jobs.title: Technology Product Owner
jobs.description:
**Organization**
At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people’s financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward, to progress, make the right financial decisions, and achieve their dreams, targets and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organization, your initiative, talent, ideas and energy contribute to the impact we can make. Together, we can achieve great things.
  
  
**Our purpose**
: Building a brighter future for all.
  
  
**Business & Team**
As we continue our pursuit of NPS +30, we need to transform how we engage with customers and colleagues. This requires moving from a two-track digital versus assisted approach to a deeply personal and empathic end-to-end digital experience, enriched and augmented by our colleagues.
  
  
The Gen AI Domain within CDAO has been established to build the tools and capabilities needed across the Group and to lead the “Transformer Banking” initiative. The domain focuses on solution practices, tools and platforms required to leverage Large Language Models safely and effectively, rather than creating foundation models.
  
  
The domain is building technology platforms and tools such as the Gen AI Hub, RAG tooling, knowledge management services, and LLM access and control planes; business platforms such as Customer Conversation Manager and Customer Activity Manager; and reusable patterns and practices for Gen AI-enabled solutions across CBA.
  
  
The team enables crews across CBA to use Generative AI as part of traditional solutions in a heavily regulated environment. We are looking for people who thrive in ambiguity, build strong team cultures, remain focused on customer needs, manage risk thoughtfully, and are passionate about enterprise transformation through Gen AI.
  
  
**Impact & Contribution**
As Product Owner, you will be accountable for a portfolio of Gen AI platforms and services used across CBA to solve important customer and colleague’s needs. You will deeply understand end-customer and internal-consumer needs, own the product roadmap, ensure the products meet those needs, and partner with the Group Practice Lead - Gen AI Solutions to drive customer success.
  
  
**Reporting Line**
Direct line reporting to CAL, Gen AI.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Define the product vision, direction and goals for the development team.
* Work with knowledge engineers, prompt engineers, platform engineers, data scientists and analysts to build reliable, resilient and adaptable Gen AI applications and deployable solutions.
* Manage and prioritize the product backlog, features and user stories, ensuring the development team works on the highest-value outcomes.
* Use your engineering background to understand customer needs for platforms serving internal engineers and assess the feasibility of transformative business capabilities.
* Balance business partner demands with the long-term sustainability of products and services to optimize customer experience, NPS, cost and risk outcomes.
* Partner with SRE teams, consuming service owners, controls teams and risk communities to embed risk management and platform resilience.
* Manage delivery expectations and provide clear status reporting to technology and business stakeholders.
* Own the risks, costs and benefits of platforms and services, while driving reliability, testing practices and Responsible AI.
* Help engineering squads determine which parts of fast-evolving Gen AI solutions require variability and which require stability.
* Continue learning while delivering tangible customer outcomes.
* Act as an ambassador for Gen AI transformation across the bank, sharing knowledge and supporting an open learning culture.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Minimum 12-14 years of relevant experience.
* Product ownership experience delivering complex, high-profile digital capabilities, technology platforms and services.
* Strong understanding of banking workflows and customer experiences, such as dispute-management processes and orchestration of multiple workflows to execute a case.
* Engineering background in software development, data engineering or data science.
* Experience building and operating technology platforms used internally or externally within an organization.
* Experience leading engineering teams that build and scale distributed systems, tools and frameworks across public, private or hybrid cloud environments.
* Exceptional stakeholder engagement, attention to detail, and verbal and written communication skills.
* Customer-focused approach with the ability to identify unmet needs and champion innovative experiences and product practices.
* Ability to drive safe and responsible Gen AI solutions by challenging technology limitations and improving systems, processes and methods.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

**Technical Skills**

* Cloud solution architecture, preferably AWS and Azure; exposure to services such as Amazon SageMaker or equivalent AI platforms is valuable.
* Strong software-development practices, including Git, debugging, automated testing and documentation.
* Experience or exposure to Python, TypeScript and/or C#.
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Prompt engineering and non-deterministic automated testing.
* System Reliability Engineering, secure coding, and software security pipeline tools for installation, configuration, operation and monitoring.
* Customer engagement systems and workflow platforms.
* Jira, Confluence and Microsoft Power Platform, including Copilot Studio.

**Good to Have**

* Understanding of machine-learning models and how generative architectures such as GANs, VAEs and Transformers are deployed at scale across cloud or on-premises infrastructure.
* Hands-on knowledge of scalable AI application patterns, RAG tooling, knowledge management services, and LLM access or control planes.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying current with developments in AI and machine learning.

**People Capabilities**
**Customer Focus:**
Creates value in every customer interaction and considers the total customer experience.
  
  
**Team and Culture:**
Inspires others to demonstrate CBA Group values and contributes to a passionate, high-performing culture.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement:**
Continuously improves and innovates to make experience simpler for customers and colleagues.
  
  
**Effective Communication:**
Communicates clearly and with impact to build understanding, engagement and commitment to action.
  
  
**Judgement:**
Uses CBA knowledge, industry information and financial drivers to guide decisions and actions.
  
  
**Drive Results:**
Takes initiative and accountability to achieve business outcomes.
  
  
**Education Qualification**
Bachelor’s degree in engineering or Master’s degree in Computer Science.
  
  
If you're already part of the Commonwealth Bank Group (including Bankwest, x15ventures), you'll need to apply through Sidekick to submit a valid application. We’re keen to support you with the next step in your career.
  
  
We're aware of some accessibility issues on this site, particularly for screen reader users. We want to make finding your dream job as easy as possible, so if you require additional support please contact HR Direct on 1800 989 696.
  
  
Advertising End Date: 26/11/2026

jobs.title: Senior Product Lead
jobs.description:
**Organization:**
At CommBank, you will work in an environment that aims to combine the scale and responsibility of Australia's leading bank with empowered, product-led teams. Our best teams are outcome-focused and take end-to-end ownership. That means staying close to the customer problem, using evidence to make decisions, being clear about trade-offs, learning quickly and owning what we build through its full lifecycle. It also means delivering safely and sustainably: risk, resilience and controls are part of good product design, not something added at the end. We value people who demonstrate Care, Courage and Commitment. You will have the opportunity to work on a material payments problem, own an important product area within a new strategic capability, collaborate with deep payments and technology specialists, and explore how automation and emerging AI can responsibly transform payment servicing.
  
  
**Job Title:**
Senior Product Lead
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Business & Team:**
As Product Lead - Payment Exceptions & Investigations, you will own a defined product area within the broader Payment Exceptions & Investigations product stream. Working within the product strategy and direction established for the stream, you will translate customer and operational problems into clear product outcomes, priorities and an executable roadmap for your squad. You will lead the product lifecycle for your area from discovery and problem definition through delivery, adoption, run performance and continuous optimisation. You will make evidence-based trade-offs across customer value, operational efficiency, risk, technology and delivery considerations, partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Architecture, Payments Operations, frontline teams, Risk and other specialist teams.
  
  
You will work closely with other Product Leads and Product Managers across the PEX stream to ensure your product area contributes to coherent end-to-end payment exception journeys and reusable capabilities rather than creating isolated solutions.
  
  
**Impact & contribution:**
As a Product Lead within the Payments Channel and Reporting Crew, you will work closely with the business to deliver exceptional outcomes for our business stakeholders and customers. You will be responsible for developing and delivering customer reporting capability for the Payments Domain. This will incorporate the delivery of reports, modernisation of existing reporting capabilities and development of the strategic roadmap for future state delivery. You will be leading a team of engineering experts to achieve this, while creating a psychologically safe, inclusive, accountable and high-performance culture, and working collaboratively within and across Crews.
  
  
**Reporting lines:**
Dhivya Elanchezhian – Senior Product Capability Lead
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Own and evolve the product vision, outcomes and roadmap for a defined Payment Exceptions & Investigations product area, aligned to the overall PEX product strategy.
* Deeply understand the customer, colleague and operational problems within your product area through discovery, data, research and engagement with frontline and operational teams.
* Translate those problems into clearly defined product opportunities, measurable outcomes and prioritised initiatives.
* Own squad-level prioritisation and roadmap decisions, balancing customer value, operational efficiency, risk, technology, delivery constraints and expected business outcomes.
* Lead discovery and delivery of reusable product capabilities that contribute to the broader PEX target state rather than creating point solutions for individual processes or systems.
* Shape simple experiences for customers, bankers, investigators and payment operations colleagues within your product area.
* Partner closely with Engineering and Architecture on product and engineering trade-offs, feasibility, sequencing, integration and delivery confidence
* Identify opportunities to move journeys from manual handling toward assisted resolution and straight-through processing where policy, evidence and controls support it.
* Explore practical applications of automation and AI for use cases such as context reconstruction, classification, summarisation, investigation support, next-best-action and response drafting.
* Ensure AI-enabled and automated outcomes within your product area are explainable, evidence-backed, auditable and appropriately bounded by human accountability and risk controls.Use customer, operational and product data to understand product performance, identify recurring pain points and continuously optimise outcomes.Define and own measurable product outcomes relevant to your area, which may include resolution time, straightthrough-processing rate, repeat contact, touches per case, queue ageing, SLA performance, customer-update timeliness, control effectiveness and colleague adoption.Embed risk, controls, regulatory and operational resilience considerations throughout discovery, design, delivery and ongoing product management.Lead and develop Product Managers within your squad/product area and contribute to strong product discipline across the broader PEX stream.Partner with other PEX Product Leads and Product Managers to manage dependencies and deliver consistent endto-end customer and colleague outcomes.

**Essential Skills:**
We’re interested in hearing from people who:
  
  

* Bring strong product management and product leadership experience, with a track record of taking complex products from discovery through delivery, adoption and continuous optimisation.
* Have payments domain knowledge, ideally across Australian domestic and/or international payments, payment processing, exceptions or servicing.
* Understand, or are able to develop strong knowledge of, payment ecosystems such as NPP, BECS/Direct Entry, BPAY, RTGS/HVCS, SWIFT and international/correspondent banking.
* Have experience with payment investigations, trace and recall, returns, repairs, failed payments, mistaken payments or related exception-servicing journeys.
* Have worked with complex workflow, case-management, servicing, operational or platform products, preferably within a regulated financial-services environment.
* Demonstrate strong product discovery, customer research, roadmap, prioritisation and lifecycle-management disciplines.
* Can turn complex customer and operational problems into simple product propositions and pragmatic delivery increments.
* Are comfortable making evidence-based trade-offs across customer value, operational outcomes, technology, risk and delivery considerations.
* Build strong partnerships across Product, Technology, Operations, Risk and customer-facing teams.Understand risk, controls and operational resilience and embed them into product decisions rather than treating them as downstream gates.
* Are curious about automation, AI and emerging technologies and can identify where they create genuine customer or operational value.
* Coach Product Managers, create clarity through ambiguity and build collaborative, outcome-focused teams

**Years of Experience:**
11+
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Product Lead with business/product background and payments domain expertise.
  
  
**Qualifications:**
B.Tech

jobs.title: Snr Product manager - Customer Platforms
jobs.description:
**Job Title: Snr Product manager - Customer Platforms**

* Wealth and Personal Banking serves millions of customers worldwide with a complete range of banking and wealth management services to enable them to manage their finances and build their financial futures. It is a global business that brings together management responsibility for Retail Banking, Wealth Management, Insurance and Asset Management with a focus on customer-centric propositions and innovative distribution channels.
* As the Product Manager - VOC Platforms, you will act as a product owner and expert for our VOC platforms. You will manage and govern the development and utilisation of the platforms such as Medallia and MMX (complaints platfrom). You will support over 15 markets and currently 6000 global platform users with a view to increase utilisation in near future. You will ensure the platforms deliver value to the business and are used effectively. You will work closely with CX specialists and other platform users to understand and deliver their business needs through the platform capabilities. You will manage the relationship with platform suppliers to maximise value to IWPB by driving the implementation and adoption of new functionality and ensuring the rapid and effective response to our required fixes and CRs.

**In This Role, You Will**

* Manage the full product lifecycle to ensure that, over time, the needs of the platform users continue to be met
* As platform SME, work closely with Technology, Transformation, D&A and market teams to ensure the VOC platforms change agenda is delivered on time and in budget. Be hands-on and remove delivery blockers through appropriate action and escalation
* Operationalise the voice of the customer platform at its full potential across users, securing ROI and value to business and customers

**Platform management (BAU)**

* Manage the integrity of the platforms and all aspects of the of business-as-usual platform operation
* Improve platform functionality, eg. Text Analytics evolution, Topic creation, AI, rules, process, triggers, surveys
* Monitor the performance of the platform to optimise value to the local and global change agenda
* Ensure platforms updates are implemented, assessed and used
* Contribute to achievement of objectives and key results across the VOC Product and use data to inform prioritisation and decision making. Maintain a focus on ROI to ensure priorities align to areas of greatest impact
* Create and manage a standard process and ways of working to respond to requests for changes
* Own the global operationalisation of the customer platforms (e.g. Medallia; Complaints platform)
* Provide status reporting regarding project milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks and issues
* Communicate and align with multiple stakeholders across organizational levels and locations
* Work creatively and solution-focused, demonstrating collaboration, innovation, and excellence
* Establish gaps in platform utilisation and opportunities to create value to business from the platform capabilities
* Own the management of training, support materials, product enquiries. Develop and report utilisation KPIs
* Own, deliver and report on a program plan to meet HSBC’s needs, maximise value from the customer platforms and maintain the functional and security integrity
* 3rd party supplier management

**Platform development (transformation)**

* Manage the pipeline of new capabilities, improvements, fixes, and requests from VOC platforms’ users
* Prioritise product requirements and own the product backlog; coordinate pilots/launches/training
* Keep up with trends and emerging business models, reimagining how to generate value to the business/customers
* Work with platform suppliers to influence their development plans, derive value from updates and ensure speedy satisfactory resolution of HSBC requests
* Obsess about how to apply technology and data to solving problems or finding new opportunities

**To Be Successful You Will**
**Knowledge & Experience / Qualifications:**

* Previous experience in implementing and configuring customer platforms (e.g. Medallia, complaints platforms)
* Previous experience in creating and managing text analytics rules and topic trees; closed loop alert rules, user roles
* Experience in a global roles, with proven experience in working in a cross functional matrix environment
* Knowledge in customer experience metrics (e.g. NPS, CSAT, Ease) and customer experience measurement
* Data driven analytical approach to problem solving, looking to understand the underlying causes, so that we can build a global solution rather than a series of point solutions
* An entrepreneurial drive, with the ability to deconstruct and solve problems
* Experience with the range of product development and deployment activities including identifying opportunities and developing business cases, defining product requirements, engaging a wide range of functional experts to agree deployment approach, project execution, launch, and post launch performance measurement and management.
* Experience of Design Thinking and leading run ahead work to explore new problems or potential ideas, bringing in Design, Analysis, Architecture and Engineering colleagues
* Good communication skills for navigating through business requirements, differences of opinion on approach
* Proven ability to build strong relationships across stakeholder groups
* Excellent understanding of the bank’s risk framework and experience of working with second line of defence: legal, compliance, financial crime (AML & sanctions), fraud, risk
* Strong outward focus and grasp of the competitor environment – opportunities, threats, gaps
* Demonstrable resilience and persistence – a ‘can-do’ attitude

**Hsbc.Com/Careers**
**You’ll achieve more at HSBC**
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Role :**

At Juspay, Associate Product managers take end to end product ownership, juggling between building the product, managing operations and evangelizing our creation with our customers.

**Being a Creator**
:

Can PMs become TRUE creators? Can they CODE? Can they Design? Can they analyze data programmatically?

Yes they do it here! We offer unique opportunities for PMs to upskill themselves and overlap with Devs and Designers. We believe PMs should participate in the creation process and make product specifications that is close to implementation.

**They Should :**

* Own the vision of the organization
* Develop and foster a deep understanding of
* *Domain*
  - Payments
* *Technology*
  - Purescript/Haskell
* *Design*
  - Mobile UX/UI (Tools: Sketch, Flinto)
* *Data*
  - Payments user journey and conversions (Tools: SQL, Tableau & data science programming)
* Deliver impactful and time-bound results by getting hands on with all aspects of product development and leading by example
* Develop framework solutions that solve problems fundamentally
* Enable, Collaborate & Coordinate with various stakeholders to craft the optimal product
* *Internal*
  - Technical Product Analysts (TPAs), Developers, Designers, Business Development and Senior Management
* *External*
  - CxOs, Sr. Executives, PMs and Devs of Merchants, Banks and Vendors
* Improve & optimise product development processes continuously

**Apply if you have :**

1. Aspiration for value creation
2. Aspiration for quality
3. Genuine user empathy
4. Openness and patience to learn harder things
5. Systematic approach to problem solving
6. Attitude and ability to get-things-done
7. Effectively balance big picture / details
8. Self-motivated and driven
9. Persuasive without being forceful
10. The Giver attitude

**Preferred Qualifications And Skills**

* MBA with 1-3 years of professional experience in Product Management.
* Strong strategic mindset along with exceptional execution capabilities and rigor.
* Proven expertise in stakeholder management
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to plan, coordinate and execute assigned tasks via collaboration with multiple cross functional teams

**Why work in Juspay?**

***Payments.. big deal?***

Yes, it is a big deal. The wind is strongly blowing in favor of electronic payments - India wants to buy/order everything online, go cashless (regulation) and can’t have enough of using smartphones! Startups and internet businesses currently see a payment’ success rate of 60% ( 40 out of 100 people fail during the payments process!). These businesses that will define our future are absolutely dependent on solving digital payments. Big industry with bigger problems to solve!

***How can Engineering solve this?***

Payments is a complex ecosystem involving banks, RBI regulations, payment networks, telecom infrastructure, online and offline merchants. There is no way to align all these stars without radical engineering innovation. Talk to us about it.

***What does Juspay offer?***

You get the opportunity to work in a free liberal environment with some of the best engineers and entrepreneurs. We live & breathe the art of building amazing products with impeccable design and engineering. We want more innovators and a little bit of madness to take it further. For us office is like home with everything needed to make us comfortably code all day and chill out too. We have a full size piano, drums and a Shruti box if you are into music :) Lots of books, pictionary and interesting people to talk to about varied subjects - art, philosophy and of course about how to do the highest feats of engineering/design. We take an active interest in helping people reach their highest potential.

jobs.title: Product Owner – Card Fraud, Payments & Authentication
jobs.description:
****Job Summary****
Synechron is seeking an experienced
**Product Designer**
to join its Card Fraud squad and shape capabilities that protect customers from card fraud while supporting secure and seamless payment experiences.
  
  
The role will focus on owning the product roadmap and priorities for Card Fraud capabilities, understanding the end-to-end card payment lifecycle, and translating customer, fraud, regulatory, and technology requirements into clear product outcomes.
  
  
The successful candidate will work across Fraud, Cards, Engineering, Operations, Architecture, and external scheme or vendor teams to identify opportunities for fraud detection and prevention across authentication, authorisation, and clearing flows.
  
  
The role will contribute to business objectives by improving fraud prevention, supporting secure payment experiences, reducing customer and business risk, enabling regulatory and scheme readiness, and delivering measurable improvements across card-payment capabilities.
  
  
****Software Requirements****
**Required Software Skills**

* Product management and ownership tools: Experience using tools and practices to manage roadmaps, priorities, backlogs, requirements, acceptance criteria, dependencies, risks, and delivery outcomes.
* Payment and fraud platforms: Understanding of systems supporting card payments, fraud detection, fraud decisioning, transaction monitoring, authentication controls, and fraud prevention.
* Card payment lifecycle: Strong knowledge of authentication, authorisation, and clearing processes.
* Card scheme processes: Strong knowledge of Mastercard and Visa card-scheme payment flows and operating requirements.
* Requirements management: Ability to document product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, process flows, and success measures.
* Roadmap and backlog management: Ability to define, prioritize, maintain, and communicate product roadmaps and delivery priorities.
* Data and reporting: Ability to use product, payment, fraud, operational, and performance information to support prioritization and decision-making.
* Stakeholder collaboration: Experience working with business, technology, operations, architecture, fraud, cards, scheme, and vendor stakeholders.

****Preferred Software Skills****

* Experience with Discover/Diners Club card-scheme payment flows.
* Exposure to real-time transaction monitoring, fraud rules, fraud strategies, authentication controls, or fraud platforms.
* Familiarity with Agile product-management and delivery tools.
* Experience with analytics, dashboards, product-performance reporting, and fraud-related metrics.
* Exposure to regulatory, scheme, and payment-transformation delivery tools and processes.

****Version And Experience Guidance****

* Specific software versions are not mandated in the requirements.
* Candidates should have experience with current product-management, payment, fraud, reporting, and collaboration tools.
* Candidates should be able to assess changes across card-payment systems, scheme requirements, fraud controls, operational processes, and technology dependencies.
* Experience should include practical ownership of product outcomes, roadmap priorities, requirements, delivery decisions, and production optimization.

****Overall Responsibilities****

* Own and drive the product roadmap and priorities for Card Fraud capabilities.
* Translate customer, fraud, regulatory, scheme, operational, and technology requirements into clear product outcomes.
* Define product goals, outcomes, priorities, delivery milestones, acceptance criteria, and success measures.
* Partner closely with Fraud, Cards, Engineering, Operations, Architecture, and external scheme or vendor teams.
* Understand end-to-end card transaction flows and identify where fraud detection and prevention controls can be effectively applied.
* Lead discovery and requirements definition for new fraud capabilities, scheme changes, and card-payment initiatives.
* Define product requirements, user stories, business rules, acceptance criteria, and delivery priorities.
* Manage dependencies, risks, assumptions, constraints, and trade-offs across multiple initiatives and stakeholder groups.
* Assess the impact of authentication, authorisation, and clearing changes on card fraud controls and customer payment experiences.
* Support the design and delivery of fraud detection, fraud decisioning, transaction monitoring, authentication, and prevention capabilities.
* Support production readiness, implementation, rollout, incident response, and ongoing optimization of fraud capabilities.
* Monitor product performance and use evidence to recommend improvements to fraud controls, payment journeys, operational processes, and customer outcomes.
* Coordinate scheme, regulatory, and payment-transformation initiatives where applicable.
* Ensure product decisions consider security, privacy, customer experience, operational feasibility, sustainability, and business value.
* Contribute to measurable outcomes, including improved fraud detection, reduced fraud losses, reduced false positives, improved payment approval rates, improved customer experience, and timely delivery of scheme or regulatory changes.

****Technical Skills (By Category)****
**Programming Languages**
****Essential****

* Ability to understand technical concepts, system behavior, APIs, data flows, integrations, and application dependencies.
* Ability to review technical requirements, solution options, acceptance criteria, and implementation impacts.
* Ability to communicate effectively with engineers, architects, analysts, fraud specialists, and technology teams.
* Ability to interpret payment, fraud, operational, and product data to support decisions.

****Preferred****

* Exposure to SQL, data analysis, or reporting tools.
* Familiarity with scripting or automation used in product analysis, reporting, or validation.
* Understanding of technical concepts related to real-time transaction processing and fraud decisioning.

**Databases/Data Management**
****Essential****

* Understanding of card-transaction, customer, payment, fraud, authentication, authorisation, clearing, and settlement data.
* Ability to assess data requirements for fraud controls, decisioning, transaction monitoring, reporting, and product measurement.
* Understanding of data quality, lineage, access control, protection, retention, and governance.
* Ability to use data and performance measures to assess product outcomes and prioritize improvements.
* Understanding of the impact of data availability, latency, accuracy, and completeness on fraud decisions and payment processing.

****Preferred****

* Exposure to real-time transaction monitoring data and fraud analytics.
* Familiarity with fraud rules, strategies, decision attributes, customer profiles, transaction patterns, and risk indicators.
* Experience with dashboards, data models, reporting tools, and analytical platforms.
* Knowledge of data requirements for card schemes, regulatory reporting, and payment transformation.

**Cloud Technologies**
****Essential****

* Understanding of technology environments that support card payments, fraud platforms, transaction processing, and customer-facing services.
* Ability to consider scalability, availability, security, latency, resilience, monitoring, and operational support in product decisions.
* Understanding of system dependencies across payment, fraud, authentication, authorisation, clearing, and operational platforms.

****Preferred****

* Exposure to cloud-based payment, fraud, analytics, or transaction-monitoring platforms.
* Familiarity with cloud-native services, APIs, real-time processing, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems.
* Understanding of cloud cost management, resource efficiency, and sustainable technology operations.

**Frameworks and Libraries**
****Essential****

* Product management and product ownership frameworks.
* Agil

jobs.title: Product Owner, SME Banking Digital
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Owner to lead the transformation of ideas into seamless, intuitive product experiences. The ideal candidate excels in planning, designing, scaling, and commercializing products, with a proven ability to test, validate, and optimize throughout the product lifecycle.
  
  
This role requires a strong client focus and business acumen to effectively prioritize and deliver on competing demands. You will inspire and influence cross-functional teams to achieve positive outcomes with executional excellence. If you are a creative problem solver who thrives on tackling complex challenges and building products from inception to scale, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
Key responsibilities include product management, governance, and commercialization activities to support client channel onboarding and the development of scalable digital solutions. Additionally, you will serve as a key point of contact for education, thought leadership, and product expertise related to client channel onboarding.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Lead high-priority, cross-functional initiatives, addressing key strategic issues and functional architecture in close collaboration with business, operations, and technology teams, with a focus on shaping and executing the client channel onboarding strategy to achieve business objectives.
* Ensure alignment of channel onboarding product goals with overall business objectives and regulatory requirements.
* Drive the implementation of digital solutions across the channel onboarding domain and operations, fostering ongoing partnerships with internal stakeholders and clients.
* Facilitate business change management and process design by developing and reviewing detailed software/functional requirements and process flow diagrams.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, communicating project progress to Senior Sponsors, Business Sponsors, Steering Committees, and the Program Management Office as appropriate.
* Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for S2B channel onboarding to senior stakeholders and team members.
* Stay abreast of industry trends, technological advancements, and best practices within the channel onboarding domain.
* Leverage innovative solutions to enhance operational efficiency and client satisfaction

**Business**

* As the product owner, responsible for crafting the product’s vision, roadmap, and maximizing the delivery of business value in SME CADM.
* Collaborate closely with channel operations team, business units, product owners and IT resources throughout all stages of project life cycle - including investigation, analysis, design, development, testing, and implementations - to ensure business requirements are successfully implemented.
* Define and track key performance indicators (KPI’s) to measure the success of various initiatives
* Institutionalize innovative ideas to accelerate the Bank’s digital footprint.

**Processes**

* Manage the Book of Work, ensuring effective prioritization and alignment with stakeholder timelines.
* Oversee and streamline processes related to information controls, productivity, and regional/country enhancements, including workflows and procedures.
* Manage the product backlog and collaborate with technology teams to digitize client and internal operational workflows for onboarding.
* Review and approve use case scenarios and test cases; coordinate and support user acceptance testing and production verification.
* Ensure governance and compliance with all bank risk assessments and policies.
* Own and approve CADM data usage and define/manage data access for CADM users; strategize and implement identity and access management applications, ensuring no toxic access.
* Collaborate with regional and country digital teams to gather product customizations, facilitate country adoption, and support documentation, guidelines, and training for identity and access management tools.
* Collect and analyze data to inform product direction and define enhancements to attract new clients.
* Deliver the digital strategy for client channel onboarding, ensuring global scalability while accommodating local requirements.
* Act as a people influencer and product owner to deliver proof of concepts and execute incubation ideas across business lines and locations, ensuring governance and controls.
* Develop and implement plans to increase awareness of digital transformation within client channel onboarding.
* Define and drive training programs to enhance digital automation capabilities among channel operations staff and stakeholders.
* Identify and address inefficiencies in channel operations, proposing workflow optimizations.
* Leverage data analysis to inform decisions and improve operational metrics.
* Identify and mitigate risks in channel operations.
* Partner with operations and business units to streamline processes, mitigate risks, and drive efficiencies.
* Measure and evaluate outcomes of change initiatives post-implementation.
* Assess the impact of process changes to ensure no additional manual touchpoints are introduced.

**People & Talent**
The role is not a people leader role however the role involves coordination between multiple parties
  
  

* Work Closely with channel operations team, business teams, peer product owners, engineering lead, architects to define and implement Solutions.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams for successful implementation and deployment of client channel onboarding capabilities
* Engage actively with legal and compliance to raise awareness of new product features and secure acceptance of the changes.

**Risk Management**

* Ensure adherence to risk management framework.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer- AI
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Senior Product Designer – AI**
who is passionate about building intelligent, AI-powered product experiences that simplify complex problems and create meaningful customer impact.

You will work at the intersection of Product Design, AI and emerging technologies, designing intuitive experiences that make AI capabilities accessible, useful and trustworthy for customers.

You will collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Data Scientists, senior leadership and other stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI can enhance customer experiences, rethink existing workflows and build innovative solutions.

We are looking for a designer who combines strong UI/UX fundamentals with curiosity about AI, understands how users interact with intelligent systems and can translate complex AI capabilities into simple, human-centric experiences.

**What You'll Do**

* Design end-to-end experiences for AI-powered products and features, from problem discovery and user journeys to high-fidelity UI and interaction design.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI to solve customer problems, simplify workflows and improve product experiences.
* Design intuitive conversational interfaces, AI assistants, chat-based experiences and intelligent user interactions.
* Translate complex AI capabilities, outputs and workflows into simple, understandable and user-friendly experiences.
* Design for AI-specific interactions, including prompts, responses, recommendations, contextual suggestions, feedback loops and human-in-the-loop workflows.
* Explore and prototype AI-powered product concepts rapidly, using emerging AI tools and technologies.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineers and Data Scientists to understand AI capabilities, technical constraints and opportunities for product innovation.
* Design experiences that build user trust through transparency, explainability, appropriate feedback and clear communication of AI-generated outputs.
* Anticipate AI-specific user experience challenges such as inaccurate responses, uncertainty, latency and unexpected outputs, and design appropriate user experiences around them.
* Conduct user research and usability testing to understand how customers interact with AI-powered features and continuously improve the experience.
* Contribute to Jupiter's design system and ensure consistency across AI-powered and traditional product experiences.
* Use qualitative insights and product metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of AI experiences and drive continuous improvements.

**What You'll Bring**

* 4+ years of hands-on Product Design experience in consumer-facing technology or product-led organisations.
* Experience designing AI-powered products, intelligent interfaces, conversational experiences or AI-enabled workflows.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts, LLM-powered applications, generative AI and conversational user experiences.
* A strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end product design capabilities, preferably including AI-driven product experiences.
* Excellent UI/UX, interaction design, prototyping and visual design skills.
* Ability to simplify complex technical concepts and translate them into intuitive customer experiences.
* Understanding of prompt-based interactions, contextual responses, AI recommendations and human-AI collaboration.
* Strong product thinking with the ability to balance user needs, business objectives and technical feasibility.
* Comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-paced environments and experimenting with emerging technologies.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to articulate design decisions and work effectively with cross-functional teams.
* A curious, experimental mindset and enthusiasm for exploring how AI can transform everyday customer experiences.

**What Will Set You Apart**

* Experience designing LLM-based products, AI copilots, chatbots, trust-based plus agentic AI experiences.
* Understanding of prompt engineering and the limitations of generative AI.
* Experience designing AI experiences involving personalisation, recommendations, automation or intelligent decision-making.
* Familiarity with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Claude code, Gemini, Lovable, Cursor or other AI-powered prototyping and design tools.
* Experience working on fintech, banking, lending or other complex consumer-facing products.

**Why You'll Love Working With Us**

* **Ownership:**
  Take responsibility for your work and drive projects from concept to impact.
* **Meaningful Problems:**
  Solve real-world financial challenges and build intelligent experiences that make managing money easier.
* **Innovation:**
  Work on emerging AI capabilities and explore new ways of building customer-centric financial products.
* **Open Culture:**
  We encourage healthy debates, diverse perspectives and open communication.
* **Speed & Trust:**
  We believe in consent over consensus, empowering teams to make decisions and move forward.
* **Continuous Learning:**
  Work with talented people who challenge you to raise the bar and grow every day.

**Job Summary**

* Own the Cash product agenda across the Digital channels, with strategic accountability for translating Cash and Payments priorities into scalable capabilities across Host-to-Host (H2H), SWIFT and Common Channel Services (CCS).
* Lead the development, prioritisation and commercialisation of channel capabilities and features, ensuring investment is anchored in clear client use cases, measurable commercial value, regulatory needs and end-to-end client outcomes.
* Lead and develop a team of Product Owners to convert strategy into an executable global roadmap and deliver consistent, secure and reusable Cash Digital capabilities across markets, client segments and connectivity models.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy, portfolio and business partnership**

* Own the global Cash channel strategy and roadmap across Web, H2H, SWIFT and CCS, aligning country, regional and global demand to business priorities.
* Act as the senior Channels counterpart to Cash Product heads and represent the portfolio in senior governance, investment and prioritisation forums.
* Partner with global, regional and country Cash Product heads to understand business, client and product priorities in every market.
* Manage senior stakeholders across global product and country management, Channels and Technology, setting expectations on scope, timing and trade-offs. Make transparent trade-offs across growth, client commitments, regulatory or scheme deadlines, resilience, simplification and platform modernisation.

**Product execution and prioritisation**

* Own the global Cash backlog for Channels and rank demand using commercial value, client impact, regulatory urgency, risk, effort and delivery feasibility.
* Lead the working relationship between Cash, country, Channel Product and Technology teams to agree scope, dependencies, release plans and accountable outcomes.
* Run one intake process for all demand, sorting each request, assess client requests tied to mandates /RFPs and implementation deadlines, track regulatory requirements against deadlines.
* Apply a clear prioritisation framework, ringfence capacity across regulatory, client driven scope on revenue and client priority, and sequence delivery. Spot common needs across markets to deliver them as global capabilities.
* Maintain executive oversight of multiple initiatives running in parallel across markets, products and channels, keep a portfolio view of status, risks, milestones and cross-channel dependencies, intervening early where delivery or value is at risk.

**Client insight, proposition and commercialisation**

* Build evidence-based country and client use cases covering target segments, revenue and volumes at stake, adoption barriers, competitive gaps and the cost of not acting.
* Define differentiated value propositions and commercialisation plans for new capabilities, partnering with Sales, Implementation, Onboarding and Client Service to drive launch readiness and adoption.
* Track adoption, transaction volumes, client feedback and realised benefits after launch, using insights to refine the proposition and roadmap.

**Cross-channel capability and solution leadership**

* Translate Cash and Payments needs into end-to-end capabilities spanning digital journeys, entitlements, approvals, connectivity, formats, payment status and reporting.
* Guide solutioning across H2H connectivity (SFTP, AS2 and HTTPS), SWIFT channels (FileAct, FIN and gpi), ISO 20022 messages and legacy or local clearing formats.
* Promote reusable components, standard formats and common services while safeguarding security, resilience, sanctions, fraud, accessibility and regulatory requirements.

**People and talent**

* Lead, coach and develop Product Owners, translating strategy into clear objectives and allocating capacity to the highest-value work.
* Build strategic, commercial, client and channel depth across the team, strengthening prioritisation, stakeholder management, product discipline and succession capacity.
* Role-model the Bank’s valued behaviours, sound risk judgement, constructive feedback, inclusion, wellbeing and accountability.

**Risk, controls and governance**

* Embed product, operational, information security, regulatory and conduct requirements throughout discovery, design, delivery, release and post-launch review.
* Ensure material decisions, exceptions, residual risks and control dependencies are appropriately governed and documented.
* Maintain accurate client-facing specifications, user guidance, release notes, testing support and migration plans for new or changed capabilities.

**Skills And Experience**
**Must-have Skills**

* Cash and Payments Product Strategy
* Digital Channels and Corporate Connectivity
* Product Commercialisation and Value Proposition

**Other Skills**

* Portfolio Prioritisation and Investment Discipline
* Client and Market Insight
* Senior Stakeholder Influence
* People Leadership and Product Team Development

**Motivations**

* Shaping client-channel strategy and turning complex Cash and Payments needs into scalable propositions with visible commercial and client value.
* Leading across business, product and technology boundaries to resolve competing priorities and deliver high-impact outcomes across markets.
* Building empowered Product Owner teams that combine deep channel expertise with strategic thinking, disciplined execution and strong client focus.

**Qualifications**
**Key Experiences**

* 15+ years of senior-level experience in Transaction Banking, Cash Management, Payments or enterprise digital channels, including product strategy, proposition development, commercialisation and execution.
* Deep experience in corporate connectivity and more than one client channel, with working knowledge of H2H, SWIFT, APIs and corporate Web banking.
* Strong Cash and Payments domain understanding across domestic and cross-border payments, real-time and bulk payments, payroll, receivables, liquidity, statements and reporting.
* Working command of ISO 20022 payment and reporting messages, legacy MT formats, local clearing formats, and ERP or treasury management system integration.
* Demonstrated experience building business cases, prioritising investments and managing multiple initiatives across countries, products and channels.
* Strong experience in Portfolio management at scale, running a large backlog with many initiatives in parallel, while sharing limited delivery capacity across countries and demand types.
* Proven leadership of Product Owners or Product Managers and senior-level influence across Product, Sales, Technology, Operations, Risk and Compliance.

**Certifications / Qualifications (only where mandatory):**
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in business, finance, engineering, computer science or a related discipline. No role-specific certification is mandatory.
  
  
**Languages:**
English: professional fluency. Additional languages are advantageous where relevant to the role’s market coverage.
  
  
**About Standard Chartered**
We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
* In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
* Core bank funding

Senior Business Analyst – Banking Data Lakehouse Platform

**Company:**
Sylox

**Location:**
Pune, Maharashtra (Baner)

**Work Mode:**
On-site, with frequent travel to Mumbai for client visits

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
4–8 years

**Joining:**
Immediate joiners required

About Sylox

Sylox is a technology company specializing in enterprise data engineering, integration, analytics and data governance. We design and deliver data solutions for enterprises, including organizations operating in regulated industries.

We are working on a cloud-native
**Banking Data Lakehouse on Google Cloud**
, bringing together data from multiple enterprise systems to support analytics, regulatory reporting and fraud detection.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced
**Senior Business Analyst**
to work closely with banking stakeholders, the Program Manager and our data engineering team on an enterprise Banking Data Lakehouse project.

The role involves understanding complex banking requirements, translating them into functional and data specifications, supporting delivery activities and coordinating directly with client stakeholders.

This is a hands-on, client-facing position requiring strong business analysis, banking domain expertise, data understanding and excellent communication skills.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Business Analysis & Requirements Gathering**

* Lead requirement-gathering discussions and workshops with banking stakeholders.
* Prepare BRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flows and acceptance criteria.
* Translate business requirements into clear, actionable specifications for data engineering teams.
* Identify requirement gaps, dependencies and change impacts.

**2. Banking Data Lakehouse Requirements**

* Work with stakeholders to define banking data flows, business rules and reporting requirements.
* Support source-to-target data mapping, data dictionaries, business glossaries and reconciliation requirements.
* Define requirements across Bronze, Silver and Gold data lakehouse layers.
* Gather requirements for data ingestion, transformation, APIs, dashboards and analytics.
* Capture regulatory reporting, fraud analytics, data security and governance requirements.
* Coordinate with data engineers to validate business rules, data quality and reporting outputs.

**3. Project Coordination & Delivery**

* Work closely with the Program Manager and engineering teams to manage requirements and delivery priorities.
* Support backlog refinement, sprint activities, issue tracking and project documentation.
* Track deliverables, dependencies, risks and stakeholder decisions.
* Maintain requirement-to-test-to-release traceability.
* Assess changes in requirements and their impact on project scope, timelines and deliverables.

**4. Client Engagement & UAT**

* Participate in regular client meetings and requirement discussions in Mumbai.
* Coordinate UAT planning, test scenarios, defect resolution and business sign-offs.
* Maintain clear communication with banking stakeholders and internal technical teams.
* Ensure requirements are validated against business expectations before release.

Required Skills & Experience

* **4–8 years**
  of relevant Business Analysis experience.
* **Minimum 2 years**
  of experience in banking, financial services data or regulatory reporting projects.
* Strong understanding of core banking, payments and banking data processes.
* Good working knowledge of SQL, data mapping, reconciliation and data validation.
* Experience in data lakehouse, data warehousing, ETL/ELT, analytics or BI projects.
* Strong documentation skills: BRD, FRD, user stories, acceptance criteria and UAT.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence or equivalent Agile delivery tools.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), particularly BigQuery.
* Familiarity with modern data lakehouse architecture and cloud-native data processing.
* Exposure to fraud analytics, banking regulatory reporting or data governance.
* Experience working directly with enterprise banking clients.
* Knowledge of data quality, metadata management and data security principles.

Location, Travel & Joining Requirements

* **Must be based in Pune or willing to relocate to Pune.**
* **Frequent travel to Mumbai for client meetings and project activities is mandatory.**
* Must be comfortable working on-site with customer teams as required.
* **Immediate joining is required.**

How to Apply

Send your updated resume to careers@syloxlabs.com.

**Email Subject:**
Senior Business Analyst – Banking Data Lakehouse – [Your Name]

Please include:

* Current location
* Total experience and banking domain experience
* Current notice period / earliest joining date
* Confirmation of willingness to travel frequently to Mumbai

https://syloxlabs.com

Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

Unlock the power of AI. Define how and where AI technology enhances the measurement and optimization of business initiatives.
  
  
**All About You**
Can work closely with cross-functional partners like engineers, designers, sales, marketing, and users.

Broad strategic thinking skills, adept in translating product vision/strategy into an actionable roadmap.
  
  
Creative problem-solver, can balance competing needs and prioritize thoughtfully.
  
  
Strong professional presence. Excellent interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills.
  
  
Experience building with AI or using AI to enhance an existing software application

jobs.title: Product Owner (SAP)
jobs.description:
**Product Owner**
Recruiter for this position: Vipin Yadav
  
  
Hiring Manager for this position: Jaya Dadlani
  
  
Division: Product Engineering O2C
  
  
Serrala is the global leader in finance process automation. For over 40 years, we have been advancing the office of the CFO with our award-winning suite of finance automation applications.
  
  
Our solutions streamline all working capital-related processes, including Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Cash Flow Management, and Treasury, across both cloud and SAP environments.
  
  
Our 10+ hubs across Europe, North America, and India support over 2,800 clients worldwide, reflecting the trust we've built with a diverse global community.
  
  
Join us as we lead the future of finance automation!
  
  
**Role Summary:**
We are looking for a Technical Product Owner to sit at the intersection of engineering and product for our Credit & Risk suite. This role is for someone who can go deep into ABAP, RAP and Fiori technical topics to design and guide developers, write Epics and User Stories that developers and QA can implement and test without ambiguity, and — when dedicated QA capacity is limited — test the functionality themselves. Prior Product Owner experience is not required as long as strong Project Management and Agile delivery skills are in place.
  
  
The person will work closely with the Product Manager to understand, follow, and contribute to the Roadmap, and will collaborate in depth with customers, external credit agencies, Solution Architects, and Consulting to explain the product, gather feedback, and turn it into actionable backlog items
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Deep-dive into technical topics in SAP ABAP, RAP and Fiori to design solutions and guide developers through implementation.
* Write clear, well-structured Epics and User Stories that are easy for developers and QA to implement and test.
* Perform hands-on testing / QA yourself for critical items when dedicated QA capacity is limited.
* Understand, follow, and actively contribute to the product Roadmap set by the Product Manager.
* Collaborate in depth with customers, external credit agencies, Solution Architects, and Consulting teams — explaining the product, capturing feedback, and translating it into requirements.
* Bring significant/strategic topics to the Product Manager for joint discussion and decision-making.
* Apply a working understanding of SAP functional processes and Finance tables to ground technical decisions in real business context.
* Demonstrate excellent communication, active listening, and critical reasoning across technical and non-technical audiences.

**Must-Have:**

* Hands-on technical experience with SAP ABAP, RAP and Fiori/UI5 — enough to design solutions and guide developers, not just review code.
* Strong Project Management / Agile delivery skills (Scrum, sprint planning, Backlog management) — Product Owner title/experience is not mandatory if this is solid.
* Basic understanding of SAP functional processes; exposure to Finance tables (e.g. BSEG, BSID, Credit Management tables) is a strong plus.
* Demonstrated ability to write Epics and User Stories that developers and QA can pick up and implement/test with minimal back-and-forth.
* Willingness and ability to personally execute QA/Testing when QA capacity is constrained.
* Proven experience collaborating directly with customers, partners, or external agencies — explaining a product and incorporating feedback.
* Excellent communication and active-listening skills, with strong critical reasoning to navigate ambiguous, technical, and business conversations alike.

**Good-to-Have:**

* Prior experience as a Product Owner or in a similar product/technical-lead role.
* Domain exposure to Credit Management, Credit Risk, Order to Cash (O2C), or Accounts Receivable.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA (or ECC-to-S/4HANA migration context).
* Familiarity with JIRA/Confluence or similar Agile tooling for Epics/Story and Roadmap management.
* Exposure to integrations with external credit bureaus/agencies (e.g. credit reporting or credit insurance providers). Exposure to AI/ML-driven features such as credit exposure or risk-prediction models.
* Prior experience working with Solution Architects and Consulting teams in a customer-facing capacity.

Next steps: Simply apply here via the internal job market - we will contact you as soon as possible. Good to know: We will contact you first - your current manager will not be informed about your internal application.
  
  
Your HR Contact for this position is: Vipin Yadav
  
  
This role is based in: Pune

jobs.title: Product Head - Fintech Domain
jobs.description:
**What You'll Do**

* Own the vision and the roadmap :
* Turn the company vision into a product strategy and a roadmap the whole company can plan against.
* Help us prioritize opportunities as we expand the product, go up-market, and explore new possibilities.
* Own product metrics end to end : turnaround time, accuracy, coverage, adoption and revenue per product line.
* Develop and execute the product strategy and roadmap to move the needle on ARR, Retention, and ACV, in collaboration with the GTM teams.
* Stay close to customers and regulators :
* Spend time every week with credit, risk, legal and operations teams at banks, NBFCs and HFCs. Know their workflows better than they do.
* Track RBI, NHB and CERSAI direction and public infrastructure such as ULI, and build ahead of it instead of reacting to it.
* Sit in on key enterprise deals and renewals, and bring back what the product needs to win the next one.
* Ship, hands-on :
* Write specs, prototype with AI tools and review output quality yourself. This is a player-coach role.
* Partner with Engineering, Data Acquisition and Data Science to balance speed with platform reliability and compliance-grade accuracy.
* Make AI a product advantage : document understanding in 14 languages, title reasoning and automated risk signals that a credit officer can trust and audit.
* Drive adoption and ARR with GTM and Sales :
* Co-own adoption and ARR targets with the Sales and GTM leads. A product is not shipped until customers are using it and paying for it.
* Work on positioning, messaging and launch content, so the market understands what each product does and why it matters to a lender.
* Equip Sales and Customer Success with demos, proof points, ROI cases and competitive answers, and join key pitches, renewals and expansion conversations.
* Run a tight loop on win/loss reasons, usage data and customer feedback, and use it to grow usage and revenue within existing accounts.
* Own pricing and monetization :
* Leverage experience in B2B SaaS to make informed decisions around monetization, pricing, and product enhancements that help grow ARR and ACV.
* Lead and grow the team :
* Hire, coach and raise the bar for product managers and designers.
* Set a lightweight operating rhythm for discovery, prioritization, releases and feedback loops with Sales and Delivery.
* Represent product to the board, investors, customers and ecosystem partners.
* Foster a culture of low ego, high impact, and continuous learning.

**What We're Looking For**

* 10+ years in product management, including 3+ years leading product managers.
* You have owned a B2B platform, API or data product end to end and scaled it from early traction to a large customer base.
* Experience selling into or building for regulated enterprises, ideally banks, NBFCs or insurers, with long sales cycles and compliance reviews.
* First-principles thinking : you can break an ambiguous problem into bets, and show the data behind your calls.
* High agency and low ego. You do whatever part of the PM job the week demands.
* AI-native in how you work and what you build. You have shipped products where ML or LLM output quality was the product.
* Experience with data products where coverage, freshness and accuracy are the core metrics.
* Comfort with pricing and packaging for enterprise and usage-based API models.
* A track record of hiring and growing strong PMs.

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience taking a B2B data asset into a consumer or partner-led product.
* Background in lending, mortgage, credit risk, collateral or fintech infrastructure.
* You have been a founder or an early leader at a company through Series A to C.

**Why You'll Love Working Here**

* Impact : property is India's largest asset class and its least liquid. Your work decides how fast credit reaches homeowners, small businesses and farmers.
* A real moat to build on : a property dataset and identity layer that took years to assemble, with live banking customers already using it.
* Ownership : a leadership seat, direct access to founders, board and customers, and meaningful equity.
* Compensation and benefits : Competitive salary, ESOPs, health cover, leave policy and other benefits.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Specialist (WT- Contact Center (Ops))
jobs.description:
Leads the strategic vision and roadmap for a digital product or products within a specific business area, demonstrating a deep understanding of the digital product(s). Digital products may have enterprise-wide implications.
  
  
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Product Manager, Specialist role is responsible for leading digital product management initiatives, overseeing the development, implementation, and optimization of strategic products. This role requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams to enhance customer experience, define product roadmaps, and drive business growth. The specialist ensures smooth product execution, manages escalations, and employs data-driven insights to refine product strategies. Additionally, they work with stakeholders to align product goals with business objectives and market needs.
  
  
This Product Manager will lead enhancements to the customer service and contact center tools used by our crew to serve clients, including the integration of AI capabilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead digital product management efforts for multiple digital products or one strategic product, ensuring alignment with business goals.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement best practices that enhance the customer experience and drive impactful changes.
* Coach digital product teams on best practices, learnings, and product development methodologies to maximize efficiency.
* Partner with stakeholders to resolve production and implementation issues promptly, supporting escalations when needed to enable rapid delivery.
* Oversee the planning, development, and execution of new digital products, including market analysis, feature definition, and implementation planning.
* Develop pricing and positioning strategies, ensuring products are competitive and aligned with market demand.
* Utilize qualitative and quantitative analysis techniques to continually improve the user experience and optimize product performance.
* Translate product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes, collaborating with engineering teams to ensure timely and resource-efficient delivery.
* Lead product launches by working closely with marketing teams, executives, and other product management stakeholders to drive successful go-to-market strategies.
* Evaluate promotional plans to ensure consistency with product line strategies and effective messaging across customer segments.
* Participate in ongoing business planning, departmental prioritization activities, and special projects as required.
* Lead the modernization of contact-center desktop capabilities and supporting tools to improve the experience of contact-center staff and participants while enabling stronger customer relationships.
* Coordinate dependencies across multiple applications and product teams by understanding interconnected roadmaps, managing delivery trade-offs, and balancing technical constraints with speed to market.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of related work experience, with at least two years of experience leading large cross-functional teams on major organizational projects.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science or IT, or Bachelor’s in Computer Applications (BCA), or Master’s in Computer Applications (MCA).
* Strong expertise in digital product management, market analysis, and user experience optimization.
* Proven ability to translate customer insights into product improvements and new features.
* Experience working with engineering teams to drive product development from concept to launch.
* Excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities to align product strategy with business goals.
* Experience in a contact-center or service environment, including familiarity with contact-center operations, desktop platforms, and the tools that support customer-service teams.
* Demonstrated ability to manage cross-product dependencies and collaborate with multiple product managers; financial-services experience is preferred but not mandatory, and relevant banking or healthcare customer-service systems experience may be considered.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

**Some careers open more doors than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

  

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we support customers with their day-to-day banking and wealth-management needs through international expertise, digital capabilities and exceptional service.

  

**Location:** GIFT City, Gandhinagar

  

**Role purpose**

Lead the development, management and growth of transaction banking, wealth, lending and related product propositions for IWPB at GIFT City IBU. The role will drive customer acquisition, relationship deepening, retention and revenue growth by delivering relevant, commercially viable, digitally enabled and compliant products.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and manage product and proposition strategies aligned with IWPB priorities and customer needs.
* Own the product lifecycle from ideation, business case and approval through launch, performance review and enhancement.
* Drive propositions across deposits, payments, cash management, foreign exchange, lending, investments, insurance and other wealth solutions.
* Conduct customer, market and competitor research to identify growth opportunities.
* Define product features, pricing, eligibility, target segments, distribution approach and customer value propositions.
* Prepare business cases covering customer value, revenue, profitability, costs, risks and operational requirements.
* Develop product roadmaps and coordinate delivery with Technology, Operations, Treasury, Finance, Distribution and control functions.
* Support Relationship Managers and distribution teams with product guides, training, sales materials and customer communications.
* Monitor product performance, including balances, volumes, revenue, profitability, adoption, penetration, customer outcomes and complaints.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer journeys, digital adoption, operational efficiency and straight-through processing.
* Ensure products and propositions meet GIFT City IBU regulations, HSBC policies and applicable risk, conduct and compliance requirements.
* Maintain appropriate product governance, approvals, disclosures, procedures and documentation.
* Partner with regional and global HSBC product teams to leverage existing capabilities and share best practice.
* Use customer and performance insight to drive continuous product and proposition improvement.
  

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong experience in product management, proposition development or business management within banking or financial services.
* Knowledge of transaction banking, wealth management, lending, investments, insurance, deposits, payments or foreign exchange.
* Strong commercial, customer-focused and analytical skills.
* Experience with product strategy, pricing, business cases, roadmaps and lifecycle management.
* Excellent stakeholder-management, communication and influencing skills.
* Ability to work effectively with business, technology, operations, distribution and control teams.
* Understanding of product governance, risk, conduct and regulatory requirements.
* Strong delivery discipline, organisation, ownership and attention to detail.
* Comfortable working in a matrix environment with regional and global stakeholders.
  

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Experience managing banking or wealth products through development, approval, launch and optimisation.
* Experience supporting affluent, international, wealth or private banking customers is preferred.
* Experience in cross-border banking, multi-currency products or GIFT City IBU is desirable.
* Experience working with Relationship Managers, Operations, Technology, Finance, Risk, Compliance and Legal teams.
* Graduate degree preferred; an MBA, finance, business, economics or technology qualification is an advantage.
* Relevant product-management, agile, project-management or financial-services certifications are desirable.
* Any required licences or certifications should align with GIFT City IBU regulatory expectations.
  

**Pro Tip:** Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.

  

**Note:**

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.

  

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

  

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
