jobs.description:
**Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution**

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

**Why Skan AI**

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

**Role Overview**

As Director of Product, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Skan's process intelligence platform. This is the platform that helps the world's largest enterprises see how work actually happens inside their organizations, and act on that understanding. It is technically complex, data-intensive, and genuinely impactful at scale.

We are looking for someone who has spent meaningful time in process mining, process intelligence, or intelligent automation. Not just an awareness of the space, but real product experience in it. You know the gap between a compelling demo and something that actually works in a large enterprise environment. You have shipped products in this domain and have the scars to show for it.

With 12 to 15 years of product experience, including time at AI-native startups, you are comfortable making product calls with incomplete information, working without a lot of support structure around you, and keeping a team focused when everything feels urgent. You are also someone who uses AI tools every day in how you work, not just in what you build. That matters to us.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Vision and Strategy**

* Own the product roadmap for the process intelligence platform, from how we capture and model operational data through to the analytics and prescriptive insights we surface to customers.
* Make clear, defensible decisions on what we build next. You will get input from customers, from sales, from data, and from the competitive landscape. Your job is to synthesize all of that and land on a prioritized point of view.
* Keep the company aligned on product direction. That means being a consistent voice in leadership discussions, not just a person who maintains a roadmap document.
* Know the competitive landscape well. Understand what Celonis, SAP Signavio, UiPath, and the broader BPM and automation ecosystem are doing. Use that knowledge to sharpen Skan's positioning and find the white space.

**Product Execution and Delivery**

* Work closely with engineering, design, and data science to turn complex customer problems into product requirements teams can actually build from. Good PRDs, clear acceptance criteria, and regular communication matter here.
* Manage delivery across several workstreams at once, covering process discovery, analytics, conformance, and integrations. Help teams make smart trade-off decisions when timelines get tight.
* Stay engaged with architecture and data model decisions that affect the product. You do not need to write the code, but you need to understand what is being built and why certain technical choices matter at enterprise scale.
* Hold a high bar for user experience. Process intelligence data is inherently complex. Making it feel accessible and actionable to both business users and technical users is one of the harder product challenges in this space.

**Using AI in How You Work**

We are an AI company. We expect product leaders to work with AI tools every day, not just build products that use them. This is what that looks like in practice.

* Use LLMs and AI research tools to move faster in discovery. Summarize customer interviews, identify patterns across large volumes of feedback, and sharpen your hypotheses without spending days manually reviewing notes.
* Use generative AI to write better first drafts of PRDs and specifications. Spend your energy making judgment calls and refining thinking, not starting from a blank page every single time.
* Set up workflows to track what is happening in the market. Use AI tools to monitor competitor releases, analyst commentary, and community signals across the process mining and automation space so you are never behind.
* Bring your team along. Help your product managers develop real fluency with these tools, including knowing when to trust AI output and when to push back on it.
* Stay grounded in what AI can and cannot do reliably inside enterprise products. That practitioner perspective will directly shape how we build and talk about AI features in the platform.
* Share what you learn. Recommend tools, document what works, and help build an internal culture of AI-augmented work across the product organization.

**Team Leadership**

* Build and grow the product management team. That means hiring thoughtfully, giving people real ownership of meaningful problems, and being the kind of manager whose reports get better over time.
* Set up the operating model. Good product teams do not run themselves. Help establish the rituals, frameworks, and ways of working that let people move fast without losing sight of what matters.
* Create an environment where people are honest about trade-offs, comfortable sitting with uncertainty, and focused on outcomes over activity.

**Customer and Commercial Engagement**

* Spend real time with customers. Get into the detail of how they use the product, where it falls short, and what they actually need. Use those conversations to challenge your assumptions, not just confirm them.
* Show up in executive-level customer conversations and sales cycles as a credible product voice. You should be able to walk a customer through where the product is heading and why it matters to their specific business.
* Work with Customer Success to track how customers are getting value from the platform and use those signals to sharpen what we build next.

**Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Help Sales and Marketing tell a sharper product story. That means going beyond feature lists and helping them articulate what actually makes Skan different in a crowded market.
* Collaborate with Finance and leadership when business cases need product input, whether that involves pricing, packaging, or expansion opportunities.
* Stay close to what Professional Services and Customer Success teams see on the ground. Some of the most useful product insights come from the people who spend the most time with customers post-sale.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* 12 to 15 years of professional experience, with at least 8 years in product management in enterprise software or SaaS.
* You have worked at an AI-native startup. You know what it is like to build under pressure, make product calls without full information, and keep moving without a lot of infrastructure around you.
* Background in process mining, process intelligence, BPM, task mining, or RPA is strongly preferred. Candidates with this domain experience will stand out. If you have worked at companies like Celonis, UiPath, SAP Signavio, ABBYY, Minit, or similar, we want to hear from you.
* Real familiarity with process mining concepts: how event logs work, what conformance checking involves, how process discovery surfaces insigh

Pine Labs is seeking a dynamic B2C marketing leader to drive consumer adoption of our fintech products through integrated marketing campaigns and innovative in-store activation. This role owns the end-to-end consumer journey—from digital discovery to in-store transaction—making affordability and smart payment solutions accessible and desirable to millions of Indian consumers.

You'll craft compelling fintech narratives that demystify complex products, drive app adoption, and create memorable in-store experiences that convert browsers into users at the moment of purchase.

**Consumer Brand Building & Integrated Campaigns**

* Develop and execute 360-degree integrated marketing campaigns that connect digital touchpoints (social, app, performance marketing) with physical retail experiences
* Own the consumer narrative for Pine Labs' affordability ecosystem—EMI, Pay Later, consumer cards, and wallet products—translating fintech complexity into simple, relatable stories
* Build category leadership by creating the "Halo Effect" that positions Pine Labs as the smart choice for aspirational consumption
* Drive always-on brand campaigns and high-impact moment marketing that keeps Pine Labs top-of-mind for young consumers

* Deep experience with integrated marketing campaigns that blend digital performance marketing with offline/experiential activation

* Narrative design skills that make financial products emotionally compelling, not just functionally useful

*Experiential Marketing & Activation*

* Ability to measure the impact of experiential marketing on brand metrics and downstream transactions

*Strategic Orchestration & Influence*

Job description:

Job Description – Business Development Manager (Field Sales)

**Position:** Business Development Manager (BDM) – Field Sales  
**Experience:** 2–8 Years  
**Job Location:** Mumbai (Open to candidates across Mumbai and nearby locations)  
**Salary:** ₹40,000 – ₹50,000 per month (based on experience and interview)  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Only  
**Employment Type:** Full-time | Field-Based Role

About the Role

We are looking for dynamic and target-driven Business Development Managers to drive business growth by connecting with founders, business owners, entrepreneurs and decision-makers. The role involves field sales, client acquisition, relationship building and converting qualified prospects into customers.

**Note:** This is a field-based role, not an office-based job. Candidates are not required to visit the office every day. You will manage your daily field activities, client meetings and follow-ups independently.

Key Responsibilities

* Meet business owners, founders, directors and decision-makers through daily field visits.
* Generate leads through market visits, networking, references and follow-ups.
* Identify businesses that require funding-readiness support.
* Explain the services, programme fees, deliverables and terms transparently.
* Convert qualified prospects into paying clients.
* Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline.
* Maintain daily records of leads, client visits, follow-ups and conversions in the CRM.
* Submit daily sales and activity reports.
* Coordinate with the internal team after successful client onboarding.

Target Audience

You will primarily connect with:

* Manufacturers, distributors and wholesalers.
* Traders and exporters.
* Retail and restaurant businesses.
* Clinics, laboratories and healthcare businesses.
* Education businesses.
* D2C and e-commerce brands.
* Technology startups and entrepreneurs.
* Logistics, textile and other business sectors.

Candidate Requirements

* 2–8 years of experience in target-based sales.
* Experience in Banking, NBFC, Loans, Credit Cards, Insurance, Financial Products or B2B Field Sales preferred.
* Proven track record of achieving monthly sales targets.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and client-handling skills.
* Comfortable with daily field visits and meeting business owners.
* Self-driven, proactive and capable of independently managing sales activities.
* Honest and transparent approach towards client acquisition.
* Immediate joiners only.

Monthly Targets

* **During Probation (First 3 Months):** 5 verified paid clients per month.
* **After Confirmation:** 10 verified paid clients per month.

A client is counted only after the agreement is signed, payment is received and settled, and onboarding is completed.

Salary & Incentives

**Monthly Salary Package: ₹40,000 – ₹50,000**

Incentive structure:

* 0–4 verified paid clients: No incentive.
* 5–9 verified paid clients: ₹20,000 incentive.
* 10 or more verified paid clients: ₹40,000 incentive.

Salary consists of base wages and a target-linked component, as specified in the written offer.

**Travel Allowance:**

* During probation: ₹3/km for bike and ₹2/km for scooty, based on field kilometres recorded in the CRM.
* After probation: ₹3,000 per month.

Training & Joining Process

* 7-day online training programme before employment.
* Training starts: 1 December 2026.
* Certification is mandatory.
* Shortlisted candidates will complete joining formalities on 7 December 2026.
* Certified candidates who complete training and join will receive a training completion bonus equivalent to 7 days of their monthly salary package, along with

Pay: ₹45,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience you have in field sales ?
* How many years of experience you have in NBFC?
* Can you work from Pune?
* Please mention your current CTC
* Please mention your expected CTC
* Please mention your notice period?

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Associate - Legal Counsel - Cross Border - Asset & Wealth Management
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

JPMorgan Chase & Co. is a leading global financial services firm with assets of $2.6 trillion and operations worldwide, and its Legal Department provides specialized legal support aligned to the firm's lines of business and corporate staff areas. Asset & Wealth Management is one of the largest asset and wealth managers in the world, serving institutional and retail clients through Asset Management and high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients through the Private Bank. The business offers global investment management across equities, fixed income, real estate, hedge funds, private equity, and liquidity, and provides trust and estate, banking, brokerage, and retirement services. The Legal Department is seeking an experienced lawyer to support cross-border efforts, focusing on reviewing and analyzing legal opinions related to the cross-border provision of asset and wealth management products and services, and helping document and communicate related legal and regulatory requirements.

This role is based in Mumbai, India, at the J.P. Morgan Mumbai Corporate Centre, and functionally reports to:

* A Managing Director and Associate General Counsel for Asset & Wealth Management in the United States
* An Executive Director and Assistant General Counsel for Asset & Wealth Management in the United Kingdom
* A local Asset & Wealth Management Legal supervisor in Mumbai

Job summary:

As an Associate Legal Counsel within Asset & Wealth Management Legal, you will support cross-border efforts with a primary focus on reviewing and analyzing legal opinions related to the cross-border provision of products and services. You will help drive documentation of cross-border laws and regulations and communicate related requirements to business stakeholders. You will partner with lawyers, compliance partners, business stakeholders, and external counsel to maintain clear, current, and usable guidance for the business.

Job responsibilities:

* Conduct the first review of new or updated legal opinions from external counsel and new or revised draft rules for the business to provide products and services on a cross-border basis, and facilitate periodic and ad hoc updates of existing materials based on legal or regulatory changes or business developments
* Draft summaries of updates to facilitate the review-and-approval process via an internal workflow tool
* Engage with external counsel, Asset & Wealth Management lawyers, Compliance, and business stakeholders to obtain and resolve feedback on updates
* Field stakeholders' basic queries concerning the materials and fact-specific queries
* Advise as the Legal Department's first point of contact on potential issues relating to cross-border materials
* Provide regular feedback to business stakeholders and cross-border forums on pending reviews
* Conduct additional research and assist on special projects as needed
* Create and enhance audit-ready processes in a highly regulated environment, including through the use of technology

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

* Demonstrate excellent English writing and communication skills
* Hold a law degree
* Be in compliance, prior to commencement of employment, with all relevant licensing requirements, including the requirements of the jurisdiction where the role will be located
* Be sufficiently well qualified to interpret and summarize external legal advice and articulate clear “rules of the road” for the business
* Operate as a self-starter who works collaboratively in a high-performing team, takes ownership of responsibilities and projects, and is results-oriented and flexible
* Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, complex business environment and maintain communication with attorneys regarding project status and estimated completion timelines
* Demonstrate competence with Microsoft Office products, including Microsoft Excel, and the use of large language models and artificial intelligence
* Successfully complete a conflicts of interest clearance review prior to commencement of employment (applicable to all Legal Department roles)

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

* Master of Laws (LLM) preferred
* 2–4 years of experience in financial services law
* Experience instructing and interacting with external counsel directly
* Experience working across jurisdictions and time zones

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

  

With large, global operations, the Legal team tackles complex issues and helps shape the regulations that affect the businesses. The group is organized into practice groups that align with the lines of business and corporate staff areas, which encourages collaboration on legal, regulatory and business developments as they arise.

jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.description:
Financial Controller – Entrance Control Middle East is responsible for leading the finance function, ensuring financial integrity, regulatory compliance, effective financial planning, and sustainable business performance. The role acts as a strategic business partner to the Managing Director and leadership team, providing financial insights to support commercial decisions, profitability, operational efficiency, and business growth. The position has overall responsibility for financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting, cash flow and working capital management, tax compliance, financial controls, risk management, audit coordination, and the development of robust finance processes across the region. The role requires a combination of strategic financial leadership, strong technical accounting expertise, commercial acumen, and an in-depth understanding of UAE financial and tax regulations. It also requires close collaboration with global finance teams, business unit leaders, sales, service, operations, procurement, and other relevant stakeholders.

  
  
**Requirements**

**Main Tasks (key accountabilities, deliveries, what is the role expected to do).**

* Lead the finance function and act as a strategic business partner to management.
* Align financial plans, budgets, and targets with regional business objectives.
* Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing and reporting.
* Ensure accurate financial statements, management accounts, and financial reconciliations.
* Ensure compliance with IFRS, group accounting policies, and local statutory requirements.
* Lead annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, and long-term financial planning.
* Analyse financial performance, variances, risks, and opportunities to support decision-making.
* Monitor revenue, gross margins, project profitability, and overall business performance.
* Review pricing proposals, tenders, customer contracts, and commercial business cases.
* Manage cash flow forecasting, liquidity planning, and working capital optimization.
* Monitor receivables, overdue payments, credit risks, and debt collection performance.
* Ensure compliance with UAE VAT, Corporate Tax, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of audit findings.
* Establish and monitor financial controls, approval processes, and risk mitigation measures.
* Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, and fixed asset accounting.
* Drive finance process improvements, automation, and effective ERP utilization, preferably Microsoft Dynamics 365.
* Prepare financial dashboards, management reports, and business performance insights.
* Lead, coach, and develop the regional finance team to achieve operational excellence.
* Collaborate with sales, service, operations, procurement, HR, and global finance teams.
* Ensure accurate intercompany accounting, reconciliations, and compliance with transfer pricing requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve profitability, reduce costs, and optimize resource utilization.
Monitor changes in UAE tax laws and implement necessary compliance and process updates.  

**Main KPI’s / Metrics that the role has an impact on**

* Financial Performance: Monitor revenue, gross margin, operating profit, EBITDA (where applicable), and achievement against budget.
* Financial Reporting: Ensure accurate and timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting.
* Closing and Reconciliation: Complete month-end closing on time, ensure balance sheet reconciliations, and resolve outstanding items.
* Budgeting and Forecasting: Maintain forecast accuracy, ensure budget adherence, and deliver high-quality financial analysis.
* Cash Flow and Working Capital: Improve cash flow forecasting, monitor overdue receivables and debtor days, optimise working capital, and manage bad debt exposure.
* Tax and Statutory Compliance: Ensure timely and accurate VAT and Corporate Tax filings, statutory submissions, and tax payments.
* Internal Controls and Audit: Minimise audit findings, close corrective actions, strengthen internal controls, and ensure compliance with group policies.
* Commercial Finance: Improve gross margins, control costs, support pricing decisions, and monitor the profitability of key customers, contracts, and projects.
* Process Improvement: Drive automation, reduce manual reporting, improve process efficiency, and enhance reporting timelines.
* Team Development: Enhance team performance, develop capabilities, support succession planning, and improve stakeholder satisfaction.

**Minimum Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting or a related discipline.
* Professional qualification such as ACCA, ACA, CPA, CIMA, or an equivalent recognized accounting qualification is strongly preferred. • Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar role, with at least 10 years of overall experience in Finance & Accounting (F&A).
* Demonstrated experience managing financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, cash flow, tax compliance, internal controls, and statutory audits.

* Excellent communication skills to demonstrate collaborations with various groups as and when required.

* **Automated Test Script Generation:** Leverage Generative AI and LLM-powered pipelines to automate the creation, synthesis, and maintenance of standardized regulatory test scripts, validation rules.

* **Control, Risk & Governance:** Ensure all data science and AI applications comply with Citi Model Risk Management (MRM), Responsible AI guidelines, and data governance policies. Appropriately assess risk when developing solutions, ensuring transparent escalation and adherence to all supervisory standards.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in QATV by managing expectations and ensuring alignment on project goals and deliverables. Communicate project status, risks, and issues to stakeholders timely manner
* **Team Player & Mentor:** Provide technical leadership and guidance to junior team members. Mentor and coach team members on best practices in data analysis, reporting, and data infrastructure management

* Work experience: 8+ years with Masters as Educational background

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and quantify opportunities for improvement.

* Programming & ML Frameworks: Strong programming skills in Python with proficiency in data science and ML libraries (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Transformers).

* Generative AI & LLMs: Hands-on experience developing GenAI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Chroma, Milvus), and API integration.

* Agentic Frameworks & MLOps: Practical exposure to agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or AutoGen, along with foundational knowledge of MLOps and model deployment pipelines.

* Data Engineering & SQL: Advanced SQL skills with experience querying, manipulating, and transforming large datasets from relational databases and testing data marts (e.g., Oracle, Snowflake, PostgreSQL).

* Data Visualization & BI: Experience building interactive analytics dashboards using Tableau or Power BI.

* Banking Knowledge: Good understanding of the banking domain, banking products and Operations in banking is preferred.

* Soft Skills: Ability to multi-task effectively and efficiently in a fast-paced environment. Excellent interpersonal skills and a positive, proactive attitude. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

jobs.title: Corporate Credit Underwriter - Senior Vice President
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

Whether you’re at the start of your career or looking to discover your next adventure, your story begins here. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your skills and make a difference at one of the world’s most global banks. We’re fully committed to supporting your growth and development from the start with extensive on-the-job training and exposure to senior leaders, as well as more traditional learning. You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact where we live and work through volunteerism.

Citi continues to enhance its business control and governance framework by building out Institutional Credit Management (ICM), a first line of defense business line, to house and consistently manage credit risk activities performed for Citi’s institutional clients. ICM’s objective is to provide integrated end-to-end credit underwriting, identification, measurement, management, and monitoring for wholesale credit across the enterprise.

Within ICM, the Credit Underwriting function (“ICM UW” or “UW”) provides credit analysis, underwriting, and first line of defense credit approval for periodic / material transaction reviews, and any necessary subsequent credit monitoring across all institutional business including Corporate Banking, Services, and Markets relationships.

ICM Underwriters manage a portfolio of relationships, being responsible for the continuous monitoring of that portfolio. That includes the production of annual reviews, quarterly reviews, and the support of ad-hoc transactions and portfolio & industry reviews and stress testing, in partnership with Business and Risk.

**In this role, you’re expected to:**

Executes, aligned with global and regional strategies, all responsibilities regarding underwriting, including, but not limited to:

* Adoption of leading practices in credit analysis, underwriting, and monitoring, including the end-to-end underwriting process, from early origination discussions to development of credit approval memos, and senior approval forums

* Detailed review of financial analysis, due diligence, projection modeling, stress testing, risk ratings and other in-depth analysis performed by junior resources

* Review and approval of Credit Approval Memos (CAM) packages

* Partner with Front Office on structuring and production of term sheet for new transactions

* Facilitate relationships with key clients in Banking and Risk and with key Regulators, Internal Audit, and control functions

* Support ICM Underwriting organization on strategic initiatives / projects as required

**Risk Management Experience:**

* Senior credit approval authority covering large and complex underwritings, capital commitments, derivatives with multi-industry experience
* Experience in and exposure to global credit risk management standards
* Ability to understand capital markets products and complex financing and product structures
* Ability to provide strategic insights and strong sensitivity to macro and regulatory issues
* Able to discuss and address issues associated with the allocation of risk assets and risk capital in partnership with banking and product organizations

**Client Relationships / Business Partnership:**

* Proven ability to understand nuances of local markets, local regulation, and the capabilities and practices of competitors
* Navigates organizational complexity and breaks silos
* Creates and sustains a network of strong partnerships with the business in all segments geographies and other risk functions
* Provides well-reasoned, balanced assessments of risk/return trade-offs associated with transactions and client relationships
* Proven track record of partnering with global peers in leveraging and implementation of best practices

* 12+ years risk/risk-related credit work experience in banking/financial institutions
* Proven ability to effectively engage with regulators and internal control functions including Internal Audit and Fundamental Credit Risk as well as with external audit
* Demonstrates strong ethics and integrity
* Ability to see the ‘big picture’ in a complex environment
* Can make decisions under pressure and short timeline

Date live: 11/23/2026

Business Area: Global Payment Services

Area of Expertise: Change

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000124725

  

At Barclays, we don’t just adapt to the future – we create it. Embark on a transformative journey as a Business Analyst-VP, where you’ll primarily responsible for Requirement analysis and specification through to data analysis co-relating client, business and colleagues (operations) impact and experience. The delivery focused role will work closely with the project and business stakeholders to ensure smooth change management.

**To be successful in this role, you should have experience with:**

* Own and manage requirement related aspects of the change delivery life cycle from inception, solution design through to implementation and post implementation support.
* Provision of subject matter expertise to support the collaboration between the product owner and the technical side of product development.
* Work in-line with overall Barclays strategy across Technology delivery and Business operations change.
* Identify, quantify, plan and control all business design and analysis related activity on change projects.
* Identify, analyze, manage and monitor relationships with and between stakeholders.
* Manage multiple work streams of project activity.
* Requirements elicitation and documentation, using User Stories, including responsibilities of similar deliverables of fellow BA team members.
* End-to-end requirements management and traceability, both functional and non-functional.

**Some of Highly Valued Skills may include:**

* Has ability to investigate, analyze, visualize, articulate and solve complex problems and concepts and make disciplined decisions based on available information.
* Can identify and explores opportunities for service and business improvement.
* Practitioner of agile methodology and how to apply the agile mindset to all aspects of their work.
* Has ability to identify and pinpoint business opportunities to allow organizations to perform more effectively.
* Exposure to toolsets across Requirements documentation, Configuration Management and Quality assurance.
* Experience in Bookkeeping, Accounting, General Ledger and periodic Deposit and Loans interest calculation processes.
* Experience in Tools that are used for Capturing Requirements in Agile(Jira, Rally etc.) and Confluence.
* Ability to understand the requirements and communicate /disseminate the same effectively to multiple stakeholders.
* Previous experience on projects having Liquidity Management implementations.
* Experience in large scale product implementation including integration various upstream and downstream applications in Bank’s estate using various communication protocols.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

The location of the role is Pune, IN

**Purpose of the role**

To collaborate with product owners and other technical teams involved in the product development process and utilise their knowledge of the bank’s technologies to enact the vision defined in the product roadmap.

**Accountabilities**

* Provision of subject matter expertise to support the collaboration between the product owner and the technical side of product development.
* Support the development and implementation of the product strategy and vision defined in the product roadmap and communicate them with the relevant stakeholders and the development team.
* Collaboration with internal stakeholders to gather and prioritise product requirements and features based on business value and feasibility that are well defined, measurable and secure.
* Development and implementation of assessments to ensure continuous testing and improvement of product quality and performance.
* Monitoring of product performance to identify opportunities for optimisation that meets the banks performance standards.
* Stay abreast of the latest industry technology trends and technologies, to evaluate and adopt new approaches to improve product development and delivery.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the India Demat Team within India International Wealth and Premier Banking as Assistant Vice President – Demat Operations.

  

**Role Purpose**

  

The role holder will manage end-to-end depository participant operations within a regulated bank environment, encompassing demat account opening and servicing, settlement monitoring, reconciliations, income and DP charge controls, and regulatory reporting. The role will ensure accurate and timely execution in accordance with applicable SEBI requirements, NSDL/CDSL rules and bye-laws, PMLA, and HSBC policies and operating procedures.

  

The incumbent will drive operational efficiency and customer service quality across retail and corporate/institutional DP services, maintain robust risk and control standards, manage audit and regulatory review requirements, and implement regulatory and system changes within prescribed timelines.

  

**Principal Accountabilities**

* + Oversee demat account opening, modification, servicing and closure, including verification of client documentation and KYC/AML requirements, periodic account reviews, and corporate demat requests.
  + Ensure accurate and timely processing of dematerialisation and rematerialisation requests (DRF/RRF), Delivery Instruction Slips (DIS), pledge, un-pledge and invocation requests, and off-market and inter-depository transfers.
  + Monitor settlement cycles and ensure timely reconciliation with depositories and clearing corporations.
  + Oversee daily, weekly and monthly reconciliations of client holdings, DP balances, suspense accounts and control accounts; investigate and resolve reconciliation breaks.
  + Manage provisioning of income entries and reconciliation of DP charges in coordination with Finance/Accounts.
  + Prepare and submit regulatory and depository reports within prescribed timelines and maintain accurate MIS for management review and compliance oversight.

**Customers / Stakeholders**

  + Liaise with NSDL/CDSL, registrars and transfer agents (RTAs), Finance/Accounts, Compliance and other internal stakeholders to resolve servicing and operational matters.
  + Drive customer-centric improvements in turnaround time and service quality across retail and corporate/institutional DP services.
  + Act as the principal contact for Demat operational and regulatory matters across Operations, Compliance, Legal, Technology, Risk, Finance, Treasury, the business and relevant depositories.
  + Coordinate responses to regulatory queries, inspections, internal and external audits, and compliance reviews.
  + Drive cross-functional actions independently, secure clear ownership and deliver within agreed timelines.
  + Provide concise management reporting on key operational risks, regulatory actions, exceptions and outstanding deliverables.
  + Promote disciplined execution, clear accountability and strong collaboration across first- and second-line stakeholders.

* **Leadership and Teamwork**
  

* + Demonstrate ownership and accountability for assigned DP operations and coordinate with stakeholders to meet operational, regulatory and audit deadlines.
  + Work collaboratively with branches, service teams, Compliance, Finance and Technology on regulatory implementation, escalations and process changes.

* **Operational Effectiveness & Control**
  

* Conduct periodic process and control reviews to identify operational and regulatory risks.
* Own audit and inspection observations, agree remediation plans and ensure timely, evidenced closure.
* Monitor implementation of regulatory and product changes and confirm that required controls operate effectively.
* Proactively identify and escalate material operational, regulatory, conduct or control risks.
* Regulatory and business deliverables completed within prescribed timelines.
* Timely and sustainable closure of audit, inspection, compliance and control actions.
* Accuracy and completeness of regulatory trackers, governance records, evidence and management information.
* Reduction in repeat exceptions, overdue actions and material control gaps.
* Effective implementation of regulatory, product and process changes with appropriate documentation and stakeholder sign-off.
* Positive stakeholder feedback and effective escalation of material risks.
* Identify opportunities for automation and digitisation to reduce manual intervention and operational errors.
* Track new and revised regulatory and depository circulars and implement required process and control changes within defined timelines.
* Identify operational risks and ensure adherence to maker-checker controls, segregation of duties, standard operating procedures and HSBC operational risk frameworks.
* Monitor exceptions, failed transactions and reconciliation breaks, ensuring timely resolution and escalation of control issues.
* Strengthen controls over DIS usage, fraud prevention and unauthorised transactions, and maintain adherence to applicable KYC/AML, PMLA and depository requirements.
* Manage internal and concurrent audits, compliance inspections and regulatory reviews relating to DP operations; ensure closure of observations within stipulated timelines.
* Maintain HSBC internal control standards and ensure timely implementation of actions arising from audits and regulatory reviews.
  

This specialist role requiring independent judgement, strong execution discipline and the ability to influence senior and cross-functional stakeholders. The role holder will operate within approved product programmes, HSBC policies, procedures and governance standards, escalating matters outside delegated authority or risk appetite.

The role holder will maintain HSBC internal control standards, comply with relevant Group and local policies and procedures, and ensure timely implementation and closure of internal and external audit points and issues raised by regulators, Compliance or Risk.

* 4–10 years of experience in DP operations, custody operations or capital markets operations within a bank, brokerage or financial institution, with hands-on experience of NSDL/

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Significant experience in financial services, with a background in operations, finance, program management, data analytics, or business analysis, and demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional delivery across business and Technology stakeholders.

* Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think strategically and connect detailed analysis to broader business objectives, including translating complex investigations into executive-ready options and recommendations.
* Proficiency in manipulating and analyzing large data sets using Excel (pivots, formulas, charts) and other data tools to validate issues, quantify impact, and evidence remediation effectiveness.
* Exceptional communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with experience engaging senior stakeholders across business and technology, including chairing working groups and contributing to senior steering forums.
* Self-starter with strong time management and organizational skills; adept at managing multiple priorities and delivering high-quality outcomes under pressure while operating with strong risk discipline and attention to controls.
* Deep understanding of business practices and products within the Commercial & Investment Bank, with a focus on Markets.
* AI/LLM experience (required): demonstrated experience using AI/LLM tools to improve productivity in data quality and data lineage documentation, analysis, and/or control design, with strong judgment around confidentiality, appropriate use, and required human review/validation.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Expertise in data quality, data lineage, metadata management, and data control concepts, including standards and control frameworks.
* Experience in a Chief Data Office or Data Quality organization within an investment bank or large financial institution.
* Proficiency in querying databases or data stores for advanced data analysis.
* Skilled in producing executive-level PowerPoint presentations for senior audiences.
* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks such as BCBS 239 and industry best practices in data management, and ability to translate regulatory expectations into practical data quality, data lineage, and control outcomes.

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. jobs.title: Corporate Credit Underwriter - Commodities - Senior Vice President
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

Whether you’re at the start of your career or looking to discover your next adventure, your story begins here. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your skills and make a difference at one of the world’s most global banks. We’re fully committed to supporting your growth and development from the start with extensive on-the-job training and exposure to senior leaders, as well as more traditional learning. You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact where we live and work through volunteerism.

  
  

Citi continues to enhance its business control and governance framework by building out Institutional Credit Management (ICM), a first line of defense business line, to house and consistently manage credit risk activities performed for Citi’s institutional clients. ICM’s objective is to provide integrated end-to-end credit underwriting, identification, measurement, management, and monitoring for wholesale credit across the enterprise. Within ICM, the Credit Underwriting function (“ICM UW” or “UW”) provides credit analysis, underwriting, and first line of defense credit approval for periodic / material transaction reviews, and any necessary subsequent credit monitoring across all institutional business including Corporate Banking, Services, and Markets relationships.

  
  

ICM Underwriters manage a portfolio of relationships, being responsible for the continuous monitoring of that portfolio. That includes the production of annual reviews, quarterly reviews, and the support of ad-hoc transactions and portfolio & industry reviews and stress testing, in partnership with Business and Risk.

The successful candidate will join the Commodities Underwriting team and will manage a group of junior analysts based in Mumbai who support Underwriters in London. The Commodities Underwriting team is responsible for the coverage of commodity traders as well as clients from other commodity related industries globally.

**In this role, you’re expected to:**

  
  

Executes, aligned with global and regional strategies, all responsibilities regarding underwriting, including, but not limited to:

  
  

* Maintains underwriting coverage of an existing portfolio of clients while supporting the underwriting of prospective commodities managed clients (CMC); the geographical coverage will include companies from Europe and Asia.
* Manage a team of 4/5 junior analysts in Mumbai by focusing on talent development, workflow management, and performance evaluations.
* Adoption of leading practices in credit analysis, underwriting, and monitoring, including the end-to-end underwriting process, from early origination discussions to development of credit approval memos, and senior approval forums.
* Detailed review of financial analysis, due diligence, projection modeling, stress testing, risk ratings and other in-depth analysis performed by junior resources.
* Review and approval of Credit Approval Memos (CAM) packages for monitoring or transaction purposes.
* Partner with Front Office on structuring and production of term sheets for new transactions.
* Partners with Legal in the negotiation of credit terms related to trading documentation (such as ISDA, EFET and other trading documents).
* Facilitate relationships with key clients in Banking and Risk and other control functions.
* Support ICM Underwriting organization on strategic initiatives / projects as required.

**Risk Management Experience:**

  
  

* Senior credit approval authority covering large and complex underwritings, capital commitments, derivatives with multi-industry experience.
* Ability to work independently, demonstrated credit judgement and experience navigating risk policies.
* Experience in and exposure to global credit risk management standards.
* Ability to understand capital markets products and complex financing and product structures including derivatives.
* Ability to provide strategic insights and strong sensitivity to macro and regulatory issues.
* Able to discuss and address issues associated with the allocation of risk assets and risk capital in partnership with banking and product organizations.

**Client Relationships / Business Partnership:**

  
  

* Proven ability to understand nuances of local markets, local regulation, and the capabilities and practices of competitors
* Navigates organizational complexity and breaks silos
* Creates and sustains a network of strong partnerships with the business in all segments, geographies and other risk functions
* Provides well-reasoned, balanced assessments of risk/return trade-offs associated with transactions and client relationships
* Proven track record of partnering with global peers in leveraging and implementation of best practices

**As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:**

  
  

* Around 13+ years risk/risk-related credit work experience in banking/financial institutions or a commodity trader.
* Proven ability to effectively engage with Senior Credit Officers.
* Prior experience in managing a small team is preferred.
* Demonstrates strong ethics and integrity.
* Ability to see the ‘big picture’ in a complex environment.
* Can make decisions under pressure and short timeline.
* Excellent verbal & written communication skills. Active listening skills.
* Excellent presentation skills – adept at presenting effectively to audiences of various sizes and various constituencies.
  

  

**Education:**

  
  

* Bachelor’s/University degree, Master’s degree preferred.
  

This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

  

* Working Environment: office setting, minimal travel required.
* Effort: minimal physical effort required.

* Own the product roadmap and backlog for retail and/or SME digital banking journeys.

* Experience working with Agile delivery teams and translating business and regulatory requirements into features, user stories and acceptance criteria.

* Experience using customer and product performance data to improve live services.
* Experience with Islamic banking products, Sharia governance or digital banking delivery in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC would be advantageous.

jobs.description:
Are you looking for the next professional opportunity that will challenge you and advance your career? Join our team now!

**Tickmill**
is expanding its
**Exchange-Traded Products**
offering, starting with
**Stocks and ETFs**
. We are looking for an experienced
**Head of Product, Exchange-Traded Products**
to drive this strategic initiative and help shape the future of investing products across our platforms.

You will own the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery for
**Stocks & Exchange-Traded Products**
, working closely with Technology, Brokerage, Operations, Compliance, Legal, Sales, Marketing, and Affiliate teams. This role requires a strong understanding of both trading products and retail brokerage operations.

**About Tickmill**

Founded in 2014, Tickmill has grown into a global financial services group of 300+ people, with regulated entities across major jurisdictions and a client base built on trust in active trading, spanning CFDs, Futures and Options.

That foundation: capital, licensing, infrastructure and an established international client base ,is what makes the next stage possible: building genuinely new product lines in Stocks, ETFs, Investing, Wealth and Prediction Markets, aimed at a much larger consumer audience than our existing trading business alone.

**What the job looks like?**

The
**Head of Product, Exchange-Traded Products**
will have the opportunity to:

* Own and drive the expansion of Tickmill's Stocks & Exchange-Traded Products offering to make it a leading product in line with the other major players in the market
* Have accountability of the P&L and success of the product alongside the business manager
* Define product strategy, roadmap, and business objectives for Stocks and related investment products.
* Lead the trading experience across web and mobile platforms, including market data, order management, portfolio views, reporting, and corporate actions.
* Partner with Engineering, UX/UI designers, QA, Compliance, Brokerage, Operations, Sales, Marketing, and Affiliates teams to deliver products from concept to market.
* Define and prioritize features based on customer needs, regulatory requirements, technical feasibility, and business objectives.
* Work closely with exchanges, market data providers, clearing brokers, custodians, and technology vendors.
* Help define scalable operating models that balance global consistency with local market requirements.
* Support acquisition, activation, retention, and engagement initiatives in partnership with Sales, Marketing, Affiliates, and Partnerships teams.
* Establish KPIs and continuously optimize client adoption, trading activity, and commercial performance.
* Champion a simple, intuitive, and mobile-first investing experience.

**What will you need to be able to do the job?**

* 7+ years of Product Management experience.
* 3+ years building or managing Stocks, ETFs, Equities, or other Exchange-Traded Products within a brokerage, investment platform, exchange, or fintech environment.
* Strong understanding of equities market structure, order management, execution, settlement, custody, market data, corporate actions, and retail brokerage operations.
* Proved experience in launching and leading a similar product in regulated markets within an established brokerage group.
* Previous accountability of a product’s success with clearly defined KPI’s
* Experience designing, optimizing, or supporting affiliate, referral, introducing broker (IB), and partner acquisition journeys.
* Proven ability to design and optimize customer journeys, onboarding experiences, and product UX using customer insights, analytics, and experimentation.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives.
* Strong technical fluency and ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
* Experience working with providers such as Interactive Brokers, Saxo, DriveWealth, Apex, Alpaca or similar platforms is considered an advantage.

**By joining us, you can expect:**

* A Unique Opportunity for a career in a global, fast-growing company.
* Attractive remuneration package based on qualifications and experience.
* Opportunities to learn and grow through our "Employee Training & Development Program".
* Health Insurance.
* Multiple events to bond with the team and the group.
* Birthday and Loyalty benefits.

**What to expect from our recruitment process:**

1. First interview with HR.
2. Product and stakeholder management interview.
3. Final interview with top management.

Make your next career step and apply NOW!

Credit & Capital Management Services (CCMS) under CIB are in the process of implementing a new, modern, and consistent E2E operating model. The BCO function will complete tasks currently owned by multiple actors in the management of the first line credit risk responsibilities including structuring, credit analysis and rating recommendation, client credit monitoring tasks, credit terms and document negotiation and clients acting as a single handoff from a RM to the BCO for all Credit & Lending (C&L) tasks, creating a single control point. * Combine client relationship management with strong risk assessment and management capabilities ensuring the required credit quality & requisite returns on risk
* Responsible for the delivery of BCO tasks in line with agreed OKRs, SLAs and KPIs

• Own the end-to-end Credit & Lending servicing journey, ensuring a seamless and efficient process for customers and internal stakeholders• Participate in deal discussions and meetings with clients or credit risk

* Work with the BCO Team Lead to ensure adequate credit risk management controls are built into the operational process and robust MI is in place to track and measure risk against agreed thresholds

* Adopt technology and customer experience improvement initiatives, including alignment to a globally consistent C&L operating model and active participation in training initiatives

* Proven expertise in corporate lending with strong analytical skills
* Must possess sound credit knowledge with proven skills of writing credit proposals
* Strong understanding of financing instruments and banking products for Wholesale Banking
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex situations and drive alignment among senior leaders
* Tenacious with numbers – aptitude for analyzing and interpreting data.
* A trust earner – can listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
* Committed to quality – high standards for work, solve problems so they are fixed and stay fixed.

is a Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products that help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and access suitable loans and credit cards - the major financial needs of middle-income consumers living paycheck to paycheck.

Bright is a profitable, India-built, U.S.-market Consumer FinTech, with a revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 6 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with financial services marketplace revenue from loans, credit cards, and credit-building tools.

Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI-driven Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers.

The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B.

Bright is backed by three top global venture capital firms and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia.

Bright was established in 2019 by a leadership team drawn from McKinsey’s Banking Practice (Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava) and InMobi’s Data Sciences organisation (Varun Modi and Avi Patchava). The core team is ex-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, joined more recently by senior leaders from McKinsey. Bright has a data-driven, fast-paced execution culture, and is building a global Consumer FinTech with all functions operating from India.

**What is the role about?**

Bright is looking for a Director - Engineering to lead and scale a core part of our engineering organisation in Bengaluru, reporting to the CTO. You will own delivery and technical direction for the systems behind Bright’s consumer app, credit decisioning, and AI products, and you will build the leadership layer that runs them.

This is a leader-of-leaders role. You will manage engineering managers and leads, shape architecture and platform strategy for your area within the CTO’s technical direction, own headcount, budget, and cloud spend for your teams, and partner with Product, Data Sciences, and the wider leadership team on what gets built next.

Bright is profitable, scaling fast in the U.S. market, and building AI into both the product and how the company runs. The systems are distributed, data-heavy, and carry real money and credit decisions, so engineering quality is a business outcome here, not an internal metric.

**What will you do?**

* Lead your organisation: Own and scale a multi-team group, with engineering managers and leads reporting to you; set the operating rhythm, standards, and performance bar across your teams.
* Build the leadership layer: Hire, coach, and retain senior engineers, leads, and managers, and develop the next line of engineering leadership beneath you.
* Technical strategy: Shape and execute architecture and platform strategy across services, data, and developer tooling for your area, in line with the CTO’s technical direction, and make the build-versus-buy and platformisation calls that shape how fast your teams can ship.
* Delivery at scale: Own end-to-end delivery of distributed, data-heavy systems - roadmap commitments, release predictability, and the trade-offs between speed and durability.
* Reliability & risk: Own availability, performance, security, and the engineering side of compliance obligations for the systems your teams run in a U.S. consumer-lending business.
* AI & ML in production: Partner with Data Sciences to productionise ML and Gen AI systems-serving, monitoring, and retraining - and raise engineering leverage through AI tooling across the org.
* Cross-functional leadership: Partner with Product, Data Sciences, Infrastructure, and business teams on priorities, sequencing, and the commitments engineering makes to them.
* Planning & budget: Own annual and quarterly planning for your area - headcount, vendor decisions, cloud cost and TCO, and the resourcing choices behind them.
* Reporting & visibility: Report clearly to the CTO and the wider leadership team on progress, risk, capacity, and investment, and contribute to leadership reviews as needed.

**Ideal candidate profile**

**Experience & Background:**

* Experience: 12+ years in engineering, with 5+ years in engineering leadership and at least 2 years managing managers or leads.
* Organisation scale: Has led a multi-team group of 20+ engineers, and has grown a team through a period of rapid scaling.
* Systems depth: Deep hands-on background in distributed, high-throughput, data-heavy systems; still able to go deep in a design review and hold a credible technical argument.
* Architecture & platform: Proven ownership of architecture, platformisation, and developer tooling, with evidence of the delivery gains those investments produced.
* ML & AI in production: Experience productionising ML or Gen AI systems in partnership with data science teams.
* Commercial ownership: Experience owning engineering budgets, cloud cost and TCO, vendor decisions, and resource planning.
* Hiring record: A strong track record of hiring and developing senior engineers and engineering managers.
* Domain: Experience in fintech, payments, lending, or another regulated, high-reliability consumer business is a strong plus.
* Location: Based in Bengaluru, or willing to relocate.

**Mindset & Operating DNA:**

* Ownership: Takes accountability for outcomes beyond their own remit, not only for their teams’ deliverables.
* Technical credibility: Earns the respect of senior engineers through judgment and depth, not position.
* Strategic thinking: Connects technical choices to business outcomes and can defend the trade-offs to a non-technical audience.
* Builder of leaders: Measures success by the strength of the managers and engineers they develop.
* Pace: Thrives in a high-growth environment where structure is still being built, and brings clarity rather than waiting for it.

**Non-Fit Profiles**

* Individual contributors or architects without sustained people-leadership experience.
* Managers who have led a single team, without experience managing managers or leading a group through scale.
* Leaders who have moved fully away from technical depth and cannot hold their own in architecture and design discussions.
* Candidates from large, process-heavy environments who need established structure, and are uncomfortable in a fast-moving, ambiguous setting.
* Delivery or programme managers without hands-on engineering ownership.

**What Bright Offers?**

* A profitable sub-unicorn with U.S. market scale - liquidity potential at $1-3B valuations.
* Real ownership: You own delivery and technical direction for a core part of the platform, with a direct line to the CTO.
* Wealth creation: Equity at an inflection stage of scale.
* A data-driven, high-cadence culture that combines consulting rigor with FinTech speed.
* Benefits: Excellent benefits package in line with sector best practice.

jobs.description:
Job Purpose
  
• Manage portfolio risk strategy and performance management for unsecured retail assets, including credit cards, personal loans, BNPL and other digital lending products.
  
• Own the end-to-end risk decision framework across acquisition, account management, line assignment, pricing, collections and customer lifecycle management.
  
• Use advanced analytics, segmentation and AI/ML models to optimize growth, credit quality, customer outcomes and risk-adjusted profitability.
  
• Provide the senior leadership team with forward-looking portfolio insights, clear risk appetite recommendations and timely actions to maintain losses, returns and capital consumption within plan.
  
  
Key Result Areas
  
• Set and execute portfolio strategies for credit cards, personal loans, BNPL and emerging digital credit propositions, aligned with approved risk appetite, growth plans and regulatory requirements.
  
• Own portfolio performance across approval rates, activation, utilization, balances, yield, delinquencies, roll rates, loss rates, risk charge, vintage performance, expected credit loss, capital and risk-adjusted returns.
  
• Develop granular customer, product, channel, employer, income and behavioral segmentation to identify growth pockets, emerging risks and differentiated treatment strategies.
  
• Design and govern risk decision frameworks covering eligibility, score cut-offs, affordability, limits, tenor, pricing, line management, cross-sell, collections and exit strategies.
  
• Lead champion–challenger tests and controlled experiments; define success metrics, guardrails and post-implementation monitoring to scale profitable strategies safely.
  
• Partner with data science teams to develop, validate and deploy application, behavioral, propensity, fraud and early-warning models using traditional and alternative data.
  
• Establish responsible AI and model governance, including explainability, fairness, drift, stability, override, monitoring and human-oversight standards.
  
• Build executive dashboards, forecasts and scenario analyses linking risk drivers to revenue, margin, credit cost, operating expense, capital and lifetime customer profitability.
  
• Define early-warning indicators, portfolio triggers and remediation playbooks for adverse trends, concentration risks and macroeconomic or market shocks.
  
• Provide independent retail credit risk challenge for new products, partnerships, fintech propositions and material changes to customer journeys or decision engines.
  
• Ensure compliance with Central Bank requirements, internal policies, model risk standards, consumer protection expectations and audit requirements.
  
• Lead, coach and develop a high-performing portfolio analytics team and strengthen data-driven decision making across Retail Banking.
  
  
Knowledge, Skills and Experience
  
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science or a related quantitative discipline; postgraduate qualification is preferred.
  
• Experience: Typically 12–15 years in retail credit risk, portfolio management or risk analytics, including substantial leadership responsibility and direct exposure to credit cards, personal loans and digital lending/BNPL.
  
• Portfolio expertise: Proven ownership of acquisition and account-management strategies, vintages, roll rates, delinquency, loss forecasting, provisions, risk-adjusted profitability, limit management, collections strategies and portfolio optimization.
  
• Analytics and modeling: Strong command of statistical analysis, experimentation, segmentation, forecasting, scorecards and AI/ML applications across underwriting, behavioral risk, propensity, fraud and early warning.
  
• Technical capability: Hands-on proficiency in SQL and at least one analytical language such as Python, R or SAS; strong working knowledge of Power BI/Tableau, large datasets, data pipelines and cloud analytics environments.
  
• Decision frameworks: Demonstrated ability to translate analytics into executable cut-offs, pricing, limits, treatments and growth strategies with clear economics, controls and performance measurement.
  
• Governance: Sound understanding of model risk, responsible AI, explainability, fairness, data privacy, consumer protection, IFRS 9/provisioning concepts and Central Bank requirements relevant to retail lending.
  
• Leadership: Strong executive communication, stakeholder influence and people leadership, with the ability to challenge constructively and present complex risk-return choices to senior committees.

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.description:
The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) is responsible for establishing, implementing, operating, monitoring, and continuously enhancing OneFin’s Information Security Management System (ISMS) across all product lines and enterprise infrastructure.

This leader will own end-to-end information security strategy, cloud security governance (AWS), regulatory compliance (RBI guidelines for digital lending and IT governance), ISO/IEC 27001:2022 standards, and client-facing security assessments for institutional banking partners. Implement zero trust security architecture.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Information Security Governance & Strategy**

* Define, maintain, and enforce OneFin's Level-1 ISMS policies, standards, and guidelines in alignment with business goals.
* Report security posture, risk profiles, and incident metrics directly to the CEO, C-suite, and Board of Directors.
* Lead the annual risk assessment framework across all business units, maintaining the enterprise Risk Register and tracking remediation strategies.
* Establish annual security objectives, measurable parameters, and operational security targets.

**2. Regulatory, Compliance & Client Audit Management**

* Direct compliance for ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certifications, surveillance audits, and internal security audits.
* Ensure strict adherence to Reserve Bank of India (RBI) guidelines regarding digital lending, data localization, outsourcing, and cloud management.
* Act as the executive point of contact for financial institution (FI) client audits, managing Information Security Group (ISG) checklists, VAPT review points, and security questionnaires.
* Oversee Data Protection and Privacy compliance, protecting Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and Sensitive Personal Data or Information (SPDI).
* Oversee source code audits, and conduct internal security audits of codebase.

**3. Cloud Infrastructure & Product Security**

* Oversee security configuration across AWS environments, ensuring AES-256 encryption at rest (S3, RDS, ECR) and enforced TLS/HTTPS in transit.
* Enforce secure architecture models for single-tenant / dedicated client deployments on Financial Institution AWS infrastructure.
* Direct Web Application Firewall (WAF) policies, IP/URL whitelisting, geo-blocking, and network perimeter controls.
* Maintain DevSecOps rigor within CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), ensuring automated peer reviews, static analysis, code coverage thresholds, and container image vulnerability management.

**4. Threat Management & Security Operations (SecOps)**

* Lead the Incident Response Team; ensure end-to-end management, SLA tracking, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for all P1/Critical incidents.
* Oversee centralized logging, Database Activity Monitoring (DAM), and integration capabilities with Bank SIEM systems.
* Mandate periodic Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT) across applications, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
* Enforce robust Access Control & Identity Management (IAM), including mandatory multi-factor authentication (MFA) across email, code repositories, and cloud portals.

**5. Third-Party Risk & Business Continuity**

* Enforce Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) guidelines, ensuring mandatory MSAs and NDAs across all vendors.
* Manage annual Business Continuity Planning (BCP) and Disaster Recovery (DR) drills, validating Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).
* Conduct annual enterprise-wide security awareness training programs and specialized DevSecOps workshops.

**Candidate Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related engineering fields.
* **Experience:** 12+ years in Information Security and Technology Risk, with at least 4+ years in a leadership role (CISO, Head of Security, or Director of InfoSec).
* **Domain Background:** Prior experience in Fintech, B2B SaaS, Banking, or Financial Services ecosystems is strictly required.

**Technical & Professional Competencies**

**Cloud Security**- Deep expertise in AWS Security Hub, WAF, KMS, CloudTrail, IAM, RDS/S3 encryption, and containerized deployments (ECS/ECR).

**Frameworks**- Hands-on mastery of ISO/IEC 27001:2022, NIST CSF, OWASP Top 10, and SOC 2 Type II compliance.

**Regulatory Knowledge**- In depth knowledge of RBI Cybersecurity Framework, RBI Digital Lending Directions, and Indian Data Protection laws.

**Application Security**- Expertise in DevSecOps, API security, automated code scanners, tesseract/OCR pipeline security, and LLM/AI model deployment governance.

**Leadership**- Exceptional stakeholder management, board-level reporting, and experience negotiating security requirements with Tier-1 Bank CISOs.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
* Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
* Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
* ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor / Lead Implementer
