**Job Description:**
--------------------

**About Us :-**

*In a short span of 2.5 years since inception, Birla Pivot has evolved into a comprehensive B2B e-commerce platform offering integrated procurement and financial solutions that help businesses become efficient and grow. We offer products across 35 categories, 40,000+SKUs from 300+ brands across* ***Building Material, Chemicals & Metals****. We launched private labels in 3 categories : Tiles, Ply and Bath ware. With a robust network of suppliers and transporters, we have delivered to 4,000+ pin codes across 375 cities. Our customer base now spans top-tier EPC companies, civil contractors, real estate developers, OEMs, fabricators, manufacturing companies, dealers, and retailers. We connect Sellers, Buyers, Logistics service providers, Lending partners, Payment solution providers on a unified digital backbone thereby creating end to end visibility and providing a B2C like fulfilment experience for the B2B ecosystem.*

*The evolution of B2B ecommerce is expected to mirror the B2C ecommerce journey, where technology transformed discovery, pricing, fulfilment, and customer experience at scale. Digital penetration today in B2B ecommerce is still under* ***2%****, indicating massive headroom for scalable digital-first platforms. As the Aditya Birla Group, we are uniquely positioned to transform and shape the way commerce is done across these verticals by leveraging our deep industry expertise and scale. We have built a unique Quote based, Credit linked commerce journey that solves for the needs of B2B commerce with a diverse team that is a mix of deep industry expertise and experience of building complex technology platforms from the ground up. Our goal is to drive this digital adoption and create a distribution platform that can become* ***the most trusted B2B ecommerce platform in the country.***
  
  
***Why is this role exciting?***
  
  
***As our Security Engineer, you are the single hands-on owner of security operations and governance for Birla Pivot's cloud native B2B commerce platform —keeping every security KRI Green and closing audits with no major findings. In this role you get to:***
  
***?Own both sides of security —vulnerability, cloud posture, detection and access controls, and the policies, evidence and cadence that audits and the DPDP Act require.***
  
***?Shape how a high-growth business adopts AI securely, from the AI usage policy to reviews of every AI use case.***
  
***?Work closely with the Head of Cybersecurity, InfoSec & Cloud, the ABG central security team, legal and our vendors.***
  
  
***What will you do?***
  
  
***Security Operations & Incident Response***
  
  
***?Triage SIEM and EDR alerts daily; act as first responder for security incidents.***
  
***?Run incident response playbooks; prepare CERT-In reports within 6 hours of a reportable incident.***
  
***?Run tabletop exercises and post-incident reviews.***
  
  
***Vulnerability & Exposure Management***
  
***?Run vulnerability scanning across cloud, containers, code and endpoints; track remediation against SLA (Critical 7 days, High 30 days).***
  
***?Coordinate VAPT and red team engagements and drive findings to closure.***
  
***?Maintain WAF rules and virtual patching for internet-facing apps.***
  
  
***Endpoint, Patching & Resilience***
  
  
***?Keep EDR healthy on all endpoints and servers; validate patch compliance monthly.***
  
***?Verify backup restore tests and support DR drills.***
  
  
***Cloud Security (AWS)***
  
  
***?Monitor posture with Prisma Cloud, Security Hub and Prowler; fix critical misconfigurations within 72 hours.***
  
***?Review IAM, security groups, network ACLs and firewall rules weekly.***
  
***?Enforce encryption, logging, key rotation, MFA and least privilege.***
  
  
***Identity & Privileged Access***
  
  
***?Integrate IAM with the HR system for joiner-mover-leaver; disable leaver accounts within 24 hours.***
  
***?Run the monthly manager certification of off-role and contractor IDs, and quarterly access reviews.***
  
***?Onboard servers, databases and admin accounts to PAM; deploy LAPS and domain-only login.***
  
  
***ISO 27001, Policies & Audits***

***?Maintain the ISMS document set: policies, procedures, risk register, Statement of Applicability.***
  
***?Draft policy amendments for approval; keep the policy register current.***
  
***?Collect audit evidence for internal, external and ISO audits; track findings to closure.***
  
  
***Data Privacy & Vendor Risk***

***?Maintain the personal-data inventory and DPDP records with legal; implement technical controls (encryption, logging, erasure).***
  
***?Run vendor risk assessments and keep all vendor contracts in the central repository***
  
  
***Cadence, Reporting & Awareness***

***?Run the Friday SPOC and vendor ticket review; issue and close monthly, quarterly and half-yearly checklists.***
  
***?Prepare the monthly KRI pack and feed the central security dashboard (SIEM, VAPT, patching, DPDP, change, PAM).***
  
***?Publish the weekly infosec mailer; run trainings and phishing simulations.***
  
  
***AI Security & Governance***

***?Maintain the AI usage policy and the approved AI tools list —enterprise or ABG central accounts only, and no new AI initiative live without review.***
  
***?Run a security and privacy review for every AI use case: data shared, model and vendor, prompt injection, output handling, access rights.***
  
***?Detect and block unapproved AI tools through Zscaler logs; apply DLP so confidential and personal data stays out of public AI tools.***
  
***?Secure AI integrations against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications: least-privilege API keys, guardrails, logging, human approval for high-impact actions.***
  
***?Keep an AI use-case register for audit.***
  
  
***What success looks like in your first 6 months***

***?EDR coverage 98%; leaver accounts disabled within 24 hours, 100% of the time.***
  
***?No Critical vulnerability past its 7-day SLA. ?Critical log sources in SIEM with 180-day retention ( 95%).***
  
***? 95% of privileged accounts in PAM. ?Internal audit for ISO 27001 closed with no major technical findings.***
  
***?All monthly and quarterly checklists closed on time; weekly mailer running every week.***
  
***?AI usage policy published; every AI use case in the register with a completed risk review; no unapproved AI tools in use.***

***A Day In Life of a Security Engineer at Birla Pivot***

***Your day moves fast —from triaging the morning's SIEM and EDR alerts and chasing a Critical finding to closure, to fixing a cloud misconfiguration, reviewing a new AI use case with the product team, and pulling audit evidence together. At Birla Pivot, you operate at the pace of a high-growth business where every control counts.***

**What makes you a great fit?**

?3–5 years in security operations, vulnerability management or cloud security (at least 2 in cloud, AWS preferred).
  
?Hands-on AWS security: IAM, VPC, security groups, CloudTrail, GuardDuty or Security Hub, KMS.
  
?Working knowledge of SIEM, EDR, WAF and vulnerability scanners (e.g. Qualys, Prisma Cloud, Snyk).
  
?Understanding of ISO 27001 controls and audit evidence.
  
?Scripting in Python or Bash for automation.
  
?Experience preparing audit evidence, writing policies and running review cadences.
  
?Clear written communication for incident reports and audit responses

**Good to have**

?Certifications: AWS Certified Security –Specialty, CompTIA Security+, CEH, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor.
  
?Exposure to PAM (BeyondTrust, Arcon), Zscaler, Kubernetes security, DevSecOps pipelines (SAST, SCA, DAST).
  
?Knowledge of the DPDP Act 2023 and CERT-In directions.
  
?AI security: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, securing LLM APIs and AI agents.

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Global Process Owner Support (GPOS) role exists to strengthen first-line-of-defence risk management and governance across Credit Origination, Credit Monitoring and Credit Allied Risk processes within Client Coverage. It supports Global Process Owners in embedding applicable policies, standards and controls into day-to-day business activities, helping the business manage operational and process risks consistently across markets. The role delivers oversight of control effectiveness, coordinated remediation of control gaps and exceptions, and clear reporting and escalation of material risks to support informed governance decisions. Working with business, country teams and second-line stakeholders, it also supports process simplification and the implementation of change with appropriate risk assessments and controls. Its primary focus is to maintain effective, consistent and efficient credit processes that support business delivery while operating within established risk tolerances.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

The role holder is an individual contributor with no formal people-management accountability. The role leads and coordinates assigned risk, control and process-improvement activities through stakeholder collaboration, supporting the Global Process Owner / delegate and GPOS Lead across Credit Origination, Credit Monitoring and Credit Allied Risk processes. The role holder is accountable for the quality and timely delivery of assigned assessments, assurance oversight, reporting and remediation coordination; designated action owners remain responsible for completing their actions.
  
**Risk assessment and control implementation**  
• Implement applicable control requirements and procedures, and support each stage of the RCSA, from process and risk identification to monitoring implemented controls, at least annually and when trigger events occur, to maintain a current view of process and residual risks.
  
**Timely risk treatment**  
• Coordinate and track agreed elevated residual-risk actions and treatment plans with designated action owners, maintain records in the Group operational risk management system, and escalate delays to support timely completion.
  
**Learning from risk events**  
• Initiate Root Cause Reviews for in-scope material risk events and, where required, aggregate smaller events with similar root causes to identify recurring weaknesses and support corrective action.
  
**Controlled change delivery**  
• Identify delivery risks and dependencies, assess impacts on critical processes and residual risk, and review and support Operational and Change Risk Assessments and process-impact assessments before go-live, including minor changes where required.

**Broad Accountabilities**  
**Strategy**  
• Targeted Improvements: Work with internal stakeholders to identify gaps and improvement opportunities in credit processes, and lead assigned change and remediation activities to make processes more effective and streamlined.
  
• Support the GPO’s credit transformation agenda by translating agreed priorities into implementation activities and delivering assigned work within agreed timelines.
  
• Automation and Streamlining: Review operational efficiency, effectiveness and quality against changing business and customer needs, and identify actions to improve process performance.
  
• Drive continuous improvement and automation, and remove or simplify unnecessary process steps to improve efficiency and consistency across systems and processes.
  
• Support CPA Team Heads, including the CPA Hub, in improving process efficiency, simplifying processes and increasing capacity.
  
**Business**  
• Assess the process and operational-risk implications of business strategies, projects and programmes, and provide remediation guidance to support informed decisions.
  
• Support global adoption of Credit COE initiatives and work with management to implement agreed process improvements and strategic credit transformation initiatives.
  
• Maintain effective relationships with Business, Finance, Risk, Technology and Operations to resolve process issues and coordinate delivery across markets.
  
• Coordinate stakeholder inputs and supporting information for regulatory and audit requests to enable timely responses.

**Processes**  
• Support the Process Owner in delivering BAU operational-risk requirements on time and in designing and maintaining the Control Assessment Standards framework for front-office processes globally.
  
• Monitor CST/KCI exception trends and agree practical improvement actions with countries to strengthen processes and controls.
  
• Guide QC teams in GBS and countries in understanding and consistently applying checks, particularly those involving qualitative or subjective assessments.
  
• Support process governance by streamlining existing processes, rolling out new processes and resolving Credit and Credit Monitoring queries with the relevant GPOS Lead.
  
• Work with CPAs, Client Management, CPOs, R&C, Business Heads and other regional and country stakeholders to share developments, lessons and best practices, and deliver agreed requirements on time.
  
• Assess change impacts through CCIA, evaluate change readiness and perform GRAM assessments. Provide subject-matter expertise to help mitigate identified process risks.
  
• Support the resolution of Group-specific process issues and related actions identified by GIA.
  
• Support the Process Owner in promptly escalating significant risks and issues to Process Universe Owners, relevant RFOs or Policy Owners. Maintain effective relationships with 2LOD across applicable risk types to support management of the Bank’s risk profile.
  
**Risk Management**  
• Identify process risks and support implementation of the Operational Risk Framework and appropriate controls. Help operations manage risk within established tolerance thresholds and minimise risks and losses in Credit Origination.

* Identify non-standard processes and agree appropriate controls with the GPOS Lead. Review proposed process and system changes for material impacts, and keep DOIs and process documentation up to date.

• Support implementation of applicable Credit, Fraud, Climate, Reputational and Sustainability Risk policies and standards within CC COE, embedding their requirements in managed processes.
  
• Prepare updates on risk initiatives for CC Governance Committee packs, and provide subject-matter expertise for Root Cause Reviews and boundary events to support oversight and corrective action.
  
• Support the design and delivery of relevant Credit Transformation initiatives and partner with TB, FM and Lending to improve the operating model and execution through existing CC credit processes.
  
• Provide ongoing learning and guidance on policies, process risks, controls and governance. Work with 2LOD and Product partners to develop and implement a roadmap for improving the control framework.
  
• Support implementation and closure of Group-level audit Management Action Plans, and delivery of actions arising from PRA Dear CEO Letters and specific reviews relating to owned processes.
  
**Governance**  
• Ensure risks are clearly identified, quantified and reported to the appropriate governance forums, with timely visibility and escalation of material issues.
  
• Assess how effectively the control framework addresses key risks and initiate treatment plans where required. Coordinate remediation of capability, process, data and documentation gaps.
  
• Provide central oversight of CST/KCI assurance checks performed by GBS, including ongoing training and guidance, to maintain standardised and consistent assessments.

1. About Loan2grow Fincap

Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited is a growing lending and financial services company focused on providing responsible, accessible and technology-enabled credit solutions to underserved customer segments.

The company offers financing solutions across multiple customer categories and is expanding its digital lending and financial services operations.

At Loan2grow, we believe that a good customer experience is central to responsible lending. We aim to make financial services accessible, transparent and convenient through technology-enabled platforms and responsive customer support.

2. About the Role

We are looking for customer-oriented and proactive professionals to join our Customer Service & Operations team as Customer Service Executives.

The selected candidates will be responsible for handling customer queries, providing assistance throughout the loan application and servicing journey, resolving customer complaints and coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of customer issues.

The role will involve handling inbound and outbound customer calls, responding to service requests, guiding customers through digital processes and maintaining accurate records of customer interactions.

The Customer Service Executive will serve as an important point of contact between the company and its customers, ensuring that customer concerns are addressed professionally, efficiently and within defined timelines.

This is a full-time, office-based role involving regular telephone-based customer interaction and coordination with internal departments.

3. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Customer Support & Query Management

* Handle inbound and outbound customer calls relating to loan products and financial services.
* Respond to customer queries regarding loan features, eligibility, application procedures and documentation requirements.
* Provide information on loan application status, approval, disbursement and repayment schedules.
* Assist customers in understanding their loan accounts, outstanding balances, EMI obligations and payment timelines.
* Provide accurate information regarding applicable interest rates, processing fees, charges and other loan-related terms.
* Ensure that customer queries are addressed in a professional, courteous and timely manner.
* Escalate complex queries to the appropriate internal teams.

B. Loan Application & Customer Onboarding Support

* Assist prospective customers with the digital loan application process.
* Guide customers through KYC verification, documentation and other onboarding requirements.
* Help customers resolve issues related to application submission, document uploads and verification.
* Follow up on incomplete applications and pending documentation.
* Coordinate with Credit and Operations teams to track application progress.
* Keep customers informed about application status and pending requirements.
* Assist customers in navigating the company's digital platforms and applications.

C. Loan Servicing & Repayment Support

* Handle customer queries relating to loan disbursement, repayment schedules and EMI deductions.
* Assist customers with repayment-related issues, including failed transactions, incorrect deductions and payment confirmation.
* Guide customers on approved repayment channels and payment procedures.
* Coordinate with Finance and Collections teams to resolve payment reconciliation issues.
* Support customers in obtaining loan statements, repayment schedules and other account-related information.
* Track and follow up on unresolved loan servicing requests.
* Ensure that customer concerns relating to loan servicing are addressed within defined timelines.

D. Customer Complaint & Grievance Resolution

* Receive, register and track customer complaints and service requests.
* Understand the nature of customer grievances and identify the appropriate resolution mechanism.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to resolve complaints.
* Follow up on pending complaints until closure.
* Maintain accurate records of complaints, actions taken and resolution timelines.
* Escalate unresolved or sensitive customer grievances to the reporting manager.
* Ensure that customer complaints are handled in accordance with company policies and applicable regulatory requirements.

E. Customer Relationship & Communication

* Maintain professional and positive relationships with customers.
* Communicate loan-related information in simple, clear and understandable language.
* Proactively contact customers regarding pending documentation, application updates and service requests.
* Provide appropriate guidance to customers throughout their loan journey.
* Handle dissatisfied customers and difficult conversations with patience and professionalism.
* Ensure transparency in all customer communications.
* Never make unauthorised commitments regarding loan approvals, interest waivers, settlements or changes in repayment terms.

* Coordinate with Sales and Business Development teams for customer acquisition and onboarding-related queries.

* Coordinate with Operations for documentation, disbursement and loan servicing issues.

* Ensure timely communication and closure of customer requests across departments.

G. Customer Service MIS & Reporting

* Pending service requests.
* Average query resolution time.

5. Key Skills & Competencies

jobs.description:
**About the Company:**

DigieSign is a Bengaluru-based legal-tech and fintech company building a connected suite of products that help lenders digitise the full lifecycle of a loan — from signing the agreement to recovering dues and resolving disputes. Our customers are NBFCs, banks and financial institutions across India.

Our product suite:

* DigieSign – Aadhaar and DSC-based eSignatures and digital document execution for loan agreements, sanction letters and other lending documents.
* Serve – End-to-end legal notice dispatch: multilingual notice generation, digital delivery (email, SMS, WhatsApp) and physical dispatch via India Post, with tracking and court-ready delivery reports.
* Collect – Collections automation that helps lenders reach delinquent borrowers at scale and improve recovery rates.
* Resolve – Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) for faster, cheaper resolution of lending disputes through arbitration, conciliation and mediation. We already work with leading NBFCs, and we are now building city-level teams to grow faster. Bengaluru is our home city and the first of these hubs.

**Role Overview**

As City Manager – Sales & Operations, Bengaluru, you will own our business in the city end to end. You will bring in new NBFC and bank customers, and you will make sure that every customer we sign is onboarded smoothly, served well and keeps growing with us. You will run the city like a business unit: pipeline, revenue, delivery quality and client satisfaction are all yours.

This role suits someone who enjoys being in front of credit, legal and collections leaders at lending institutions, and who also likes making operations run cleanly behind the scenes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Sales & Business Development (approx. 60%)**

•Find, prospect and acquire new NBFCs, banks (private, small finance, cooperative), HFCs and MFIs headquartered or with major operations in Bengaluru and Karnataka.

•Build and manage a healthy pipeline: research target accounts, map decision-makers (Heads of Collections, Legal, Credit Operations, Risk, IT/Digital) and run multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

* Run product demos and discovery meetings, and position the full suite: DigieSign, Serve, Collect and Resolve.

* Build proposals, commercial quotes and pricing in line with company guidelines; negotiate and close agreements.

* Handle procurement processes, vendor empanelment, RFPs, information security questionnaires and legal/compliance reviews at client institutions.

* Cross-sell and upsell across the suite to existing accounts (for example, moving a Serve customer onto Collect or Resolve).

* Meet monthly and quarterly targets for new logos, revenue and pipeline.

* Keep the CRM up to date and share accurate forecasts with leadership.

* Represent DigieSign at BFSI industry events, NBFC forums and legal-tech meetups in the city.

**B. City Operations & Client Delivery (approx. 40%)**

* Own client onboarding for the city: account setup, user training, template configuration, data upload formats and go-live.

* Oversee day-to-day delivery for Bengaluru clients, including legal notice dispatch batches, India Post coordination, eSign volumes and ODR case flows, so that SLAs and turnaround times are met.

* Coordinate with internal product, tech, legal and support teams to resolve client issues and escalations quickly.

* Make sure clients receive timely MIS and delivery reports, and review account health with them regularly (monthly reviews and QBRs).

* Track usage, wallet/billing status and collections on invoices for city accounts, and follow up on receivables.

* Manage local vendors and partners (printing, dispatch, courier and field partners) where needed.

* Capture client feedback and feature requests and pass them to the product team in a structured way.

* As the city grows, hire, train and lead a small team of sales and operations executives.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* New NBFC and bank customers signed per quarter

* Revenue and pipeline value against target

* Time from signature to go-live for new clients

* SLA adherence for notice dispatch, eSign and ODR delivery

* Client retention, expansion revenue and cross-sell across products

* Receivables collected on time

**Requirements Must have**

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA preferred.

* 3–6 years of experience in B2B / enterprise sales, account management or operations in BFSI, fintech, legal-tech or SaaS.

* A proven record of selling to NBFCs and/or banks, with an existing network among collections, legal, credit or operations leaders.

* Understanding of the lending lifecycle in India — loan origination, documentation, collections, NPA recovery and legal/recovery processes (SARFAESI, Section 138 NI Act, arbitration).

* Comfort managing operational processes, SLAs and client escalations.

* Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills in English; Kannada and/or Hindi strongly preferred.

* Comfortable with CRM tools, Excel/Google Sheets and preparing MIS reports.

* Willing to travel within Bengaluru and Karnataka for client meetings. Good to have

* Experience selling eSign, eStamp, legal notice, collections or ODR solutions.

* Exposure to RBI digital lending guidelines and outsourcing norms for regulated entities.

* Experience setting up or scaling a city or regional business from an early stage.

* Experience hiring and leading a small team.

**What We Offer**

* A chance to build and own a city business at an early-stage, fast-growing legal-tech company.

* Direct work with the founding team and real influence on product and go-to-market.

* Competitive fixed pay plus a performance-linked incentive plan.

* A clear growth path to Regional / Zonal Head as we expand to more cities.

Pay: ₹70,000.00 - ₹110,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Head of India
jobs.description:
**The Role**
India is the biggest remittance market with over $130 billion a year flowing home to it, from everywhere: engineers in the Bay Area and Sydney, cabbies in Toronto, construction crews in Dubai, shopkeepers in Leicester, students in Berlin. From Punjabis, Gujaratis, Tamils, Malayalis and Telugus. From people wiring $3,000 a month to a Mumbai mortgage and people sending $80 to a village in Bihar. Your job is to win this market.
  
  
You are someone who gets excited by the nuances of the Indian diaspora and how to reach each group, and who wants to own the P&L, the regulatory landscape and pricing at the same time. If you find the price sensitivity of each cohort exciting, and "why do Malayali nurses cluster in specific hospital systems, and what does that mean for acquisition?" as interesting as "what's RBI's latest remittance policy and which banks make the best partners," this is it.
  
  
As the GM, you own the P&L, and set pricing. For customer growth, you decide which communities to acquire and in what order. Know the RBI's rules well enough to see the openings inside them, not just the limits. A Gujarati family in New Jersey and a Punjabi trucker in Brampton got abroad through completely different networks, and reaching them takes completely different channels.
  
  
Reports to the Head of South Asia. Builds a team of FX Advisors in India and growth managers in sending markets. The face of India inside and outside the company. Total ownership. Be your own CEO
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* The P&L. Volume, gross profit and CAC across every India corridor. Not influence, own. A miss is your miss. A beat is your win.
* Strategy and sequencing. Which sender markets, which communities, which channels, in what order. US, Canada, UK, Europe, Australia and UAE to start. Build the plan, defend it to leadership, execute it.
* Pricing. India is the most rate-sensitive, most competitive remittance market in the world, up against competitors who reprice daily. Set FX and fee strategy corridor by corridor.
* The regulatory and partner landscape. RBI rules, bank partnerships, payout rails. Know the terrain cold and own the local relationships.
* Product. Obsess over UX and the services NRIs actually need. Closer to the customer than anyone in the company, and what you hear feeds straight into product, pricing and customer support.
* The diaspora puzzle. Community partnerships, temples and gurdwaras and churches, cricket leagues, student associations, remittance-heavy employers, influencers, festivals (Diwali is a season, not a day). Get in front of each community authentically, and cheaply.
* The team. Hire, coach and retain people in India and in sending markets. Small, dense, fast.

**Who You Are**

* 10 to 15 years in high-growth environments: startups, operations, consulting, finance, fintech. Has owned a number and talks about it the way owners do.
* Diaspora-fluent. Real knowledge of and networks in the Indian diaspora, and real curiosity about it. Migration patterns, community structures, who sends money to whom and why.
* Commercially sharp. Holds pricing, unit economics and CAC math in their head, and works the data directly. Excel or Sheets required, SQL a real plus.
* A hustler with judgment. Closes a bank partnership Monday, reviews corridor margins Tuesday, shows up at a community event in Jackson Heights on Saturday. Likes all three.
* A regulatory realist. Understands (or can quickly master) RBI rules and the compliance realities of moving money into India. Treats compliance as a partner, not an obstacle.
* Multilingual, ideally. Fluent in English. Hindi, Gujarati, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu or Malayalam are genuine assets.

Location: London or Dubai. Regular travel to India and sending markets is part of the job.
  
  
**Why This Role**
India is the largest remittance market in the world, and winning it moves the whole company forward. This role owns that outcome, with the authority and the accountability that come with it. It also drives real value for the customers: Immigrants work hard for this money, and every basis point saved goes home.
  
  
**About Us**
We’re building the world’s leading cross-border fintech for emerging markets - empowering families, fuelling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services.
  
  
Since our launch in 2019, we have transformed how money moves across borders with our operations spanning 6 out of 7 continents and covering both the busiest and most underserved (remittance) corridors. We tapped into a massive shift - from banks to phones - bringing digital finance to places where traditional systems never reached. The next stage of growth will fuel a network of services and products especially designed to make money more accessible to diaspora communities including local cards, and additional savings and payments features.
  
  
We’re growing fast, backed by world-class investors, and scaling a product that blends
**real world impact with cutting edge fintech innovation**
.
  
  
**Here’s a Little More**

* Founded by Harvard grads and 3-time founders who previously built Segovia (acquired) and GiveDirectly (>$300M revenue, fastest-growing NGO in the world)
* Backed by top investors including Spark Capital, Canaan, Reid Hoffman, Breyer Capital, Unbound, Wamda, and more
* Built by global top performers from Bain, Google, McKinsey, Uber, Checkout, Bolt, and beyond - we move fast, stay humble, and care deeply about our mission
* Truly global team - 250+ people, 50+ nationalities, 50+ languages
* Guided by our values - ownership, impact, humility, and heart - in deed, not just word

Taptap Values
  
  
Impact first
  
  
Team next
  
  
Accept reality
  
  
Propose solutions
  
  
Win with grit
  
  
Be proactively candid, with yourself and others
  
  
Love the particular
  
  
Own it
  
  
Create positive energy
  
  
Maybe, even have fun
  
  
Taptap Send is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All employment decisions are decided on the basis of qualifications, experience and business need. We strongly encourage applications who are members of underrepresented communities to apply.
  
  
If you require reasonable adjustments to be made during the recruitment process, please do not hesitate to let us know. Any information you provide us in this respect will only be used to accommodate your requirements.
  
  
*Note: we recognize imposter syndrome is real - any candidate that does not perfectly fit every characteristic of this role is still strongly encouraged to apply.*

Consolidated Analytics Inc is a key player in the US Real Estate space offering full suite of Mortgage support services to its clients. These comprise of Valuation services, Post Close Audit support, Fulfilment support, Default support, Investor Claims and consulting advisory services. Most importantly, the Due Diligence Division of CA Inc offers third party rating services (FITCH, SsP GLOBAL, KROLL, MORNINGSTAR, AND DRBS) through its unique underwriting solutions to customers in the Capital Markets space. The underwriting solution is also extended to both originations and default operations to some of the clients.

This is a competitive space that CA has positioned itself as a formidable player in. To stay competitive and ahead of the game, CA constantly endeavors to reengineer its UW processes and the supporting tech to stay agile, relevant and most sought after by its clients.

The Due diligence businesses won by nimble players who can turn around files faster and in an accurate fashion. **Current Operation Model**

The current model of operations follows a seamless integrated model comprising of onshore and offshore team members. The offshore unit predominantly assists in performing bookmarking and data extraction activities on a loan file. The Data extraction is performed across Credit, Income and Compliance sections of the loan file. Bookmarking ensures bookmarking consistency across the labelling of each document, chronologically arranging similar documents, removal of duplicate documents, re-arranging misplaced documents and nesting bookmarks under a header bookmark. Currently both bookmarking and data extraction are performed using a third-party AI driven software. From the Offshore side, the Underwriters collect data and review on the following areas: Credit (Income Calculation) and Compliance.

jobs.title: Revenue Accounting Engineering and Delivery Tech Lead - India
jobs.description:
**Role Purpose**
The Head of Engineering for Revenue Accounting India will provide senior technology and engineering leadership for the Revenue Accounting organization in India, building a world-class engineering capability and driving modernization, engineering excellence and predictable delivery across the Revenue Accounting technology estate.
  
  
The role will establish India as a
**strategic engineering centre supporting end-to-end delivery**
, partnering with global Technology and Finance leadership to deliver critical Revenue Accounting capabilities and strategic transformation.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong engineering and technology leadership with the ability to lead a large, complex organization, develop exceptional talent, modernize the technology estate and deliver consistently in a highly regulated environment.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Engineering Leadership & Strategy**

* Lead the Revenue Accounting engineering organization in India, with accountability for engineering excellence, talent, technology and delivery outcomes.
* Define and execute the India engineering strategy, aligned to the global Revenue Accounting technology strategy and broader Finance transformation agenda.
* Provide strong technical leadership across the engineering organization, ensuring strategic technology decisions balance business outcomes, architecture, resilience, risk and long-term sustainability.
* Establish clear engineering standards across software design, architecture, development, testing, DevSecOps, observability, resilience and production engineering.
* Champion a culture of engineering ownership where teams are accountable for solutions throughout the technology lifecycle, from design and build through deployment and production.

**Technology Modernization**

* Drive modernization of the Revenue Accounting technology estate, including MOTIF and the broader subledger ecosystem, simplifying legacy architecture and moving toward strategic target-state capabilities.
* Actively manage technical debt and drive simplification of applications, infrastructure, data flows and engineering processes.
* Promote modern architecture and engineering patterns including cloud, APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, automation and modern data capabilities where appropriate.
* Ensure technology investment balances immediate business and regulatory requirements with the long-term strategic health of the platform.

**Delivery & Transformation**

* Drive predictable execution of the Revenue Accounting engineering roadmap, aligning engineering capacity to the highest-value business, regulatory and strategic outcomes.
* Provide senior engineering leadership to major Finance transformation initiatives, ensuring Revenue Accounting capabilities integrate effectively with the target front-to-back accounting architecture.
* Establish transparent measures of engineering health, delivery effectiveness, quality, risk and productivity.
* Identify and proactively manage material technology dependencies, delivery risks and capacity constraints.

**Talent & Organizational Leadership**

* Build and develop a high-performing engineering organization across India, strengthening both engineering leadership and deep technical capability.
* Attract, retain and develop outstanding engineering talent while creating clear career paths for technical specialists and engineering leaders.
* Build a strong succession pipeline across Director, VP, technical leadership and senior engineering roles.
* Strengthen institutional knowledge and reduce key-person or third-party dependencies through targeted insourcing, mobility, cross-training and capability development.
* Foster an inclusive, collaborative and high-performance engineering culture where teams are empowered to challenge, innovate and continuously improve.

**Innovation & AI**

* Champion the responsible adoption of AI-enabled software engineering, intelligent automation and modern developer tooling across the engineering lifecycle.
* Identify opportunities to improve developer productivity, test automation, software quality and speed to market through AI and automation.
* Create an environment that encourages experimentation while ensuring innovation is governed appropriately for a regulated technology environment.

**Partnership & Stakeholder Leadership**

* Act as a senior member of the global Revenue Accounting technology leadership team, ensuring India is fully integrated into global strategy and decision-making.
* Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Finance, Product, Architecture, Operations, Risk, Controls and Technology.
* Influence enterprise technology and engineering decisions beyond the immediate Revenue Accounting organization.
* Represent Revenue Accounting within the broader India technology leadership community and strengthen India's position as a strategic engineering hub.

****Desirable Skills****
The following would be advantageous:
  
  
  

* Experience within financial accounting technology, including subledger, general ledger, financial control or regulatory reporting platforms.
* Understanding of front-to-back accounting flows, including transaction capture, accounting event generation, subledger processing, reconciliation, financial controls and general-ledger integration.
* Experience delivering large-scale Finance or enterprise transformation within a global financial institution.
* Experience with large-scale platform or cloud modernization.
* Knowledge of modern technologies and patterns including Java, APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, AWS/cloud technologies, DevSecOps and modern data platforms.
* Experience implementing AI-assisted software engineering, developer productivity tooling or intelligent test automation at enterprise scale.
* Experience developing product-oriented and Agile engineering organizations.
* Experience implementing insourcing strategies and transferring critical technology or domain capability from third-party providers into permanent engineering teams.
* Experience leading globally distributed engineering organizations, particularly across India, the UK and US.
* Understanding of technology economics and experience optimizing engineering investment, infrastructure costs and third-party expenditure.

****Accountabilities****
The Head of Engineering will have clear accountability across the following areas:
  
  
**Technology & Architecture**

* Technical health and strategic evolution of the Revenue Accounting technology estate within the role's remit.
* Alignment to enterprise architecture, engineering and technology standards.
* Reduction of legacy complexity and technical debt.
* Creation of sustainable, resilient and scalable technology solutions.

**Engineering & Delivery**

* Quality, predictability and effectiveness of engineering delivery.
* Engineering standards and controls throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Effective management of engineering capacity, dependencies and technology risks.
* Continuous improvement of engineering productivity, quality and time to market.

**Service, Resilience & Controls**

* Stability, resilience, security and maintainability of technology platforms.
* Effective management of production risk, recurring incidents and systemic technology issues.
* Compliance with applicable technology, cyber, data, resilience and regulatory requirements.
* Timely identification, escalation and remediation of material technology risks and control weaknesses.

**People & Organization**

* Organizational health and effectiveness of the India Revenue Accounting engineering function.
* Workforce strategy, organizational design and location strategy.
* Attraction, retention, development and succession of engineering talent.
* Development of strong engineering and technology leadership capability.
* Reduction of key-person risk and inappropriate dependency on external providers.

jobs.description:

66592

Hybrid Worker

#### **Brand**

HSBC

Full Time

24 November 2026

**Some careers have more impact than others.**

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a meaningful difference, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be. As one of the world’s largest banking and financial services organisations, HSBC operates across 62 countries and territories.

We aim to be where the growth is—enabling businesses to thrive, economies to prosper and people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We’re seeking an experienced professional to join our Securities Services team as **NFR Senior Manager.**

  

**In this role, you will:**

* Report to the FMI NFR Head, the Senior Manager will act as a key partner in shaping and delivering the FMI non-financial risk agenda. The role holder will recommend priorities, take ownership of agreed deliverables and lead implementation across in-scope FMI activities and NTTPs, ensuring alignment with Group mandatory procedures, the Risk Management Framework (RMF) and Third-Party Risk Policy requirements.
* This newly created position will lead the design, implementation and ongoing enhancement of the FMI NTTP risk management operating model. The Senior Manager will translate policy requirements into effective governance, controls and management information (MI), challenge existing practices and drive consistent adoption. Success will be measured through demonstrable improvements in risk management and sustainable control outcomes, rather than completion of activities alone.
* Working across Network Management and Market Intelligence (N2MI), Trading Facilities and CCP Management (TFCM), CSD Management and PS Management, the role holder will influence senior stakeholders and lead resolution of complex risk and control matters. The role will operate autonomously within an agreed mandate, escalating material exposures, unresolved disagreements and decisions requiring the FMI NFR Head’s authority. The FMI NFR Head retains overall functional accountability, while business and control owners retain responsibility for their risks, controls and remediation.
* Partner with the FMI NFR Head to establish a prioritised programme of activity that strengthens the control environment for in-scope FMI NTTPs. Lead delivery of agreed outcomes, ensuring risk management practices are consistent, evidence-based and aligned with Third-Party Risk Policy requirements, FMI-specific expectations and applicable risk appetite.
* Lead the development of clear, forward-looking risk insight and recommendations to inform governance and senior decision-making. Challenge control weaknesses, emerging exposures and the adequacy of proposed responses, holding accountable owners to agreed remediation outcomes and escalating material concerns or delivery risks.
* Drive change across FMI by leading implementation of CIB-led Third-Party Risk Management initiatives and improvements to mandatory procedures, operating instructions, reporting and tooling. Assess market infrastructure and regulatory developments, recommend proportionate responses and secure stakeholder commitment to changes that are practical, consistently embedded and sustainable.
* Partner with the FMI NFR Head to shape priorities and lead implementation and enhancement of mandatory FMI procedures and associated controls across in-scope NTTPs. Lead annual reviews and updates across N2MI and TFCM, challenge gaps and drive consistent application as business and regulatory requirements evolve.
* Lead oversight of FMI third-party controls and monitoring, critically assess results and challenge the adequacy of control design, operation and supporting evidence against Third-Party Risk Policy requirements and FMI-specific expectations. Drive resolution of weaknesses with accountable owners and maintain audit-ready documentation standards.
* Lead development and quality assurance of monthly governance packs and MI for the FMI Business Control Committee and N2MI Governance Committee. Translate complex matters into clear risk assessments, recommendations and decisions required; present and defend key messages, challenge senior stakeholders and escalate material concerns through the appropriate governance channels.
* Lead end-to-end oversight of NFR actions, issues and remediation, including Management Self-Identified Issues (MSIIs) and Audit Identified Issues (AIIs). Challenge root-cause analysis, action plans, milestones and closure evidence; hold accountable owners to agreed outcomes and escalate delays, unresolved exposures or remediation that does not deliver sustainable risk reduction.
* Lead FMI’s coordination of internal and external audits and assurance reviews. Establish coherent responses across the FMI team, challenge evidence quality and consistency, identify cross-cutting themes and drive delivery of agreed remediation with accountable owners, escalating significant matters to the FMI NFR Head.
* Lead FMI’s implementation and embedding of CIB-led Third-Party Risk Management initiatives. Assess business impacts, establish clear delivery plans and accountabilities, influence stakeholders across business, operations and Risk and Control functions, and resolve implementation challenges to secure effective adoption.
* Drive continuous improvement and simplification of FMI NFR processes, reporting and tooling. Challenge inefficient practices, prioritise changes that strengthen control effectiveness, data quality and management insight, and lead delivery from design through implementation and embedding within an agreed mandate.
* Lead analysis and preparation of responses to regulatory requests and senior management queries. Proactively assess emerging market infrastructure and regulatory developments, determine implications for FMI NTTP operational performance and the control environment, and recommend prioritised, proportionate responses to the FMI NFR Head and relevant stakeholders.
  

**To be successful you will:**

* Substantial experience in non-financial risk, operational risk, third-party risk or governance and controls within financial services or a similarly regulated environment, with a demonstrated record of leading complex risk and control initiatives.
* A self-starting, solution-oriented approach, independently setting priorities aligned with the FMI NFR agenda and driving delivery without close supervision. Takes proactive initiative and end-to-end ownership, remaining accountable for outcomes and exercising sound judgement on when to engage or escalate.
* Strong practical expertise in risk and control frameworks, including the ability to challenge risk assessments, control design and effectiveness, root-cause analysis, remediation plans and closure evidence, and maintain audit-quality documentation.
* Strong analytical capability and sound judgement to interpret complex information, identify emerging risks and cross-cutting themes, and recommend priorities based on materiality.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with senior leaders, influence and constructively challenge stakeholders, resolve competing priorities and secure delivery across business, operations and Risk and Control functions without relying on direct reporting authority.
* Strong executive communication skills, including producing concise MI, dashboards and governance papers, presenting complex matters clearly, making evidence-based recommendations and articulating the decisions and actions required from senior stakeholders.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional change from design through implementation and embedding, establish clear accountability and manage multiple priorities with disciplined delivery and attention to detail. Evidence of sustainable improvements in risk management or control effectiveness, supported by proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
* Knowledge of FM

jobs.title: Area Manager - Credit & Operations
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONAREA MANAGER – CREDIT & OPERATIONS

**Industry:** NBFC- Gold Loan  
**Location:** Thiruvananthapuram / Assigned Area  
**Department:** Credit & Operations  
**Reporting To:** Regional Manager / Head of Operations

1. Job Purpose

The Area Manager – Credit & Operations will be responsible for managing credit operations, customer visits, loan appraisal and approval, branch performance, business development and portfolio quality across assigned branches.

The position requires an experienced professional who can balance credit discipline with business growth, regularly visit branches, motivate employees, support customer acquisition and ensure efficient branch operations.

The Area Manager will play a key role in improving business performance across Gold Loan, Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan products.

2. Duties & Responsibilities

**A. Branch Visits & Business Development**

* Visit every assigned branch at least once a week.
* Review branch-wise business performance, loan disbursements, outstanding and collection efficiency.
* Motivate Branch Managers and employees to improve business sourcing and achieve assigned targets.
* Conduct regular meetings with branch teams to review performance and business plans.
* Identify local business opportunities and support branches in acquiring new customers.
* Participate in important customer meetings and assist branch teams in converting high-value loan proposals.
* Identify operational and business challenges and provide suitable solutions.
* Monitor staff productivity and provide guidance to improve individual performance.
* Develop strategies to improve branch business across Gold Loans, Business Loans and Commercial Property Loans.
* Submit weekly branch visit reports with observations, business updates and action plans.

**B. Customer Visits & Credit Assessment**

* Conduct regular customer visits for Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan proposals.
* Visit business premises, commercial establishments and properties to assess customer credentials and business activities.
* Evaluate customer repayment capacity, business operations and financial position.
* Independently verify information provided in loan applications and identify discrepancies.
* Meet prospective and existing customers to understand their financial requirements.
* Support branch teams in handling high-value and critical loan proposals.
* Ensure proper field verification and due diligence before recommending loan proposals.

**C. Credit Appraisal & Loan Approval**

* Review and evaluate loan applications across assigned branches.
* Assess customer eligibility, repayment capacity, income documents and credit history.
* Ensure proper assessment of collateral, property valuation and legal documentation.
* Review and approve or recommend loan proposals within delegated authority.
* Ensure adherence to credit policies, lending norms and product-specific eligibility criteria.
* Identify potential credit risks and take preventive measures.
* Ensure proper documentation and verification before loan disbursement.
* Improve credit processing turnaround time without compromising lending standards.

**D. Gold Loan Operations**

* Monitor gold loan appraisal procedures and ensure adherence to company guidelines.
* Ensure accuracy in gold purity testing, weight assessment and valuation.
* Monitor Loan-to-Value (LTV) compliance and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Conduct surprise inspections and verification of gold packets and vault procedures.
* Ensure proper custody, security and reconciliation of pledged gold ornaments.
* Monitor gold loan renewals, closures, overdue accounts and auction procedures.

**E. Business Loan & Commercial Property Loan Operations**

* Supervise credit evaluation and processing of Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan applications.
* Review financial statements, bank statements, income documents and business cash flows.
* Ensure proper property valuation, legal scrutiny and title verification for property-backed loans.
* Coordinate with legal, technical and credit teams for timely processing.
* Ensure compliance with approved lending policies and sanction conditions.
* Monitor documentation, disbursement and post-disbursement compliance.

**F. Branch Operations & Process Control**

* Monitor daily branch operations and ensure operational discipline.
* Conduct periodic branch inspections and operational audits.
* Ensure proper cash management, document custody and record maintenance.
* Review daily transactions, disbursement reports and operational MIS.
* Identify process gaps and implement corrective measures.
* Ensure adherence to internal SOPs and operational guidelines.

**G. Portfolio Monitoring, Collections & Recovery**

* Monitor branch-wise portfolio performance and overdue accounts.
* Track NPA, delinquency and collection efficiency.
* Identify early warning signals and potentially stressed accounts.
* Coordinate with Branch Managers for recovery and overdue reduction.
* Ensure timely follow-up of maturing and overdue loan accounts.
* Recommend corrective actions to improve portfolio quality.

**H. Team Management & Motivation**

* Guide, supervise and motivate Branch Managers and branch employees.
* Train branch teams on credit policies, documentation and operational procedures.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and operational training.
* Ensure accountability and adherence to defined responsibilities.
* Support branch teams in achieving business and collection targets.
* Build a customer-focused and result-oriented working culture.

**I. Compliance, Risk Management & Audit**

* Ensure compliance with applicable RBI regulations and internal policies.
* Monitor KYC, AML and customer due diligence requirements.
* Coordinate internal, concurrent and statutory audits.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Report operational irregularities, fraud indicators and policy violations to management.
* Ensure effective implementation of risk management practices across branches.

**J. MIS & Management Reporting**

* Prepare and review branch-wise credit and operational performance reports.
* Monitor loan sanctions, disbursements, outstanding, collections and overdue positions.
* Submit periodic reports to Regional Management / Head Office.
* Analyse operational bottlenecks and recommend process improvements.
* Prepare weekly branch visit reports and follow up on pending action points.
* Support management in implementing business growth and risk management strategies.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* **Branch Visits:** Minimum one visit to every assigned branch every week.
* **Business Growth:** Improvement in branch-wise sourcing and loan disbursements.
* **Customer Visits:** Regular field visits for customer verification and credit assessment.
* **Credit Approval:** Timely appraisal and decision-making.
* **Branch Motivation:** Regular performance meetings and staff engagement.
* **Credit Quality:** Effective control over NPA and overdue accounts.
* **Gold Loan Operations:** Accuracy in appraisal, LTV compliance and gold security.
* **Operational Efficiency:** Audit scores, process adherence and documentation quality.
* **Collections:** Improvement in recovery and collection efficiency.
* **Reporting:** Timely submission of weekly and monthly MIS reports.

4. Candidate Profile

* Graduate / Postgraduate in any discipline; finance or banking qualifications preferred.
* 8–15 years of experience in Banking or NBFC operations.
* Strong experience in credit appraisal, loan operations and branch administration.
* Exposure to Gold Loans, Business Loans and Loan Against Property / Commercial Property Loans.
* Experience in handling multiple branches or geographical areas preferred.
* Good knowledge of RBI regulations, KYC, AML and credit risk management.
* Strong customer relationship, business development and team leadership skills.
* Willingness to travel regularly

------------

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Senior Manager, Business Governance & Controls (BG&C), leads the first-line operational risk and control agenda for the Bengaluru GCC. The role establishes a consistent and effective risk and control environment aligned with ANZ’s Risk Appetite and enterprise risk framework, while ensuring business and functional leaders retain clear ownership of their risks and controls.

  

As the senior risk partner to the GCC Head and GCC Leadership Team, the role provides independent-minded advice and constructive challenge, strengthens risk culture and operational resilience, and enables well-informed business decisions. The role also leads the continuous improvement of control testing, assurance insights and governance reporting across the GCC.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  

**Role Type: Full Time, Permanent**  
**Role Location: Bengaluru**

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

As a Senior Manager, BG&C, you will:

  

* Develop and execute the GCC first-line risk and control strategy, aligned with ANZ’s Risk Appetite, enterprise risk framework and relevant regulatory obligations.
* Establish and maintain a consistent GCC-wide approach to identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring and reporting operational and compliance risks, with clear business ownership of risks and controls.
* Act as the senior risk partner to the GCC Head and GCC Leadership Team, providing timely advice, evidence-based insights and constructive challenge to support informed decision-making.
* Lead GCC-wide risk assessments across operational, technology, cyber, data, third-party, people, conduct, regulatory and change risks, ensuring material exposures and emerging themes are identified and addressed.
* Oversee the GCC operational resilience agenda, including first-line oversight of critical operations, material service providers, intra group arrangements, business continuity and key dependency or concentration risks.
* Coordinate GCC implementation of relevant enterprise and regulatory risk requirements, including PACT, NFR framework changes and CPS 230-related obligations, in partnership with Group Risk and specialist teams.
* Lead the design, uplift and consistent application of control testing methodologies, quality benchmarks, documentation standards and review practices across GCC teams and portfolios.
* Champion data-led and automated testing approaches where appropriate, ensuring enhancements are well governed, scalable and improve the quality and efficiency of assurance outcomes.
* Synthesise risk assessments and control testing outcomes into clear, prioritised insights for the GCC Leadership Team and relevant governance forums, including transparent escalation of material weaknesses, systemic issues and non-compliance risks.

* Oversee the quality and progress of remediation, challenging whether actions address root causes and provide sufficient evidence of sustainable closure, while retaining accountability with the relevant business owner.
* Lead first-line coordination of internal, external and in-country audits for the GCC, ensuring effective business engagement, timely responses and disciplined tracking of agreed actions.
* Build a strong risk and compliance culture by coaching leaders, strengthening accountability and promoting open, transparent engagement across businesses, functions, second line, Audit and other key stakeholders.
* Lead and develop the BG&C team, ensuring effective resourcing, clear priorities and the skills and capability required to meet current and future GCC needs.
* Drive continuous improvement of the GCC risk and control environment, supporting business, process, systems and automation changes while ensuring associated risks are understood and appropriately managed.

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

  

**‘Must have’ knowledge, skills and experiences**

  

* Strong degree of know-how and ability to drive strategic initiatives
* Strong understanding of risk and control frameworks, including control taxonomies and enterprise risk standards.
* Knowledge of regulatory obligations relevant to conduct, compliance, and operational risk.
* Awareness of business processes, control design principles, and first‑line risk responsibilities.
* Analytical capability to interpret data, identify patterns, and translate findings into actionable insights.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey risk messages clearly and influence stakeholders.
* Ability to assess control adequacy and effectiveness, including root‑cause analysis and evidence evaluation.
* Stakeholder engagement and relationship‑building skills, with confidence to challenge constructively.
* Planning and prioritisation skills to manage testing cycles, competing workloads, and quality standards.
* Experience delivering control testing, quality assurance, or risk assessment activities in a regulated environment.
* Demonstrated involvement in analysing business processes and identifying control gaps or compliance issues.
* Strong understanding of risk management and operational risk
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to lead discussions and partner effectively with stakeholders across geographies
* Knowledge of banking processes and/or products
* Extensive experience in enterprise risk management and/or leadership roles within the banking, financial services or KPO sectors
* Knowledge of retail banking products and processes
* Demonstrated experience in risk and compliance management
* Strong stakeholder management
* Demonstrated experience in people leadership and capability development

**‘****Good to have’ knowledge, skills and experiences**

  

* ERP systems and Risk toolkits
* PACT
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Programs
* Business and Executive Report Writing

  

**Qualifications**

  

* Relevant tertiary qualifications
* Overall 15+ years of experience in banking, including a minimum of five years in risk, compliance or audit

jobs.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

**Role Description:**

This role is responsible for the ongoing monthly testing of the Quality Assurance program for all Wealth clients records in UAE. The Post Execution Quality process is a key risk indicator that is reported to the regulators monthly. The PEQ process is reviewed numerous times a year by Regulators, Internal Audit and Compliance Testing to ensure adherence to regulatory and Citi-wide policies and standards. This role is responsible to test the Post Execution Quality accuracy to ensure all KYC Quality reporting is in line with our regulatory commitments to the OCC. This role is responsible for independently testing each PEQ analyst and report all findings to the Head of Wealth KYC Quality for effective oversight of personnel.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

This role is critical in identifying any quality deficiencies immediately, raise self-identified issues for proper oversight and execution on the correction action plans in a timely manner. * Transformation Roadmap: Define and own the enterprise transformation roadmap across finance, operations and technology.

*Good-to-Have*

**What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)**

* A clear transformation roadmap approved by leadership.
* Two to three high-impact automation or modernisation programmes delivered.
* Governance and KPI framework running with regular executive reporting.
* Visible gains in cycle time, cost, or control quality.

**Why Join Us?**

* Shape how Osfin works and scales, alongside the founders and senior leadership.
* Work with a high-calibre team of industry experts and solve complex problems at scale.
* Build capabilities that serve leading customers across banking, fintech, e-commerce, and other industries.
* Drive the next phase of platform and operational development, with significant ownership and impact.
* Competitive compensation and ESOPs aligned with your contribution and impact.

Location: Bengaluru

Immediate joiners preferred (up to 30 days considered)
  
  
Interested? We'd love to hear from you.

**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
  
  
**Job Title**
Director, Payment Acceptance
  
  
**Job Location: Pune**
**5 Days Work from Office**
**Shift Timing : 6:30PM to 3:30AM**
**What does a great Director of Business Analysis I do?**
The
**Director, Payment Acceptance**
provides strategic and operational leadership for Payment Acceptance operations functions within Merchant Solutions. This leader is accountable for delivering consistent, controlled, and efficient operations across least cost routing, interchange reconciliation, network reporting and fee oversight, merchant data integrity and PCI compliance support, and Payment Acceptance inquiries while ensuring the organization meets client commitments, network requirements, financial controls, service levels, quality standards, and productivity expectations.
  
  
The Director leads through other leaders and is responsible for translating business strategy into operational execution across a complex Payment Acceptance environment. The role provides oversight across credit deibt and dispute operation routing and configuration, interchange and settlement reconciliation, network fees and reporting, merchant compliance requirements, inquiry management and escalation, production workflow, reporting and analytics, and continuous improvement.
  
  
This leader is expected to think beyond daily operations. They anticipate operational, financial, network, and compliance risk; identify opportunities to simplify and modernize processes; develop scalable operating models; and establish the controls, metrics, talent, and governance necessary to support Payment Acceptance.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Provide strategic leadership for Payment Acceptance operations, establishing priorities, operating standards, performance expectations, and long-term direction across supported functions.
* Lead through managers, supervisors, and professional staff, creating clear accountability for operational execution, service delivery, quality, productivity, associate development, and results.
* Oversee Least Cost Routing support, ensuring debit network routing requirements, eligibility indicators, configuration values, and related data are accurate and support appropriate transaction routing.
* Provide leadership for interchange reconciliation activities across payment, interchange, settlement, and billing processes, ensuring variances, exceptions, and out-of-balance conditions are identified and resolved in a timely manner.
* Oversee network reporting and fee governance activities, ensuring reporting accuracy, data integrity, merchant compliance support, fee validation, and timely resolution of discrepancies.
* Provide leadership for Payment Acceptance inquiry support, ensuring Account Management and lines of business receive timely research, clear answers, appropriate issue tracking, and escalation to Technology when technical investigation or system changes are required.
* Provide oversight of payment and debit network requirements that affect routing, interchange, reporting, fees, merchant compliance, and Payment Acceptance operations.
* Lead production workflow and capacity management, ensuring inventory, staffing, skills, and resources are aligned to volumes, service-level requirements, and business priorities.
* Maintain strong financial and operational controls across interchange reconciliation, network fees, routing, reporting, exceptions, adjustments, and other activities affecting merchant or corporate financial positions.
* Establish and monitor performance metrics across productivity, quality, SLA attainment, inventory, aging, financial accuracy, data quality, operational risk, and client experience. Use data to identify trends, root causes, and opportunities requiring leadership intervention.
* Establish consistent processes for issue intake, research, ownership, escalation, aging, resolution, and communication across Payment Acceptance support functions.
* Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement by simplifying processes, eliminating manual activity, improving controls, expanding automation, and partnering with Technology on system and reporting enhancements.
* Lead Payment Acceptance technology and modernization initiatives, representing Operations in the design and enhancement of routing, reconciliation, inquiry, reporting, workflow, automation, and control capabilities.
* Drive a scalable operating model that provides resiliency, knowledge transfer, cross-training, and appropriate site redundancy while maintaining consistent operational standards across locations.
* Manage operational risk by proactively identifying process breaks, control gaps, financial exposure, network or compliance concerns, data-quality issues, and emerging trends and ensuring appropriate remediation and escalation.
* Support audit and control activities, maintaining strong documentation, process adherence, evidence management, and sustainable controls.
* Partner across the organization with Product, Technology, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Network Relations, Account Management, and other business partners to resolve complex issues and deliver strategic objectives.
* Provide leadership for client, merchant, and business escalations, ensuring complex Payment Acceptance issues are researched thoroughly, root causes are understood, and sustainable corrective actions are implemented.
* Develop organizational talent and succession, strengthening leadership capability and Payment Acceptance subject-matter expertise while building clear development paths for associates, analysts, supervisors, and managers.
* Create an accountability-driven culture where leaders and associates demonstrate ownership, sound judgment, follow-through, continuous learning, and commitment to client and business outcomes.
* Communicate operational performance and risk to senior leadership, translating complex operational data and issues into clear business impacts, recommendations, decisions, and action plans.

**What You Need To Have**

* Demonstrated experience in business analysis, Payment Acceptance, payment operations, network reporting, fee oversight, merchant compliance, or a related field, ideally within financial services.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large data sets, identify trends, validate data integrity, and resolve discrepancies.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex network requirements into clear business requirements and operational direction.
* Proven ability to lead multiple projects and priorities simultaneously with strong organization, accountability, and attention to detail.
* Strong knowledge of payment networks, merchant compliance requirements, network fees, reporting processes, and industry regulations.
* Proficiency with CRM systems, reporting tools, and Microsoft Office applications.
* Experience working with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI, and Excel macros.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate complex issues, assess business impact and risk, and coordinate solutions with payment networks and internal teams.
* Ability to work effectively across payment networks, lines of business, and cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
* High attention to detail, adaptability, and commitment to data quality, compliance, accuracy, and strong operational controls.

**What Would Be Great To Have**

* Experience leading Paymen

Morgan Stanley can provide a superior foundation for building a professional career, a place for people to learn, to achieve and grow. A philosophy that balances personal lifestyles, perspectives and needs is an important part of our culture.

**Department Profile**

Client Onboarding and Regulatory Services (CORDS) is a global group with offices in New York, Baltimore, London, Glasgow, Tokyo, Hong Kong, Mumbai and Bengaluru. The group partners closely with Business, Legal and Compliance Division, Risk Management and Technology to assist the Firm in complying with regulatory obligations that involve client data, documentation and reporting requirements.
  
  
The Quality Control (QC) function sits within the Client Onboarding & Reference Data Services (CORDS) department of the Firmwide Operations division. QC provides independent, risk-based quality assurance over the end-to-end client lifecycle, covering client onboarding, Know Your Customer (KYC), Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), sanctions screening, periodic review and account maintenance. As part of the first line of defense, the function gives senior management and the business assurance that client records meet the Firm's policy and regulatory requirements, and it uses data-led quality intelligence to find and fix systemic issues before they become risk events.

The Executive Director, Quality Control is a strategic and visionary leader accountable for the design, delivery and continuous transformation of the global QC framework across CORDS. The role leads a team of high-performing individuals, sets quality thresholds and tolerances, owns the risk-based QA/QC methodology and drives AI-led transformation of how quality is measured and assured. The successful candidate will be a trusted partner to Operations, Risk, Compliance, Technology and Audit leadership, able to influence without direct authority and to make strong, commercially aware decisions in a highly regulated environment.
