jobs.title: Sr Director, Finance
jobs.description:
**About Data Axle**

Data Axle Inc. has been an industry leader in data, marketing solutions, sales, and research for over 50 years in the USA. Data Axle now has an established strategic global centre of excellence in Pune. This centre delivers mission-critical data services to its global customers, powered by its proprietary cloud-based technology platform and by leveraging proprietary business and consumer databases.  
  
**Role Summary:**

We are looking for an experienced and strategic Senior Director - Finance to lead the finance function, oversee financial operations, and drive financial governance across the organization.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in managing financial reporting, accounting, controllership, taxation, audit, and regulatory compliance, with strong expertise in both Indian Accounting Standards (IGAAP / Ind AS) and US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP).

This role will serve as a strategic finance partner to senior leadership and global stakeholders, ensuring financial accuracy, operational efficiency, compliance, and alignment with global finance policies and business objectives.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Financial Reporting & Controllership**

* Lead end-to-end financial reporting, accounting, and controllership functions.
* Ensure accurate and timely preparation of financial statements under both IGAAP / Ind AS and US GAAP.
* Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing processes.
* Manage financial consolidation, reconciliations, intercompany accounting, and reporting.
* Ensure consistency between local statutory reporting and US GAAP reporting requirements.
* Establish robust internal financial controls, accounting policies, and governance frameworks.

* **US GAAP & IGAAP Compliance**

* Provide technical accounting guidance on complex accounting matters under US GAAP and IGAAP / Ind AS.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, statutory requirements, and regulatory guidelines.
* Manage accounting differences between Indian and US reporting frameworks, including revenue recognition, leases, fixed assets, provisions, and foreign currency transactions.
* Coordinate with global finance teams to ensure alignment of accounting practices and reporting standards.
* Drive implementation of changes in accounting standards and assess their business impact.

* **Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)**

* Lead budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and performance management.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to support strategic business decisions.
* Monitor revenue, operating expenses, profitability, cash flow, and financial performance.
* Develop financial models, business forecasts, and scenario analyses.
* Partner with business leaders to identify cost optimization and profitability improvement opportunities.

* **Audit, Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Lead statutory, internal, and external audit processes.
* Manage coordination with external auditors, tax consultants, and regulatory authorities.
* Oversee direct and indirect taxation, including corporate tax, GST, transfer pricing, and other applicable compliance requirements.
* Ensure adherence to Indian statutory and regulatory requirements.
* Support US audit and tax reporting requirements in coordination with global finance teams.

* **Treasury & Cash Flow Management**

* Oversee treasury operations, working capital, liquidity, and cash flow management.
* Develop strategies for efficient cash utilization and financial risk management.
* Monitor foreign exchange exposure and implement appropriate risk mitigation measures.
* Manage banking relationships and financing arrangements.

* **Global Finance Stakeholder Management**

* Act as a key finance business partner to US-based leadership and global finance teams.
* Drive standardization of financial processes, reporting frameworks, and controls across geographies.
* Present financial performance, risks, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
* Ensure effective coordination between India finance operations and US corporate finance.

* **Leadership & Team Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing finance and accounting team.
* Build a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Drive automation, process optimization, and digital transformation across finance operations.
* Establish KPIs and performance metrics for the finance function.

Requirements:

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) with 15+ years of post-qualification experience (PQE) in Finance and Accounting, including significant experience in senior finance leadership roles.
* Strong hands-on expertise in both **IGAAP / Ind AS and US GAAP**.
* Proven experience managing financial reporting and controllership for multinational organizations or US-headquartered companies.
* Strong understanding of US GAAP technical accounting, financial consolidation, and statutory reporting.
* Experience managing global finance stakeholders and cross-border financial operations.
* Strong exposure to financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, taxation, treasury, and audit management.
* Experience leading large finance teams and managing complex financial operations.

  

**Disclaimer**

Data Axle India follows a merit-based employee recruitment practice with extensive screening steps. Data Axle India does not charge or accept any amount or security deposit from job seekers during the recruitment process. Job seekers are requested to be aware of unsolicited or fraudulent communication regarding a job offer or interview call against payment of money and are advised to remain alert.

All Data Axle India jobs are published on the Careers page of its website and/or on its LinkedIn profile. Interested job seekers may access the same and apply directly. If you believe you have been a victim of recruitment fraud, please approach the appropriate law enforcement agencies immediately.

jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The Director, Contact Center Governance, Controls & Performance Management is a strategic leadership role responsible for establishing and leading the governance, performance management, financial control, operational risk, compliance, and quality oversight framework for Contact Center Operations. This leader serves as the first line of defense and is accountable for ensuring operational processes, customer servicing activities, technology platforms, and business controls operate effectively while supporting enterprise objectives, regulatory requirements, financial performance expectations, and customer experience goals.

The Director partners closely with Operations, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Quality, and Change Management teams to drive operational excellence, strengthen controls, improve performance visibility, and ensure successful execution of strategic initiatives. This role is responsible for executive performance reporting, Contact Center Operations Management Business Reviews (MBRs), Balanced Scorecard governance, operational readiness reviews, financial analysis, technology change governance, testing of new system rollouts, and deployment of AI-enabled controls and quality assurance capabilities.

Reporting directly to the SVP, Contact Center Operations, this position plays a critical role in protecting enterprise value, enabling scalable growth, reducing operational risk, improving financial discipline, and driving a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and data-driven decision making.

**JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Governance, Risk & Controls Leadership**

* Lead the overall governance and first-line control framework for Contact Center Operations, including policies, procedures, control standards, process documentation, and governance routines aligned with enterprise requirements.
* Identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate operational, regulatory, compliance, financial, and reputational risks across Contact Center Operations.
* Oversee RCSA activities, issue management, remediation plans, corrective actions, audit responses, and regulatory examination support.
* Serve as the primary liaison for Internal Audit, Compliance, Risk Management, external auditors, and regulatory examination teams.

**Performance Management & Executive Reporting**

* Own the Contact Center Operations performance management framework, including KPI governance across customer experience, quality, productivity, compliance, operational effectiveness, financial performance, and risk management.
* Lead monthly Contact Center Operations Management Business Reviews (MBRs), executive operating reviews, and Balanced Scorecard governance forums.
* Develop executive dashboards, scorecards, and reporting packages that provide actionable operational and financial insights.
* Drive accountability for performance improvement initiatives through structured action planning, follow-up governance, and data-driven recommendations.

* Apply accounting, financial analysis, and business performance expertise to evaluate operating results, expense trends, control effectiveness, and operational decision impacts.
* Partner with Finance and Operations leadership to analyze cost-to-serve, productivity, staffing efficiency, operational investments, and business performance trends.
* Develop business cases supporting automation, process improvement, technology investments, and strategic initiatives.
* Support annual planning, forecasting, budgeting, expense governance, and financial performance routines as required.

**AI, Automation & Intelligent Controls**

* Lead the strategy and roadmap for AI-enabled controls, automated quality assurance, and intelligent operational monitoring across Contact Center Operations.
* Leverage AI, machine learning, speech analytics, interaction analytics, automation, and advanced analytics to strengthen oversight, improve quality coverage, and detect risks earlier.
* Develop predictive monitoring, exception management, and automated control capabilities that proactively identify compliance risks, process failures, customer friction, and operational defects.
* Ensure AI-enabled solutions operate within established governance, regulatory, compliance, risk management, and model oversight standards.

**Technology Governance & Change Management**

* Partner with Technology and business stakeholders to ensure controls, compliance requirements, and operational readiness expectations are embedded into new systems and process changes.
* Lead operational readiness reviews for technology implementations, automation initiatives, and strategic system rollouts.
* Oversee User Acceptance Testing (UAT), business validation, control testing, implementation governance, and post-implementation performance monitoring.
* Ensure operational risks associated with system implementations are identified, assessed, mitigated, and monitored after deployment.

* Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related discipline required.

**Experience**

* Minimum 15-18 years of progressive experience in Operational Risk, Internal Controls, Compliance, Audit, Accounting, Finance, or Financial Services Operations.
* Experience supporting audits, regulatory examinations, enterprise risk management activities, and remediation governance.
* Experience managing operational controls within a highly regulated financial services environment.
* Demonstrated experience in accounting, financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and business performance management.
* Experience leading executive scorecards, KPI governance, Management Business Reviews (MBRs), and performance management programs.

* Mortgage servicing, banking, consumer lending, or financial services experience preferred.
* Experience implementing AI, automation, speech analytics, predictive analytics, or intelligent quality management solutions preferred.

**Description**

At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd  
  
Treasury is the Vice Presidency, reporting to the Managing Director and World Bank Group Chief Financial Officer, performing treasury functions for the IBRD and IDA and, to varying degrees, for other members of the World Bank Group and other public sector investors. Its activities are organized and grouped into the following departments: Capital Markets & Investment Management, Client Asset Management and Advisory, and Treasury Operations.  
  
Treasury (TRE) has been a large and significant player in the international financial markets for over seventy years and has achieved a global reputation as a prudent and innovative borrower, investor and risk manager. Treasury is responsible for: (i) managing approximately $195 billion in assets for the World Bank and other official sector investors; (ii) leading IBRD’s and IDA’s triple-A rated financing programs in international and domestic bond and derivative markets; (iii) conducting asset and liability management for IBRD’s and IDA’s balance sheets; (iv) overseeing the development and outreach related to the financing and hedging products the Bank provides for its developing-country clients; and (v) collaborating with the World Bank member countries to help build their capacity. Staff in Treasury regularly interact and collaborate with other departments across the Bank and Finance Partners’ teams.  
  
The Treasury Operations Department (TREOP) provides a full range of operational support for Treasury’s asset management, capital markets and banking businesses. The Department is presently organized in 7 operational units: Asset and Liability Operations (TREAL), Quantitative Solutions and Analytics (TREQA), and Cash and Banking Operations (TREBK), Treasury Quantitative Modelling (TREQM), Treasury ALM & Collateral (TREAC), Treasury Market Data and Valuation (TREMV) and a Financial Technology coordination unit (TREFT).  
  
Treasury Asset and Liability Operations (TREAL) is the unit responsible for delivering on a range of operations functions supporting the funding, investment, and asset and liability management portfolios for internal World Bank Group (IBRD, IDA, MIGA, and Trust Funds) entities. In addition, the team supports investment portfolios for a growing roster of more than 60 client entities in domestic and international markets. The team provides integrated and end-to-end support for all trade execution and portfolio servicing activities including trade review, settlement and documentation, options monitoring, debt service and cash and collateral management across the full range of products including bonds, swaps, repos, deposits, and exchange-traded derivatives.  
  
In performing these functions, the team works closely with internal partners and market counterparts as well as external service providers such as technology vendors, custodians, and paying agents. In addition to managing the day-to-day operations, TREAL staff lead the research, coordination, and implementation of new products and markets across Treasury. The team has a heavy focus on, and takes a leadership role in, evaluating and deploying the latest products and technologies (core trading platforms and new initiatives and technologies like CBDC, blockchain, AI, robotics, etc.) to create efficiencies, reduce risk, and advance thought leadership amongst WB’s peers and clients. TREAL staff participate in capacity-building programs for clients in these areas of expertise. TREAL staff recently co-led projects where the World Bank issued innovative digital bonds using blockchain technology and CBDC. In recognition of their efforts to advance capital markets and asset management, the TREAL team received several industry awards including for “Innovation in Reserves Management” (2021) and “Asset Servicing Initiative of the year” (2023). The team has twice been shortlisted for “Operations Team of the Year” award (2023 and 2024).  
  
Treasury ALM & Collateral Operations (TREAC) delivers operations support for asset and liability management, client risk management and collateral activities across IBRD, IDA and IFC. It is the operational engine of Treasury Client Solutions (TCS) and the central collateral management provider for WBG entities and RAMP clients. Team covers the full transaction lifecycle for funding and client hedging transactions, from trade setup and confirmation through settlement, rate fixings, payment events, exception handling, reconciliations and reporting. On the collateral side, it manages margining for OTC derivatives, MBS and futures, including daily margin calls, dispute resolution, CSA agreement administration, and monitoring of valuation.  
  
The team also supports long-term local currency investment transactions through IFC in countries where market solutions are not sufficiently available under the IDA–IFC Private Sector Window. The team works closely with front office, risk, finance, legal and technology teams, and with external counterparties, custodians, brokers and clearing organizations. Operating from Washington, D.C., Chennai and Sofia give the unit time-zone coverage and continuity. Beyond daily operations, TREAC leads systems implementation, convergence and digital transformation, with a strong focus on operational risk, controls and governance. The team operates on a common WBG operating model that aligns with IBRD, IDA and IFC practices, reduces duplication and manual handoffs, and delivers scalable, traceable, automation-ready processes.  
  
**Duties and Accountabilities:**  
The TRE Operations Chennai (TRECH) is an integral part of TREOP and is responsible for a variety of duties providing vital support across its operational divisions. It works closely with the Headquarters in Washington D.C and another shared services center in Sofia, Bulgaria. Under the guidance and supervision of a Team Lead and/or Functional Lead, the incumbent will have responsibilities for specific individual tasks/projects as well as for working as an integral part of the team in executing the Treasury Operation’s work program, while maintaining close relationships with the other Treasury departments.  
  
The incumbent’s primary responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, some combination of the following activities:

* Support data collection, analysis, visualization, and report writing, including by innovatively using data, stories, and analytics to build powerful narratives.

jobs.description:
Portage Point is a Chicago-headquartered advisory, interim management and investment banking firm focused on serving the middle-market. Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm has grown at over 30% annually since its founding in 2016 and today operates from ten offices across the United States and an office in Gurugram.

The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround & Restructuring and Investment Banking. Engagement teams are lean and execution-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transaction, transitions and transformations.

Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm's platform, established to build a high-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long-term growth in a high-performance environment.

The Technology function serves as the strategic and operational core of the firm's AI platform – building the enterprise-grade infrastructure, AI product platform and data foundation that power Portage Point's AI-enabled advisory model. The team architects and operates the multi-tenant Portage Point Platform, the Enterprise Data Vault and a portfolio of 15 AI products spanning all practice lines. Working directly with US leadership and practice line leaders, the team translates the firm's ambition – a digital AI version of every advisory capability – into a governed, scalable and commercially deployable technology platform.

The Senior Director, Enterprise Technology Build & Operations will report directly into the CTO, and holds unified accountability for Portage Point corporate technology environment and security posture. As firm scales, there is a need for robust IT operations, security and infrastructure planning and management. This role ensures the firm's IT foundation is reliable, secure and audit-ready, integrating network and endpoint operations, Microsoft 365 governance, ITSM delivery, Zero Trust security architecture, SOC 2 Type II compliance and AI-specific security controls under a single point of ownership. The role approves IT operations and service management designs, security architecture decisions, vendor engagements and infrastructure implementation decisions within CTO-approved standards.

### **Responsibilities**

* Design and operate enterprise network infrastructure (for e.g. Cisco Meraki, SD-WAN, dual-ISP failover, next-gen firewall) and Microsoft 365 environment (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Microsoft Purview) — covering tenant governance, licensing optimisation, DLP, retention and compliance features; manage the endpoint platform (Intune / Autopilot) including device enrolment, configuration, patch management and Conditional Access compliance enforcement
* Partner with the Head of Innovation and Product Manager on the platform roadmap, product intake from practice lines and release readiness
* Own the ITSM framework (ServiceNow or Jira Service Management) across incident, change, problem, service request and asset management; operate the IT service desk with P1–P4 SLA tiers, CSAT measurement and self-service knowledge base; personally own IT onboarding (Day 1 device, accounts and access) and offboarding (account revocation and access audit) within defined SLAs
* Design and enforce end-to-end security architecture with Zero Trust Network Access, micro-segmentation, Azure AD / Entra ID PIM, Conditional Access, application-layer security (OWASP Top 10 controls for all AI products), encryption, key management (Azure Key Vault) and AI-specific controls covering prompt injection defences, model access controls and audit trails for all LLM interactions
* Own the SOC 2 Type II programme – map platform and corporate IT controls to AICPA Trust Services Criteria, manage gap remediation, coordinate the external audit and produce the SOC 2 report for client and PE sponsor review; maintain TPI's information security policy suite; ensure compliance (personal data mapping, legal basis documentation, breach notification); manage the third-party and vendor risk assessment programme
* Design and operate the vulnerability management programme (Tenable.io or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management) with automated scanning and enforced remediation SLAs; deploy and operate SIEM (Microsoft Sentinel) for identity, data exfiltration and AI-specific threat detection; own the Incident Response Plan and personally lead all P1 and P2 security incidents
* Lead and develop the combined IT and security team of engineers and analysts; own IT procurement (TCO analysis, with CTO) and the full vendor portfolio; design and test IT BCP and DR procedures; produce monthly ITSM performance review and quarterly security dashboard for the CTO and COO
* Support talent acquisition and firm development efforts
* Lead technical trainings on architecture, data engineering and AI infrastructure
* Contribute to a high-performing and inclusive engineering culture

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree from a top undergraduate program required
* 15 plus years in IT leadership with demonstrated ownership of both corporate IT operations (infrastructure, service management) and cybersecurity (architecture, compliance)
* Experience as the senior IT and security lead in a professional services, advisory or GCC environment; Big Four or comparable advisory GCC experience a strong differentiator
* Located in or willing to relocate to Gurugram, India
* ITIL 4 Managing Professional (or above) and CISSP, CISM or equivalent cybersecurity certification required; must have designed and operated a live ITSM framework and personally owned a SOC 2 Type II programme
* Production experience with the Microsoft security stack at scale (500+ users): Entra ID, Conditional Access, PIM, Intune, Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Purview; enterprise network infrastructure (Cisco Meraki, SD-WAN, NGFW); ZTNA implementation experiences a differentiator
* ServiceNow or Jira Service Management administration — must have built incident, change and asset management workflows from scratch; hands-on PAM (HashiCorp Vault or CyberArk) and secrets management programme ownership; vulnerability scanning and CI / CD security integration (SAST / DAST) experience
* Prior exposure to private equity, M&A, or restructuring transaction environments preferred; ability to collaborate across US and India time zones and willingness to flex working hours for cross-border stakeholder engagement
* Superior written and verbal communication skills, including executive-ready presentation and reporting skills
* Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast-moving teams
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and ownership mindset
* Track record of success in high-pressure, client-facing environments

**Job Summary**

Treasury works closely with senior management, the businesses, Country CEOs / CFOs, and Finance to manage and promote the bank’s liquidity, capital, and balance sheet position. Treasury is laser-focussed on its vision to be “Open, progressive and trusted, working commercially with our partners” to create sustainable value by balancing the supply and demand of liquidity and capital.

Within Treasury (which comprises Capital, Liquidity & Markets), the Treasury Liquidity function is responsible for driving the strategic liquidity agenda and Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Booking (‘IRRBB’).

The Associate Director – IRRBB, India hub will support the Head of IRRBB, India Hub in advancing IRRBB Analytics for overseeing and executing comprehensive internal analyses. The role holder will help in migrating and centralising global IRRBB processes from Group and Clusters, performing detailed stress tests and scenario analyses, leveraging IRRBB data to provide insightful risk assessments and mitigation strategies. This position requires a deep understanding of IRRBB, strong analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with senior stakeholders across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy**  
• Keep up to date with the Group’s business strategy (incl. SC Ventures) and ensure the IRRBB frameworks are aligned to that.
  
• Partner with Global Head of IRRBB in developing and recommending risk mitigation strategies based on the findings from stress tests and scenario analyses. Ensure that these strategies are effectively communicated and implemented across relevant business units.

**Business**  
• Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates, with a focus on the Group’s participation in the Digital Assets and platforms space.
  
• Provide insights on current and forward looking IRRBB exposures, impact assessments on interest income and actions available for balance sheet optimisation.
  
• Lead the engagement with businesses on balance sheet optimisation strategies including but not limited to asset & liability mix to manage IRRBB while optimising returns.

**Processes**  
• **Analytics:** Support the newly developed IRRBB analytics capabilities on a regular basis, including operating the RCO IRRBB calculation engine to run bespoke scenarios and extracting and analysing the results, covering key metric including, but not limited to, Weekly NIIS Flash, Hedging Strategy Assessments, Corporate Plan NII impact simulations and PV01 analysis. This will also involve working with CPM and Finance closely to prepare MI slides for relevant committees like GALCO, ALCO and IRRBB Steering Forums.

* **Strategy:** Support IRRBB strategy by engaging Treasury Markets on NII sensitivities, hedging performance and P&L forecasting. * **Framework & Governance:** Support IRRBB governance through preparation of monthly GALCO/ALCO packs with commentary, review of risk metrics and monitoring of group, solo and local limits. Lead regulatory submissions and challenge returns, oversee MAT and risk appetite reviews, maintain IRRBB policies, support disclosures and audits, escalate emerging topics and drive regulatory engagement and interpretation.

Review and update IRRBB and structural hedging policies, maintain standards, and perform annual forecasts of NII, EBE, and P2A. Conduct policy effectiveness, self-assessment, gap and impact analyses, harmonize models with group, and run simulations and scenario analyses to support regulatory and corporate planning.

Businesses are continuously exploring opportunities to grow / rationalize costs and mergers and acquisitions, or carve-outs through separations and divestitures, are among the most complex business activities an organization will undertake. Deloitte’s global network of consulting

Learn more about our Strategy & Transactions Practice

  

**Your work profile**

Professionals in M&A group offer both advisory and deployment services that provide clients with comprehensive solutions to help them better manage the critical business functions.

We accomplish this mission through continued development of people in our Strategy, Risk and Transactions - M&A: Deal Transformation and Post Merger Integration

The primary role is to make direct contributions to the engagement team by assisting healthcare sector clients on Organization Readiness and integration or carve-outs in a deal / M&A scenario.

  

**Delivery of specific capability in Pharma M&A: DT & PMI**

**Organization readiness in a post deal integration:**

* Understand the integration vision and strategy set out in the deal objective
* Work with C-suite executives, business and internal firm stakeholders to identify integration guiding principles
* Identify the target operating model, organization construct and governance model for the consolidated entity
* Evaluate the considerations for organization readiness for interim (Day 1 /100), desired end state
* Establish Day 1 / Day 100 checklists and workplans

**Integration support for post-deal activities:**

* Program / Integration/ Transformation management office planning and readiness
* Day 1 / 100 Readiness planning
* Assess the IT landscape and identify the areas of synergies / dis-synergies
* Vendor evaluation and selection
* IT spend analysis (including vendor contract reviews for any hidden transactional costs), provide recommendations on the cost efficiencies
* Bid formulation and vendor management
* Facilitate execution of the post deal integration of IT operations and organization
  

**Carve-out and separation:**

* Develop the separation strategy and assess the separation readiness
* Evaluate financial and operational entanglements / interdependencies
* Identify the operating model, organization construct and governance model for the re-structured entity
* Evaluate the considerations for organization readiness for interim (Day 1 /100) and desired end state
* Establish Day 1 / Day 100 checklists and workplans

**Commercial and Operational Diligence and Transformation:**

* Evaluate the strategic and commercial feasibility of a deal / transaction
* Evaluate the current business capabilities and identify red flags on operational issues/risks

**Synergy / dis-synergy assessment & delivery:**

* Work with functional leads on Synergy realization
  

**Key skills required:**

* Strong advanced MS Excel and MS PowerPoint skills

jobs.description:
**Location & work modality: India , Mumbai**

**About Submer**  
  
**At Submer, we are redefining how data centers are built, integrated, and operated, with sustainability, efficiency, and innovation at the core. Our technology is designed to reduce environmental impact while improving performance and efficiency. We are a purpose-driven company with a passion for innovation and a growing global presence.**

**Your impact**

Submer India is seeking an experienced, commercially minded and strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead and build the Finance function in India. This is a growth- and investment-oriented role with particular responsibility for capital strategy, fundraising and the financial architecture supporting enterprise growth and infrastructure expansion.

The CFO will own the India capital agenda within approved mandates, working with India and Group leadership to secure financing and lead transactions through financial closure. The role requires an accomplished senior finance leader with demonstrated CFO-level responsibility and a proven record of personally leading and closing capital-raising transactions, preferably within technology, infrastructure, digital infrastructure, datacentres, engineering, energy or other high-growth and capital-intensive businesses.

The successful candidate will combine capital-raising capability with strong financial stewardship, governance and compliance. The CFO must understand the complete business lifecycle, from establishment and capitalisation through growth, scaling, restructuring and potential strategic transactions and/or potential exit, and be able to operate in an entrepreneurial technology and infrastructure environment.

**What you'll do**

**1. Strategic Financial Leadership**
=====================================

* Act as a key member of the India leadership team and provide strategic financial leadership to support Submer's growth and long-term enterprise value.
* Develop and execute the financial and capital strategy for the India business, linking enterprise growth and infrastructure expansion to appropriate sources of funding.
* Partner with business and operational leadership on investments, expansion plans and commercial opportunities, providing financial insight, strategic decisions and constructive challenge.
* Build scalable financial structures, processes, controls and planning capabilities suitable for a high growth organisation
* Build long term business planning and value creation.

**2. Investment, Fundraising and Capital Raising**
==================================================

* Lead the development and execution of capital-raising strategies for Submer's India business and strategic initiatives, aligned with approved plans and funding mandates.
* Build and maintain relationships with institutional, private equity, venture capital, infrastructure and strategic investors/partners, banks, financial institutions and structured-finance providers, as relevant.
* Lead India investor and lender engagement, financial presentations and, 'fund-sourcing to fund-raising to investment' plans and subsequent discussions; *(coordinate with Group finance and support Group-led transactions under the agreed mandate.)*
* Distinguish corporate capital for enterprise growth, including growth equity, strategic investment and corporate debt, from project or asset capital, including JV/SPV equity, infrastructure debt, construction finance and project finance.
* Develop financial models, investment cases and business plans; evaluate funding structures, financing costs, dilution, security requirements and investment returns.
* Lead financial due diligence readiness, strategic investment, financial structuring and financing negotiations through financial closure, coordinating legal, tax, business and technical inputs and obtaining required approvals.
* Agree capital-raising milestones with leadership and report on funding secured, transaction progress, financing terms and deployment of proceeds; maintain appropriate investor and lender reporting.

**3. Business Lifecycle and Growth Strategy**
=============================================

Guide the business through its financial lifecycle and ensure that funding structures and financial capabilities evolve with its stage of development. This includes:

* Business establishment, entity structuring, financial planning and initial capitalisation.
* Early-stage growth, scaling, fundraising and infrastructure or project expansion.
* Financial governance, commercial growth, profitability and long-term value creation.
* Mergers, acquisitions, strategic partnerships, restructuring and business transformation.
* Transaction readiness and potential exit planning.

Align corporate growth capital, project or asset financing and subsequent refinancing or strategic transactions with business needs, risk appetite and approved return objectives.

**4. Financial Planning, Analysis and Performance Management**
==============================================================

* Lead annual budgeting, long-term financial planning, forecasts and scenario modelling.
* Monitor financial and operational performance against approved plans
* Analyze profitability, cash flow, capital requirements and investment returns.
* Track business and project performance against approved investment cases, identify variances and recommend corrective action.
* Develop management reports and financial dashboards for senior leadership, identifying risks and opportunities and enabling informed decisions.

**5. Corporate Finance and Strategic Transactions**
===================================================

* Evaluate investment and strategic opportunities through valuation, financial analysis and assessment of returns and risks.
* Lead financial due diligence and financial transaction structuring for India-led transactions; *(support Group-led transactions within the agreed mandate.)*
* Structure and financially govern joint ventures and special purpose vehicles (JVs/SPVs), including shareholder funding, debt/equity arrangements, inter-company transactions and project returns.
* Develop and oversee cash waterfalls, distributions, dividend or repatriation arrangements and investor reporting in accordance with approved agreements and applicable requirements.
* Contribute to mergers, acquisitions and strategic partnerships, working with legal, tax, banking and external advisory partners
* Support exit readiness and strategic transaction planning.

**6. Finance Operations, Governance and Compliance**
====================================================

* Establish and maintain robust financial controls, policies and governance, including oversight of capital deployment and entity-level reporting.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian accounting, taxation, corporate and regulatory requirements
* Oversee financial, accounting and statutory compliance reporting.
* Ensure timely and accurate financial management and statutory filings.
* Manage relationships with auditors, tax advisors and external consultants; *(coordinating with Group finance as appropriate.)*
* Identify and mitigate financial and business risks, including financing covenant compliance and related-party exposures.

**7. Cash Flow and Working Capital Management**
===============================================

* Lead cash flow, liquidity and working capital planning and management.
* Align liquidity and financing requirements with business growth, capital expenditure and project or JV/SPV funding commitments.
* Manage banking relationships and financing facilities
* Monitor funding availability, drawdown conditions and covenant headroom.
* Monitor capital expenditure and investment commitments and optimise the use of capital across approved business, for infrastructure- and project-based requirements.

jobs.description:
**About WeRize**

Founded in 2019 by Vishal Chopra and Himanshu Gupta, WeRize is building India’s largest full stack fintech platform for 500 million underserved middle-class customers who live in 5000+ small towns of India. WeRize (Wortgage technologies pvt ltd) also owns RBI registered NBFC subsidiary (Wortgage Finance pvt ltd).

This customer segment is not served by private sector banks, Insurers and Mutual Fund companies due to their low ticket-size and lifetime value and is dependent on PSU/Govt. banks. PSU/Government banks rarely provide financial products beyond basic savings accounts and these customers lack access to unsecured loans, MSME loans, credit cards, affordable housing loans, loan against property , health/life insurance and investment products. WeRize manufactures innovative unsecured consumer credit, mortgages, loan against property, MSME loans, savings and insurance products designed for this customer base keeping in mind their needs, requirements and purchasing power, with a view to add a layer of financial security to their lives and enable access to credit.

While customers in these geographies use smartphones, they need proper guidance and support when purchasing the right financial products for themselves. So, a pure digital model doesn’t work for this segment. WeRize has innovated on this front through its ‘Finance ki online dukaan (Social Shopify of Finance)’, a first of its kind social distribution tech platform in the financial services space that educates and enables local financially literate freelancers across these small towns to source business through online and offline channels, recommend the right financial product(s) to customers as well as provide after sales support. These freelancers, who are located in more than 5000+ towns and cities, earn as much as INR 30,000 a month from WeRize in commissions.

Our social distribution platform supported by financially literate freelancers means exceptionally low cost of customer acquisition (CAC) and operations costs compared to both fully digital and on the-ground financial services providers. Digital conversions among this target group are way lower when compared to upper income customers in metros and hence pure digital CAC doesn’t work for this segment. While companies like LIC and Fino Bank also rely on freelancer distribution, they deploy local on-field teams/branches to manage freelancers in every city. That results in very high CAC and operations costs for such companies. WeRize on the other hand, has been able to acquire, train and manage thousands of freelancers in 5000+ cities only through its tech platform and without any feet-on-street team of its own. This results in highly profitable business model for Werize.

To know more about the company, please visit: https://www.werize.com/

**Position Overview**

We are looking for a high-impact, business-driven
**Chief Manager / Associate Director – Credit Card Sales**
to lead and scale our Credit Card vertical. In this role, you will be responsible for building end-to-end sales strategies, managing banking and co-branded card partnerships, and scaling credit card distribution across our social freelance partner network in 5,000+ small towns.

You will act as the single point of contact between bank partners, internal product/tech teams, and our freelancer channel to drive high-volume, cost-effective, and compliant credit card issuance tailored to India’s middle-income segment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership & Sales Execution**

* Own the P&L, sales targets, and portfolio growth for the Credit Cards vertical across 5,000+ towns.
* Formulate and execute scalable sales strategies to drive credit card adoption through our unique tech-enabled freelancer distribution platform (
  **‘Finance ki Online Dukaan’**
  ).
* Analyze regional performance, conversion funnels, and customer approval rates to continuously optimize sales pipelines.

**Partnership & Ecosystem Management**

* Onboard, manage, and scale partnerships with leading banks, card issuers, and fintech partners.
* Collaborate with partner institutions to design customer journeys, credit policies, and product variants tailored to Tier 2/3/4 customer profiles.
* Serve as the key liaison for day-to-day operations, SLA management, and approval rate optimizations with partner banks.

**Partner Enablement & Channel Engagement**

* Work alongside channel and marketing teams to design training modules, sales enablement toolkits, and commission/incentive structures for local freelancers.
* Drive engagement, active sourcing, and product cross-selling across the freelancer network to maximize card issuance.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with internal Product, Tech, and Analytics teams to enhance digital application flows, minimize friction, and automate approval pipelines.
* Ensure strict adherence to RBI guidelines, partner bank compliance, data privacy, and ethical selling practices across the freelance network.

**Qualifications & Skill Set**

* **Experience:**
  8 to 15 years of core experience in Credit Card sales, partner management, or unsecured lending within Banks, NBFCs, or Fintechs.
* **Distribution Expertise:**
  Proven track record in scaling financial products through indirect channels, agency networks, DSAs, or tech-enabled social/freelancer distribution.
* **Banking Partnerships:**
  Prior experience managing relationships, integrations, and SLAs with major credit card issuing banks.
* **Data-Driven Approach:**
  Deep understanding of approval funnels, customer acquisition metrics (CAC, LTV), and credit underwriting basics for middle-income segments.
* **Entrepreneurial Mindset:**
  Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, solve unstructured problems, and take complete ownership of product-line growth.

**Marcus Evans**
is a global leader in business intelligence and growth partner for leading businesses worldwide, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. Since 1983, we have brought decision-makers together through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms and performance programmes, working across all sectors and regions.

Our overriding approach is one of collaboration, and our belief that "We'll be our most successful when we work together." We recognise excellence and actively develop top performers into future leaders. Our culture promotes teamwork, continuous learning and global career growth.

**About Client Analytics**

Client Analytics is a new team in Hyderabad. It partners with the Managing Directors who lead our sales offices around the world, and helps them manage every client account to a consistent standard: before an event, on site and long after it. The team works on the data and discipline behind how we keep and grow clients, so our sales leaders can spend their time in front of them.

**Job Summary**

We're hiring Client Analytics Business Partner to work alongside the Managing Directors who run our sales offices in North America, APAC and Europe. You'll own the account management rhythm for those offices. That covers the rebook plan before every event, the results after it, the clients we're trying to win back, and the health of every active account. You'll turn client data into a clear view of where each account stands and what should happen next.

This is a partnering role, not a sales role and not an administrative one. You won't sell to clients. You will be the person an MD relies on to know whether the right work has been done on every account, to prompt it when it hasn't, and to report it clearly to our senior leadership.

This is an hybrid role in our Hyderabad office. Working hours overlap with the business day of the offices you support in North America and Europe.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan & Report: Build the pre-event rebook review four weeks out, covering what we plan to offer each client and how well we know them. Check that pricing has reached the sales team in time. Run a strategy update with the MD in the final one to two weeks. Four weeks after the event, report the outcome for every client.
* Win back lost clients: Own the lost opportunity list for your offices. Categorise each account, keep it current and review it with the MD every four weeks. Run the win-back programme, including the controlled use of complimentary video meetings. Track the results of reassigned accounts.
* Know the active portfolio: Keep a live view of each client showing what we know, what we plan to offer and when we next engage them. Use CRM data, AI tools and third-party sources to build the picture, and spot where the account can grow.
* Hold the standard: Monitor adherence to the account management workflow and alert the MD when a step is missed. Track KPIs and scoring, keep the dashboard current, and flag where retraining is needed. Work with Learning & Quality to train sales teams.
* Report to leadership: Present evidence-based reviews and clear recommendations to senior leadership, including the Chairman and CEO.
* Work across the business: Partner with Operations, Finance, Marketing and Technology. Direct the Account Management Coordinators who support your offices. Suggest improvements to our reports and tools, including where AI can save time.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in business, commerce, economics, statistics or a related field
* Minimum 5 years in sales operations, revenue operations, commercial analytics, account management analytics or a similar role supporting sales leaders
* Experience working directly with senior stakeholders in the US, UK or Europe, and the confidence to challenge them constructively
* Advanced Excel, plus hands-on experience with a CRM such as HubSpot or Salesforce
* Able to turn data into a short, clear recommendation that a busy senior leader can act on
* Excellent written and spoken English (C1 or above)
* Highly organised and comfortable managing several stakeholders, deadlines and reporting cycles at once
* Discretion with commercially sensitive information
* Willing to work hours that overlap with North American and European offices

**Preferred**

* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification
* Experience in B2B services, events, media, consulting or financial services
* Experience with dashboard tools such as Power BI or Tableau
* Experience using AI tools for research and analysis
* Familiarity with sales intelligence platforms such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo or Apollo
* Experience supporting account management, client retention or key account programmes

**Compensation**

**Compensation & Benefits**

Competitive base salary and performance base bonus opportunity, discussed in the hiring manager conversation

**Benefits**

* Work directly with Managing Directors and senior leadership, including the Chairman and CEO's office
* Join a new team at the start, and help shape how it works
* Fast-track, transparent promotional structure, with a path to Senior Business Partner and team leadership
* Opportunity to attend Marcus Evans events
* International travel opportunities
* A friendly, dynamic and vibrant work environment

**Marcus Evans**
is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity, and all employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need.

**About Column**
For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand — builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve.
  
  
At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. This means a safer, more transparent, and less costly banking supply chain. Come build with us!
  
  
**The opportunity**
As Column’s Emerging Markets Lead, you will spearhead one of our most strategic international expansion initiatives. In this role, you will be responsible for driving 0-to-1 growth for a new banking product, with a particular focus on building and nurturing relationships with prospective partners and customers in select markets, with a specific focus on markets within MENA. This role combines global expansion strategy, business development with hands-on relationship management, requiring a general business athlete who thrives on networking and executing complex partnerships. This is a unique opportunity to be on the founding team for a new business line, with significant autonomy and direct impact on Column’s global expansion strategy.
  
  
This position will be based in Dubai with regular travel throughout the region and occasional travel to Column’s headquarters in San Francisco.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead regional market development: Own the end-to-end process of identifying, evaluating, and executing on high-value partnerships with banks across a number of international markets.
* Build and maintain key relationships: Serve as the primary relationship owner for prospective and existing customers, conducting regular in-person meetings, attending local industry events, and managing ongoing partnership development.
* Own partnership execution: Lead complex deal processes from initial outreach through contract signature, working collaboratively with Column’s Legal, Compliance, and Product teams.
* Develop market intelligence: Gather and synthesize insights on local market conditions, regulatory developments, competitive landscape, and customer needs to inform Column’s regional strategy.
* Market expertise and network: Become an expert on the correspondent banking space in our key emerging markets and build an extensive network within their banking and fintech ecosystems.
* Drive operational excellence: Build scalable processes for onboarding, relationship management, and ongoing support that can be replicated as we expand.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**

* 6+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, growth, operations or strategy in a high-caliber environment
* 4+ years of business experience specifically in MENA
* Native fluency in Arabic and experience managing business relationships with Arabic-speaking clients and stakeholders
* Track record of successfully managing complex partnerships and high-value deals with executive stakeholders
* Natural networker who thrives on building trust and long-term relationships with senior executives, market experts and decision-makers
* Strong strategic thinking - ability to assess market opportunities, evaluate potential partners, and provide strategic recommendations to senior leadership
* Hyper-organized approach to project management, including coordinating efforts across multiple teams; comfort juggling multiple projects and priorities is critical
* Scrappy, roll-up-your-sleeves attitude - we thrive because we work harder, are more creative, and have zero ego when it comes to getting our hands dirty to build a business

**We look forward to hearing from you**
Column is committed to working with the best and brightest people from the broadest talent pool possible. We value bringing together a team with different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences, and believe a diversity of ideas is what allows us to develop the best solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
  
  
If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application and recruiting process, please reach out to accommodations@column.com.
  
  
We participate in the E-Verify program in certain locations as required by law. Learn more about the E-Verify program here.

jobs.title: Account Management Specialist
jobs.description:
**Department:**
Merchant Business

**Location:**
UAE

**Description**
**About Tabby:**
Tabby creates financial freedom in the way people shop, earn and save by reshaping their relationship with money. Over 20 million users choose Tabby to stay in control of their spending and make the most out of their money.
  
  
The company’s flagship offering allows shoppers to split their payments online and in-store with no interest or fees. Over 40,000 global brands and small businesses, including Amazon, Noon, IKEA, and SHEIN use Tabby to accelerate growth and gain loyal customers by offering easy and flexible payments online and in stores.
  
  
Tabby generates over $14 billion in annual transaction volume for its partner brands and is the highest-rated, most-reviewed, largest, and fastest-growing FinTech in the GCC region.
  
  
Tabby launched in 2019 and has since raised +$1 billion in equity and debt funding from global and regional investors, and now has an implied valuation of $4.5 billion.
  
  
**About the Role:**
The Account Management Specialist manages a portfolio of strategic and enterprise merchants, driving long-term growth, retention, and product adoption across accounts. Acting as a trusted advisor, the specialist is responsible for developing account strategies, identifying revenue opportunities, and delivering data-driven recommendations that maximize merchant performance and business outcomes.
  
  
This role requires strong commercial acumen, analytical capabilities, and stakeholder management skills. The Account Management Specialist is expected to operate independently, lead strategic merchant conversations, influence decision-making, and drive the adoption of Tabby's full product suite. The role also plays a key part in cross-functional initiatives, process improvements, and strategic projects that support broader business objectives.
  
  
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Account Management:**

* Own and manage a portfolio of strategic and enterprise merchants, driving retention, growth, and long-term partnership success.
* Build relationships with key decision-makers and act as a trusted advisor to merchants.
* Develop and execute account growth plans aligned with merchant objectives and Tabby's commercial strategy.

**Revenue Growth & Product Expansion:**

* Drive revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and expansion of Tabby's products and services.
* Identify opportunities to increase product penetration across the portfolio, including new and existing solutions.
* Lead commercial discussions and proactively position relevant products based on merchant needs and performance insights.
* Own pipeline generation within the portfolio and track expansion opportunities through to execution.

**Data Analytics & Portfolio Optimization:**

* Analyze merchant performance, transaction trends, conversion metrics, and product adoption to identify growth opportunities and risks.
* Translate complex datasets into actionable recommendations that improve merchant performance and revenue contribution.
* Conduct portfolio reviews, business reviews, and strategic performance discussions with merchants.
* Build dashboards, reports, and presentations to support data-driven decision-making.

**Strategic Projects & Business Initiatives:**

* Lead and contribute to strategic initiatives, product launches, operational improvements, and merchant experience enhancements.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and support automation and scalability initiatives across the business.
* Partner with leadership and cross-functional teams on high-impact commercial and operational projects.

**Merchant Success & Problem Resolution:**

* Proactively identify merchant challenges and business risks before they impact performance.
* Take ownership of complex merchant escalations and coordinate stakeholders to drive timely resolution.
* Ensure merchants receive strategic recommendations and solutions that support continued growth.

**Cross-Functional Leadership:**

* Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Operations, Risk, Finance, and Tech teams to deliver merchant solutions and achieve business objectives.
* Act as the primary point of coordination for strategic merchant initiatives requiring cross-functional involvement.
* Influence internal stakeholders and drive alignment to achieve successful merchant outcomes.

**Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
* 3-5+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Partnerships, Business Development, or a similar client-facing role.
* Proven experience independently managing enterprise or strategic accounts.
* Strong commercial mindset with demonstrated success in driving revenue growth, upselling, and cross-selling.
* Advanced analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into business recommendations.
* Experience conducting portfolio reviews, business reviews, and presenting performance insights to senior stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives and priorities simultaneously.
* Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Technical teams.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and experience with Tableau, Power BI, or similar analytics tools.
* Experience within fintech, payments, BNPL, e-commerce, or technology industries is preferred.

**Job Benefits**

* We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well at times that suit you and your team.
* A working environment that gives you autonomy and responsibility from day one.
* You should be comfortable with the idea that the quality of your work will influence the shape of your career.
* Participation in the company’s employee stock options program.
* Health Insurance.
* Flexi Perks: a monetary benefit to spend on what matters most to you — health, well-being, education, or professional development.

Founded and headquartered in Switzerland, Avaloq is continuously expanding its global footprint with around 2,500 colleagues in 12 countries, and more than 170 clients in 35 countries. We are an industry-leading provider of wealth management technology and services for financial institutions around the world, including private banks and wealth managers, investment managers, as well as retail and neo banks. Our research led approach and continual innovation is powered by the passion and creativity of our colleagues.
  
  
We are always looking for talented people to join us on our mission to orchestrate the financial ecosystem and democratize access to wealth management. Avaloq offers the opportunity to work closely with some of the world’s leading financial institutions as we jointly develop and shape careers. Championing a collaborative, supportive and flexible work environment empowers our colleagues to reach their full potential.
  
  
**Job Description**
The
**Sales Director / Manager – Africa**
is responsible for driving
**revenue growth, market expansion, and strategic client acquisition**
across the region. The role owns the
**end‑to‑end sales lifecycle**
, including pipeline development, strategic account management, complex deal structuring, and executive‑level stakeholder engagement, while working closely with
**delivery, product, marketing, and partner ecosystems**
to ensure sustainable growth and customer success
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Regional Revenue & Growth Ownership**

* Own and deliver regional sales targets, pipeline coverage, and forecast accuracy.
* Drive new logo acquisition and expansion of existing strategic accounts across banking, wealth management, asset management, and capital markets.
* Develop and execute country‑level and segment‑specific go‑to‑market strategies aligned with regional priorities (GCC, Levant, North Africa).

**Strategic Account & CXO Engagement**

* Build and maintain C‑suite relationships (CEO, CIO, COO, Heads of Wealth, Digital, and Transformation).
* Lead complex, multi‑stakeholder sales cycles, including RFPs, negotiations, and commercial structuring.

**Sales Execution & Deal Leadership**

* Lead the full sales lifecycle: opportunity qualification, solution positioning, pricing, contracting, and closure.
* Partner with pre‑sales, solution architects, and delivery teams to shape winning proposals and value‑based business cases.
* Ensure governance, compliance, and internal approval processes are followed for all deals.

**Partner & Ecosystem Development**

* Build and manage a strong regional partner ecosystem (system integrators, advisory firms, technology partners, introducers).
* Identify and execute co‑sell and joint go‑to‑market initiatives with strategic partners.
* Strengthen regional market credibility through alliances and industry presence.

**Market Intelligence & Competitive Positioning**

* Track market trends, regulatory changes, and competitive dynamics in the Middle East.
* Provide structured feedback into product, pricing, and regional solution strategies.
* Position differentiated value propositions against global and regional competitors.

**Team Leadership & Collaboration**

* Lead, coach, and develop sales and account management teams (where applicable).
* Foster strong collaboration with marketing, delivery, governance, and operations teams to ensure seamless execution.
* Contribute to regional leadership forums and management committees.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Regional revenue achievement and pipeline coverage
* New logo wins and strategic account expansion
* Forecast accuracy and deal governance compliance
* Average deal size and margin quality
* Partner‑sourced revenue contribution
* Client satisfaction and long‑term account sustainability

**Qualifications**

* Experience: Minimum of 15 years of proven sales experience in the banking, wealth management, or financial technology (fintech) industry, with a track record of exceeding sales targets, especially in the Middle Eastern region.
* Industry Knowledge: Strong understanding of the banking, wealth management, and financial services landscape, including regulations, technology trends, and challenges faced by financial institutions.
* Sales Skills: Demonstrated ability to sell complex software solutions to senior executives, with expertise in consultative and solution-based selling methodologies.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex concepts in a clear, concise, and persuasive manner.
* Relationship Management: Proven ability to build, nurture, and maintain strong client relationships, with a customer-centric approach to sales.
* Leadership: Ability to work independently and collaborate with a team, manage multiple opportunities simultaneously, and mentor junior team members.
* Education: Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or a related field. MBA or relevant certifications in sales or financial services is a plus.
* Technical Proficiency: Comfortable using CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.), Microsoft Office Suite, and other sales and presentation tools. Familiarity with banking and wealth management software is advantageous.
* Proficiency in English. French & Arabic language would be an added advantage.

**Additional Information**
We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.
  
  
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.
  
  
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.
  
  
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

**About Us**
Our team consists of 25,000 colleagues, spread across 35 countries. We believe in transformation – embracing agile and new ways of working together, which helps us to truly ‘think client’ and serve millions of our affluent and emerging affluent clients, across the world. Our clients include individuals and small businesses, and we support them with a range of traditional banking services, including investment, credit and wealth planning solutions.
  
  
We offer career opportunities for relationship managers, customer service specialists, product and segment management, sales and wealth planning.
  
  
**If you’re looking to unlock new job growth opportunities, Standard Chartered Bank is the place for you. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.**
**About Wealth And Retail Banking**
Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB) serves more than 11 million clients in many of the world’s fastest-growing markets. Our client continuum spans from Mass Retail to Affluent, including high-net worth clients served by our Private Bank. We leverage digital banking channels with a human touch to provide clients with differentiated products and services such as deposits, payments, financing, wealth management and personalised advice. We also support small business clients with their business banking needs.
  
  
**About The Job**
To become a strategic and managing client relations professional within our team, while utilizing your experience in building hips, across the region. Your focus will be on developing new relationships, to onboard new clients while maintaining and servicing a portfolio, through excellent communication, negotiation and customer service.

* Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations for your team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
* Ensure KYC/AML updates, proper zero error documentation.
* To be able to detect any suspicious transactions, Money laundering, forgeries etc.

**People & Talent**

* Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.

* Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.

**Risk Management**

* Updating the C – Manager, adhering to the Contact Management Plan.

* Ensure compliance with the above policies on an ongoing basis and reported any suspicious transaction immediately to the supervising officer.
* Ensure full awareness of all policies relating to operational risk, sales processes, anti-misselling, etc and comply with the same.
* Read, understand and comply with all provisions of the Group Code of Conduct.

**Our Ideal Candidate**

* Experienced Sales and Relationship Manager with background in handling all Banking & Investment Products. Strong communication and negotiation skills with the ability to influence outcomes.
* Networking ability to manage interdepartmental deliverables.
* Strong inter-personal skills and leadership ability, which encourages and promotes enthusiasm and team spirit.
* Good understanding of the business environment in UAE preferably with direct contacts with the local HNI community.

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

**Associate Director, Software Engineering Specialist.**

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
HSBC is seeking an Associate Director - Integration Engineering & Architecture to help deliver enterprise-grade integrations and data pipelines within Finance Technology. This role focuses on end-to-end technical delivery across Oracle Cloud components including integration with Oracle ERP, with a strong emphasis on high-volume data movement, controls and operational stability. You’ll define scalable ETL/ELT patterns and set engineering standards that support performance, resilience and maintainability. The role spans design, build, release and production support with accountability for outcomes in live environments. Success means reliable data movement, strong reconciliation and controls, automated delivery through CI/CD and an integration platform that performs consistently under load.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Own end-to-end technical delivery from inception through production support including planning, governance and stakeholder updates
* Define scalable ETL/ELT architecture and patterns for high-volume datasets with a focus on performance and maintainability
* Develop and optimise data pipelines using Oracle Data Integrator (ODI) and/or other data transformation tools
* Engineer integrations using Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) PaaS and SaaS components as appropriate
* Deliver integrations with Oracle ERP and Oracle Integration Cloud Service (OICS) with a focus on Finance modules where required
* Automate operational tasks and deployments using scripting to improve reliability and speed of change
* Implement secure and reliable transmission and connectivity mechanisms aligned to operational requirements
* Run production support for the integration platform including incident resolution, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement

What we're looking for
  
  

* Bring substantial experience in enterprise application integration, data transformation and technology delivery
* Demonstrate delivery of complex integration programmes and cross-team technology initiatives
* Show hands-on capability with ETL/ELT for large and diverse datasets including performance tuning and optimisation
* Apply practical expertise in Oracle Data Integrator (ODI) and/or equivalent transformation tooling alongside Oracle ERP integration
* Use proven experience with OCI (PaaS and SaaS components) and integrating cloud services into enterprise workflows
* Evidence delivery of integrations with Oracle ERP including Finance modules where applicable
* Apply working knowledge of scheduling tools, scripting languages, Oracle ATP database and secure transmission technologies
* Embed DevOps practices including CI/CD and release automation across integration platforms

Building Finance Integration at Scale
  
  
If you want to shape how critical Finance data moves across a complex technology landscape this role offers real scope and accountability. You’ll set technical direction for integration engineering and deliver outcomes that matter in production - performance, stability, controls and fast but safe change. You’ll work across stakeholders to deliver integrations that are robust and ready for scale. Apply to join HSBC in Pune or Hyderabad and help strengthen the integration platform that underpins Finance Technology.

9
